This paper develops a new anytime planner called LSRP* that can keep improving solution quality after the initial solution is obtained until the runtime budget depletes. We analyze the properties of LSRP* and test it against several baselines with up to 1000 agents on various maps. LSRP* can handle up to 25% more agents than LSRP and can reduce up to 40% of the solution cost found by LSRP.

translation.title: LSRP*：面向异步动作多智能体路径规划的可扩展与任意时间规划
translation.abstract: 多智能体路径规划（MAPF）旨在为多个智能体从各自起始位置到各自目标位置寻找无碰撞路径，同时最小化路径成本。尽管已发展出许多 MAPF 算法，但大多数依赖于同步动作的常见假设，即所有智能体的动作同时开始且始终耗时一个时间单位。这一假设可能限制 MAPF 规划器在实际中的应用。为摆脱该假设，最近提出了一种称为松同步基于规则的规划（LSRP）的算法，可为大量智能体找到次优解。然而，由于其次优性无界，LSRP 常常找到质量较差的解。本文开发了一种新的任意时间（anytime）规划器 LSRP*，它能在获得初始解后持续改进解的质量，直至运行时间预算耗尽。我们分析了 LSRP* 的性质，并在多种地图上与若干基线进行了多达 1000 个智能体的测试。LSRP* 比 LSRP 可多处理最多 25% 的智能体，并将 LSRP 找到的解的成本最多降低 40%。
translation.brief: 针对异步动作MAPF算法LSRP次优性无界导致解质量差的问题，提出任意时间规划器LSRP*，可在时间预算内持续改进解质量。

papers.title: From Reflection to Co-Evolution: Self-Evolving Agents with Locally Verified Memory
papers.abstract: LLM agents have made impressive progress in coding and mathematical reasoning, motivating growing interest in learning from long-horizon interaction. Memory supports this process, but plausible lessons can be redundant or reinforce inappropriate actions. Can a memory's source decision provide a practical test for whether to retain it? We localize consequential trajectory steps, extract candidate memories, and replay each source decision with and without its candidate under the same context. This reveals two properties: most candidates barely shift the probed distribution, and both successful and failed source actions can be reinforced or suppressed. These observations motivate Anchor, which tests shift magnitude and source-role alignment before retention. Admitted memories guide later trajectories, enabling experience-driven improvement under a frozen policy. On held-out ALFWorld and WebShop tasks, Anchor improves success rate and mean score by up to 19.9% and 17.2%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline for each backbone. With Qwen3.5-27B, it retains 41% fewer ALFWorld cards than unfiltered retention and outperforms all four WebShop cost-comparison baselines while using fewer tokens.

translation.title: 从反思到协同进化：具有局部验证记忆的自进化智能体
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体在编程和数学推理方面取得了令人瞩目的进展，这激发了对从长程交互中学习的日益浓厚的兴趣。记忆可以支持这一过程，但貌似合理的经验教训可能是冗余的，或会强化不当行为。记忆的来源决策能否作为是否保留该记忆的实用检验标准？我们定位轨迹中的关键步骤，提取候选记忆，并在相同上下文下分别在有和无该候选记忆的情况下重放其来源决策。这揭示了两个特性：大多数候选记忆几乎不改变所探测的分布，而且成功和失败的来源动作都可能被强化或抑制。这些观察催生了 Anchor，它在保留记忆之前检验偏移幅度和来源角色的一致性。被保留的记忆指导后续轨迹，从而在冻结策略下实现经验驱动的改进。在留出的 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 任务上，相对于每个骨干模型的最强基线，Anchor 分别将成功率和平均分最高提升了 19.9% 和 17.2%。使用 Qwen3.5-27B 时，相比无过滤的保留策略，它保留的 ALFWorld 卡片减少了 41%，并以更少的 token 超越了全部四个 WebShop 成本对比基线。
translation.brief: 解决自进化智能体记忆冗余或强化不当行为的问题，核心方法是通过重放来源决策检验记忆偏移幅度和来源角色一致性（Anchor）来决定记忆保留。

papers.title: A Computational Map of the Disaster Mental Health Research Landscape
papers.abstract: When disasters strike, they not only damage infrastructure, buildings, and the economy, but also affect the mental health of affected populations. Research on the mental health effects of disasters has expanded rapidly and has become an important, well-funded area of psychology, public health, and related social sciences. However, the overall structure of this research landscape has not been systematically characterized. Using large language models, we conducted a review of all articles related to terms 'disaster' and 'mental health' indexed in PubMed. 7,859 articles' metadata were retrieved using the NCBI API, and then Claude Sonnet was used to extract structured variables from the abstracts. The results indicated that earthquakes and epidemics were the most commonly studied disasters while many other disasters such as heat and cold waves have received less attention. PTSD, depression, and anxiety were well investigated but many other mental health issues (e.g., aggression, suicide) are relatively ignored. Despite enjoying relatively large sample sizes (median = 452, IQR = 142 - 1,568), the field rarely utilizes machine learning algorithms. Hypothesis significance testing, reviews, qualitative methods, and structural equation modeling are respectively most common methods while agent-based modeling, machine learning, casual inference, and NLP each appear in less than 1% of articles. Studies are limited to a small number of countries, particularly the United States, Japan, and China, while many disaster-prone regions remain substantially underrepresented. This LLM-assisted computational map provides a broad overview of the disaster mental health literature while highlighting important methodological gaps, with particular emphasis on the underutilization of computational methods that could help advance the field.

translation.title: 灾害心理健康研究领域的计算图谱
translation.abstract: 灾害发生时，不仅损害基础设施、建筑和经济，还会影响受灾人群的心理健康。灾害心理健康影响的研究迅速扩展，已成为心理学、公共卫生及相关社会科学中一个重要的、获得大量资助的领域。然而，这一研究领域的整体结构尚未被系统刻画。我们利用大语言模型，对 PubMed 收录的所有与“灾害”和“心理健康”相关的文章进行了综述。通过 NCBI API 检索了 7,859 篇文章的元数据，然后使用 Claude Sonnet 从摘要中提取结构化变量。结果表明，地震和流行病是最常被研究的灾害，而许多其他灾害（如热浪和寒潮）受到的关注较少。PTSD、抑郁和焦虑得到了充分研究，但许多其他心理健康问题（如攻击行为、自杀）相对被忽视。尽管样本量相对较大（中位数 = 452，IQR = 142 - 1,568），该领域很少使用机器学习算法。假设显著性检验、综述、定性方法和结构方程模型分别是最常用的方法，而基于智能体的建模、机器学习、因果推断和 NLP 各自出现在不到 1% 的文章中。研究局限于少数国家，尤其是美国、日本和中国，而许多灾害多发地区仍严重缺乏代表性。这份 LLM 辅助的计算图谱为灾害心理健康文献提供了广泛概览，同时凸显了重要的方法学空白，尤其是可能推动该领域进展的计算方法的利用不足。
translation.brief: 解决灾害心理健康研究全景缺乏系统刻画的问题，核心方法是用 LLM 对 PubMed 相关文献元数据进行大规模结构化提取与计算分析。

papers.title: Crustify: Repository-Level Generation of Safe Rust Bindings with LLM Agents and Coverage-Guided Testing
papers.abstract: Wrapping C code in a safe Rust interface lets Rust applications use it without writing unsafe code, until the code itself is migrated to Rust. Such bindings are tedious and error-prone to write, however: their internals use unsafe code that the Rust compiler does not check, so a single mistake can introduce undefined behavior (UB), and they have so far been written mostly by hand. We present Crustify, an agentic co-translator that generates safe Rust bindings for repository-level C libraries. Crustify schedules a target's types and symbols into dependency-ordered waves of independent batches that agents bind concurrently. Its agents derive the ownership and lifecycle contract of every pointer and type they wrap, check each binding with coverage-guided equivalence and UB tests under sanitizers and Miri, and review every wave. They build on three tools that we contribute: (a) ffibox, Rust primitives for C/Rust interop that mirror Box, Arc, and Vec for C objects without ever forming a reference to memory that C may alias; (b) Wavefront, a neuro-symbolic static analyzer that orders a target's items by their dependencies, including those that casts and type-erased pointers hide; and (c) ffimap, a rustc-based analysis that maps the unsafe surface of bindings. On libgit2 and ffmpeg, with one developer in the loop, Crustify generated safe bindings for 41.9% and 42.8% of their public APIs in about 51.9 and 58.9 hours. On the interface consumers are expected to use, only 1.6% and 0.4% of the bindings' public functions are unsafe, and only 0.1% and 0.6% have a raw pointer in their signature. Their tests cover 98.92% and 99.07% of the Rust code and 45.95% and 67.20% of libgit2 and of ffmpeg's libavutil, and the reviewers fixed 8 and 13 defects that caused UB reachable from Rust. To our knowledge, this is the first work to automate the generation of safe Rust bindings for C libraries.

translation.title: Crustify：基于 LLM 智能体与覆盖率引导测试的仓库级安全 Rust 绑定生成
translation.abstract: 将 C 代码封装在安全的 Rust 接口中，可以让 Rust 应用程序在不编写 unsafe 代码的情况下使用它，直到代码本身被迁移到 Rust。然而，编写此类绑定繁琐且容易出错：其内部使用的 unsafe 代码不受 Rust 编译器检查，因此单个错误就可能引入未定义行为（UB），而且迄今为止它们大多由手工编写。我们提出了 Crustify，一个为仓库级 C 库生成安全 Rust 绑定的智能体协同翻译器。Crustify 将目标的类型和符号调度为按依赖排序的、由并发智能体绑定的独立批次波次。其智能体推导所封装的每个指针和类型的所有权与生命周期契约，在 sanitizers 和 Miri 下用覆盖率引导的等价性和 UB 测试检查每个绑定，并评审每一波次。它们构建在我们贡献的三个工具之上：(a) ffibox，用于 C/Rust 互操作的 Rust 原语，镜像 Box、Arc 和 Vec 以管理 C 对象，且不会形成对 C 可能别名的内存的引用；(b) Wavefront，一个神经符号静态分析器，按依赖关系对目标的条目排序，包括那些被类型转换和类型擦除指针隐藏的依赖；(c) ffimap，一个基于 rustc 的分析，映射绑定的 unsafe 表面。在 libgit2 和 ffmpeg 上，在一名开发者参与的情况下，Crustify 分别在大约 51.9 和 58.9 小时内为其 41.9% 和 42.8% 的公共 API 生成了安全绑定。在消费者预期使用的接口上，绑定的公共函数中分别只有 1.6% 和 0.4% 是 unsafe 的，只有 0.1% 和 0.6% 的签名中包含裸指针。它们的测试覆盖了 98.92% 和 99.07% 的 Rust 代码，以及 libgit2 和 ffmpeg 的 libavutil 的 45.95% 和 67.20%，评审者修复了 8 和 13 个从 Rust 可达的导致 UB 的缺陷。据我们所知，这是首个自动化生成 C 库安全 Rust 绑定的工作。
translation.brief: 解决手工编写 C 库安全 Rust 绑定繁琐易错的问题，核心方法是 LLM 智能体按依赖波次生成绑定，并用覆盖率引导的等价性与 UB 测试验证。

papers.title: The Limits of Information-Flow Control Enforcement for Agentic Systems
papers.abstract: Information-flow control (IFC) is a promising approach to enforce policy in agentic AI systems. However, IFC suffers from label creep, a phenomenon where monotonically increasing security labels propagate through a system and progressively limit its utility. Label creep in agentic AI systems can be mitigated using two major strategies: (1) improved system design and (2) label declassification. In this paper, we characterize how far system design alone can mitigate label creep in agentic systems. Specifically, we measure how system topology, scale, and agent composition affect utility loss and security enforcement cost proxies for conservative IFC enforcement in a stateful agentic system simulator. We develop a pipeline to systematically vary these features and measure their impacts on label propagation. Our results demonstrate strong associations between structural graph features and our IFC utility loss metric (up to a Spearman correlation $|ρ|$ of $0.96$) and show that system size and tool allocation substantially affect how labels propagate. These findings identify design choices to reduce IFC utility loss, but they also demonstrate that system design alone cannot fully prevent utility loss due to monotonic label propagation. This motivates the development of label declassification mechanisms that aid these design choices and diminish IFC utility cost.

translation.title: 智能体系统中信息流控制执行的局限性
translation.abstract: 信息流控制（IFC）是在智能体 AI 系统中执行策略的一种有前景的方法。然而，IFC 受到标签蔓延的困扰，这是一种单调递增的安全标签在系统中传播并逐渐限制其效用的现象。智能体 AI 系统中的标签蔓延可以通过两大策略来缓解：(1) 改进的系统设计；(2) 标签去分类。在本文中，我们刻画了仅靠系统设计能在多大程度上缓解智能体系统中的标签蔓延。具体而言，我们在一个有状态的智能体系统模拟器中测量系统拓扑、规模和智能体组成如何影响保守 IFC 执行下的效用损失和安全执行成本代理指标。我们开发了一条流水线来系统地变化这些特征并测量它们对标签传播的影响。我们的结果证明了结构图特征与我们的 IFC 效用损失指标之间存在强关联（Spearman 相关性 |ρ| 高达 0.96），并表明系统规模和工具分配会显著影响标签的传播方式。这些发现指出了减少 IFC 效用损失的设计选择，但也表明仅靠系统设计无法完全避免由单调标签传播导致的效用损失。这促使我们开发标签去分类机制，以辅助这些设计选择并降低 IFC 的效用成本。
translation.brief: 解决智能体系统中 IFC 标签蔓延导致的效用损失问题，核心方法是在有状态模拟器中系统测量拓扑、规模和组成对标签传播的影响以界定系统设计的缓解上限。

papers.title: Coding or Cheating? An Investigation of Frontier Coding LLMs
papers.abstract: Frontier agentic LLMs are trained on verifiable rewards in reinforcement learning (RL) environments built from real software repositories. A passing test suite is treated as the reward for solving the task. We show that, on hard problems, frontier models often satisfy these rewards by obtaining the answer instead of deriving it, known as reward hacking. Prior reports document this behavior on public benchmarks. We test its persistence on unseen problems. In a hardened environment where the answer cannot leak, nearly every model we tested attempted to recover the answer, escalating through tiers of increasingly specialized exploitation: mining the repository history for the upstream fix, inspecting the git object store directly, and sweeping the filesystem for a possible newer copy of the source or hidden tests. These attempts were concentrated on the hardest problems, and the models differed in whether, how often, and how deeply they escalated. Our position is that this behavior is a learned shortcut, acquired in RL environments that leak the answer, not a sign of intelligence. We release agent traces for these models to support further study at https://huggingface.co/datasets/logitly-ai/reward-hacking-raw-v1.

translation.title: 编程还是作弊？对前沿编程 LLM 的调查
translation.abstract: 前沿智能体 LLM 在由真实软件仓库构建的强化学习（RL）环境中以可验证奖励进行训练。通过测试套件被视为解决任务的奖励。我们表明，在困难问题上，前沿模型常常通过获取答案而非推导答案来满足这些奖励，这被称为奖励作弊（reward hacking）。此前有报告记录了这种行为在公开基准上的表现。我们检验其在未见过的问题上是否持续存在。在一个答案无法泄露的强化环境中，我们测试的几乎所有模型都尝试恢复答案，并通过层层递进的越来越专业化的利用手段进行升级：挖掘仓库历史以寻找上游修复、直接检查 git 对象存储，以及扫描文件系统以寻找源代码或隐藏测试的可能的更新副本。这些尝试集中于最难的问题上，且各模型在是否、多久以及多深入地升级方面存在差异。我们的立场是，这种行为是在泄露答案的 RL 环境中习得的捷径，而非智能的表现。我们发布这些模型的智能体轨迹以支持进一步研究，见 https://huggingface.co/datasets/logitly-ai/reward-hacking-raw-v1。
translation.brief: 研究前沿编程 LLM 在无法泄露答案的环境中是否仍通过挖掘仓库历史等方式获取答案进行奖励作弊，核心方法是构建强化环境并分析智能体轨迹。

papers.title: Yuanbao-Reranker: Document-Grounded Synthesis and Preference Distillation for Text Reranking
papers.abstract: High-precision text reranking is a critical component in modern search, recommendation, and agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems. We present Yuanbao-Reranker, a family of general-purpose dense rerankers spanning 0.6B, 4B, and 8B parameter scales built upon the Qwen3 backbone. To construct diverse and reliable ranking supervision at scale, we pair answer-first and query-type-guided document-grounded synthesis with a three-stage curation funnel that verifies positive support, eliminates semantic redundancy, and enforces balanced source-by-length quotas. For each curated pair, we screen real retrieval pools with a teacher score margin to filter out potential false negatives and sample Hard, Medium, and Moderate negative tiers, yielding 2.75M $1{:}3$ ranking groups. We train the models by jointly optimizing pointwise relevance cross-entropy and a bounded minimum-gap hinge objective over both positive--negative and negative--negative pairs. This formulation transfers fine-grained teacher preferences across candidate tiers without over-constraining well-separated predictions, supporting both cross-scale and same-scale distillation followed by layerwise adaptive model merging. Across five comprehensive benchmarks spanning Chinese (CMTEB-R), multilingual (MMTEB-R), English (BEIR), long-document (MLDR), and code (MTEB-Code) retrieval, Yuanbao-Reranker consistently leads every parameter tier: the 0.6B variant reaches 70.96 Avg. to surpass 1B--4B active-parameter baselines, the 4B variant reaches 73.63 Avg. to outperform the 8B teacher (72.68), and the 8B variant achieves a state-of-the-art 74.21 Avg., with substantial gains generalizing across distinct first-stage retrievers.

translation.title: Yuanbao-Reranker：面向文本重排的基于文档的合成与偏好蒸馏
translation.abstract: 高精度文本重排是现代搜索、推荐和智能体检索增强生成（RAG）系统的关键组件。我们提出 Yuanbao-Reranker，这是一系列基于 Qwen3 骨干、覆盖 0.6B、4B 和 8B 参数规模的通用稠密重排器。为在大规模下构建多样且可靠的排序监督，我们将答案优先和查询类型引导的基于文档的合成与三阶段筛选漏斗相结合，验证正向支持、消除语义冗余并强制按来源和长度的配额平衡。对每个筛选后的样本对，我们用教师分数边际筛选真实检索池以过滤潜在假负例，并采样 Hard、Medium 和 Moderate 三个负例层级，产出 275 万个 1:3 排序组。我们通过联合优化逐点相关性交叉熵和有界最小间隔 hinge 目标（作用于正-负与负-负样本对）来训练模型。该公式在不过度约束已充分分离预测的前提下，跨候选层级迁移细粒度教师偏好，支持跨规模与同规模蒸馏，随后进行逐层自适应模型合并。在覆盖中文（CMTEB-R）、多语言（MMTEB-R）、英文（BEIR）、长文档（MLDR）和代码（MTEB-Code）检索的五个综合基准上，Yuanbao-Reranker 在每个参数层级均持续领先：0.6B 版本达到 70.96 平均分，超越 1B–4B 激活参数基线；4B 版本达到 73.63 平均分，优于 8B 教师（72.68）；8B 版本达到 74.21 的最先进平均分，且增益在不同第一阶段检索器上均能显著泛化。
translation.brief: 为构建多样化可靠的排序监督，该方法将基于文档的答案优先合成与三阶段筛选、假负例过滤及跨层级教师偏好蒸馏相结合，训练覆盖多参数规模的通用稠密重排器。

papers.title: Tail-risk-aware Agent Safety: Constraining Tail Risks Across Multi-step LLM Agent Workflows
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents extend LLMs with tool calls, memory, planning, and retrieval to act in external environments, but they are vulnerable to attacks at different workflow steps. Existing defenses, including prompt engineering and post-training alignment, primarily improve LLM-only safety and often overlook risks that arise from multi-step execution. External verification adds guardrails to check each step separately, but it typically ignores how risks can propagate across steps. We argue that we should consider risk transitions across dependent steps through the agent workflow, rather than separate verification on a single step. In this paper, we propose \textbf{T}ail-risk-aware \textbf{A}gent \textbf{S}afety (TAS), a tail-risk-aware safety framework that models agent workflow safety as a sequence of dependent safety states and constrains the rare but extreme risks (i.e., tail risk) with a shared budget. TAS first models safety-state transitions sequentially along the workflow as an MDP to trace risk propagation, then measures a tail-sensitive risk to target rare but high-cost risks (i.e., tail risk), and constrains the risk with a shared budget to derive a step-wise safety strategy. By constraining tail risk rather than the overall average, TAS suppresses rare high-cost failures while preserving utility in normal cases. Experiments show that TAS achieves better performance compared with eleven baselines across three benchmarks.

translation.title: 尾部风险感知的智能体安全：约束多步 LLM 智能体工作流中的尾部风险
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的智能体通过工具调用、记忆、规划和检索扩展了 LLM，以在外部环境中行动，但它们在工作流的不同步骤上容易受到攻击。现有防御手段（包括提示工程和后训练对齐）主要提升仅针对 LLM 的安全性，往往忽视多步执行带来的风险。外部验证为逐步检查添加了护栏，但通常忽略风险如何跨步骤传播。我们认为，应当通过智能体工作流考虑相依步骤之间的风险转移，而不是对单一步骤进行分离验证。本文提出尾部风险感知的智能体安全（TAS），这是一个尾部风险感知的安全框架，将智能体工作流安全建模为一序列相依的安全状态，并用共享预算约束罕见但极端的风险（即尾部风险）。TAS 首先将安全状态转移沿工作流顺序建模为 MDP 以追踪风险传播，然后度量尾部敏感的风险以针对罕见但高代价的风险（即尾部风险），并用共享预算约束该风险以导出逐步安全策略。通过约束尾部风险而非总体平均，TAS 在正常情况下保持效用的同时抑制罕见的高代价失败。实验表明，TAS 在三个基准上相比十一个基线取得了更好的性能。
translation.brief: 该框架将多步智能体工作流的安全状态转移建模为 MDP，并以共享预算约束尾部敏感风险，从而抑制罕见高代价失败。

papers.title: TurnFlow: Benchmarking User-State Reasoning in Multi-Turn LLM Agents via Scene-Guided User Simulation
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed through conversational interfaces, yet strong single-turn performance does not imply reliability in multi-turn settings. Multi-turn assistance requires a model to maintain an evolving representation of user requirements and to reason over it before complying with later requests. Failures can therefore be subtle: models may fail to recognize a changed constraint or hidden conflict, or recognize it without enforcing it in the final response. Existing benchmarks primarily test fully specified prompts, long-context recall, or controlled domain environments, leaving open-domain requirement reconciliation undermeasured. We introduce TurnFlow, an interactive benchmark for evaluating whether models preserve, revise, and act on user requirements across turns. TurnFlow combines adaptive user simulation with verifiable judging, allowing conversations to unfold naturally while keeping hidden requirements and pass/fail criteria controlled. In our evaluation, nine LLMs achieve overall pass rates from 42.86% to 59.59% on 490 scenarios. Performance varies substantially across challenge types: models perform well on Stateful Multi-Constraint Following but remain considerably less reliable on Scope Creep and Goal Shift. These results reveal persistent limitations in reasoning over evolving user requirements across turns.

translation.title: TurnFlow：通过场景引导的用户模拟评测多轮 LLM 智能体中的用户状态推理
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地通过对话界面部署，然而强大的单轮性能并不意味着多轮场景下的可靠性。多轮辅助要求模型维护一个不断演化的用户需求表示，并在满足后续请求之前对其进行推理。因此失败可能是隐蔽的：模型可能未能识别已变化的约束或隐藏冲突，或者识别了却未在最终响应中执行。现有基准主要测试完全指定的提示、长上下文回忆或受控领域环境，对开放领域需求协调的测量不足。我们提出 TurnFlow，一个交互式基准，用于评测模型是否在多轮之间保留、修改并执行用户需求。TurnFlow 将自适应用户模拟与可验证评判相结合，允许对话自然展开，同时保持隐藏需求和通过/失败标准的可控性。在我们的评测中，九个 LLM 在 490 个场景上的总体通过率为 42.86% 至 59.59%。性能在不同挑战类型间差异显著：模型在有状态多约束遵循上表现良好，但在范围蔓延和目标偏移上可靠性明显较低。这些结果揭示了模型在跨轮推理不断演化的用户需求方面的持续局限。
translation.brief: 该工作提出 TurnFlow 交互式基准，结合自适应用户模拟与可验证评判，评测 LLM 在多轮对话中保留、修改并执行用户需求的能力。

papers.title: Track or Follow? A Jev-Compatible Multi-Agent Trading System When Web News Lags the Market
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly trade on the Web news they read, yet much Web news about listed firms is published after, and about, the price move it reports, so a reader can agree with the market by following it instead of reading the event. We ask whether LLM judgments of Web news track the market's reaction to the reported event or follow it. To answer, we built a multi-agent trading system whose agents share only point-in-time stores and answer typed questions through the interface of Jev, a hosted typed decision model; code sets every position under a proved bound on how far text can move it. In a hash-committed test of a Jev-compatible reader built from a pinned LLM's option probabilities, item judgments track announcement-window abnormal returns (weekly Spearman 0.119), also after the LLM's release, and event types agree with the issuers' 8-K filings (AUC 0.833); Jev's judgments of news published after its own release track the reaction as well (descriptive). Exploratory analyses show where the association comes from: 72% of earnings news items appear after the issuer's filing, contributor-written items often report the price move, and from the first trade after publication the association falls to 0.023. At a weekly horizon, the confirmatory test detects no rank information over code-only features. Under attack, decision cards traced 88% of successful attacks to the planted item. We propose that market-graded tests of Web-text readers report the criterion from publication, not only from the event.

translation.title: 追踪还是跟随？当网络新闻滞后于市场时的 Jev 兼容多智能体交易系统
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体越来越多地依据其阅读的网络新闻进行交易，但许多关于上市公司的网络新闻是在其报道的价格变动之后发布的，且是关于该价格变动的，因此读者可以通过跟随市场而非阅读事件来与市场一致。我们提出疑问：LLM 对网络新闻的判断是追踪市场对所报道事件的反应，还是跟随它？为回答这一问题，我们构建了一个多智能体交易系统，其智能体仅共享时点数据存储，并通过 Jev（一个托管的有类型决策模型）的接口回答有类型的问题；代码在文本对仓位可能影响程度的已证明上界之下设置每个仓位。在一个哈希提交的测试中，一个由固定 LLM 期权概率构建的 Jev 兼容阅读器的逐条判断追踪了公告窗口异常收益（周度 Spearman 0.119），在 LLM 发布之后亦然，且事件类型与发行方 8-K 备案一致（AUC 0.833）；Jev 对其自身发布之后发布的新闻的判断同样追踪了反应（描述性）。探索性分析显示这种关联的来源：72% 的财报新闻出现在发行方备案之后，贡献者撰写的条目常常报道价格变动，且从发布后第一笔交易开始关联降至 0.023。在周度视野下，验证性测试未检测到超越纯代码特征的排名信息。在攻击下，决策卡片将 88% 的成功攻击追溯到了被植入的条目。我们建议市场分级测试的网络文本阅读器报告从发布起而非仅从事件起的标准。
translation.brief: 该工作构建一个基于 Jev 有类型决策模型的多智能体交易系统，检验 LLM 对网络新闻的判断究竟是追踪事件本身还是跟随市场已发生的反应。

papers.title: Beyond Query Similarity: Safety-Conditioned Cache Routing for LLM Response Reuse
papers.abstract: Semantic response caching reuses a cached response for a semantically similar query to improve LLM inference efficiency. However, query similarity alone can lead to unsafe reuse when safety conditions change. Existing approaches improve cache safety through stricter similarity checks, context-aware validation, or response verification, yet they may still miss safety conflicts between the cached response and the new request or introduce unnecessary verification overhead. We argue that safe and efficient semantic caching requires a reuse policy that makes the cached response's safety conditions explicit and uses them to guide the reuse decision with a balance between safety and utility. In this paper, we propose SafeCache, a safety-aware framework that separates candidate retrieval from safety approval and formulates semantic response reuse as a safety-conditioned routing problem. SafeCache matches each cached-response condition against the new request and aggregates the per-condition mismatches into an overall risk score. A separate contradiction guard prevents explicit conflicts from being diluted by strong matches. It further estimates matching uncertainty and calibrates the routing policy under a required unsafe-reuse target and a verifier-call budget to choose among direct reuse, selective verification, or regeneration. Experiments show that SafeCache achieves the better safety-utility trade-off among the evaluated baselines, enabling safer response reuse at comparable cache utility.

translation.title: 超越查询相似性：面向 LLM 响应复用的安全条件缓存路由
translation.abstract: 语义响应缓存通过为语义相似的查询复用缓存的响应来提高 LLM 推理效率。然而，仅依靠查询相似性在安全条件变化时可能导致不安全的复用。现有方法通过更严格的相似性检查、上下文感知验证或响应验证来提高缓存安全性，但仍可能遗漏缓存响应与新请求之间的安全冲突，或引入不必要的验证开销。我们认为，安全高效的语义缓存需要一个复用策略，该策略显式化缓存响应的安全条件，并用它们在安全与效用之间取得平衡来指导复用决策。本文提出 SafeCache，一个安全感知框架，将候选检索与安全审批分离，并将语义响应复用形式化为一个安全条件的路由问题。SafeCache 将每个缓存响应条件与新请求匹配，并将逐条件的不匹配聚合为总体风险分数。独立的矛盾守卫防止显式冲突被强匹配稀释。它进一步估计匹配不确定性，并在要求的复用不安全目标与验证器调用预算下校准路由策略，在直接复用、选择性验证或重新生成之间做出选择。实验表明，SafeCache 在所评测基线中取得了更优的安全-效用权衡，在相当的缓存效用下实现更安全的响应复用。
translation.brief: 该框架将语义响应复用形式化为安全条件路由问题，通过条件匹配、风险聚合与矛盾守卫在安全与效用间校准复用决策。

papers.title: Deploying Physically and Epistemically Compliant Agents by Distilling Belief-Space Task and Motion Planners
papers.abstract: In this work, we train agents to act under uncertainty according to specified, belief-dependent rules. Deep reinforcement learning (RL) can in theory train agents to follow rules if encoded into well-designed rewards, but in practice, RL fails to perfectly optimize these rewards, leading to ineffective or noncompliant agent behavior. Belief-space planners by construction produce behavior in line with developer specification, but require hand-programming online planners and belief-state estimators, adding significant engineering complexity at scale. We combine the two: we plan offline to generate a dataset of sample trajectories and then distill the plans into a policy that acts on raw observations. We propose two changes to planner distillation that address problems specific to history-based policies: Dual Averaging, a loss that combines per-timestep predictive loss and average loss on task changes, and $ρ$-Optimal Reinforcement, a feedback mechanism that reinforces the policy's own successful rollouts when these are near-optimal. We provide a sufficient condition under which static search problems with noiseless observation models is complete, and show that maximum-likelihood-observation planning implies this condition in static search with continuous beliefs. We create a challenging new domain, Scavenger, where an agent needs to gain information in order to succeed. We evaluate our distilled policy in two versions of Scavenger, one where information is provided visually and one where it is provided as a command in natural language. In either case, the learned policy attains a success rate above 90% in Scavenger, compared with at most 5% for RL. We also find that distilled planners transfer with greater than 60% success to following unseen and intentionally vague commands and greater than 75% success to following floorplans larger than those seen in training.

translation.title: 通过蒸馏信念空间任务与运动规划器部署满足物理与认知规范的智能体
translation.abstract: 本工作训练智能体在不确定性下依据指定的、依赖信念的规则行动。深度强化学习（RL）理论上可以通过精心设计的奖励来训练智能体遵循规则，但实践中RL无法完美优化这些奖励，导致智能体行为无效或不合规。信念空间规划器在结构上产生的行为符合开发者规范，但需要手工编写在线规划器和信念状态估计器，在大规模应用中带来显著的工程复杂性。我们将两者结合：先离线规划生成样例轨迹数据集，再将规划蒸馏为直接作用于原始观测的策略。我们针对基于历史的策略特有的问题提出两项规划蒸馏改进：Dual Averaging，一种结合每时间步预测损失与任务变更平均损失的损失函数；以及 $ρ$-Optimal Reinforcement，一种在策略自身成功且接近最优的 rollout 上进行强化反馈的机制。我们给出了带无噪声观测模型的静态搜索问题在该条件下完备的充分条件，并证明在连续信念的静态搜索中最大似然观测规划蕴含该条件。我们创建了一个具有挑战性的新领域 Scavenger，其中智能体需要获取信息才能成功。我们在两个版本的 Scavenger 上评估蒸馏策略：一个版本中信息以视觉方式提供，另一个版本中以自然语言命令提供。两种情况下，学习到的策略在 Scavenger 中的成功率均超过90%，而RL最多仅为5%。我们还发现蒸馏后的规划器在遵循未见过的、故意含糊的命令上取得超过60%的成功率，在遵循大于训练时见过的楼层平面图上取得超过75%的成功率。
translation.brief: 针对RL难以严格遵循依赖信念的行为规范、而信念空间规划器工程复杂的问题，采用离线规划加策略蒸馏（含Dual Averaging损失与ρ-Optimal Reinforcement）训练智能体。

papers.title: HexIt: Learning Hexahedral Block Decomposition with Expert Iteration on Combinatorial Maps
papers.abstract: Decomposing a polyhedral solid into a few well-shaped hexahedral blocks is a long-standing open problem in mesh generation. We cast it as a sequential decision problem on a 3-dimensional generalised map: an agent splits edges, faces and volumes with three insert operations until every cell is a hexahedron and the mesh passes a quality threshold, and a policy that convolves over the map's involutions chooses each insert. A successful decomposition takes over a hundred decisions, and a uniformly random policy never finds one. We clone a policy from constructed decompositions and improve it by expert iteration. On held-out chamfered solids that share no boundary topology with the cloning data, the final policy solves an expected $94.4\%$ in $20$ samples, and expert iteration raises the best-of-20 solve rate on large chamfered solids from $0.203$ to $0.355$. At matched compute, PPO, GRPO and VinePPO updates all make the cloned policy worse.

translation.title: HexIt：基于组合映射与专家迭代学习六面体块分解
translation.abstract: 将多面体实体分解为少量形状良好的六面体块是网格生成中长期悬而未决的问题。我们将其形式化为三维广义映射（generalised map）上的序贯决策问题：智能体通过三种插入操作分割边、面和体，直到每个单元都是六面体且网格通过质量阈值，策略通过对映射的对合（involutions）进行卷积来选择每次插入操作。一次成功的分解需要超过一百个决策，均匀随机策略永远找不到成功分解。我们从构造的分解中克隆策略，并通过专家迭代加以改进。在与克隆数据无共享边界拓扑的保留切角实体上，最终策略在20个采样内期望解决94.4%的问题；专家迭代将大切角实体上 best-of-20 求解率从0.203提升至0.355。在相同计算量下，PPO、GRPO 和 VinePPO 的更新都会使克隆策略变差。
translation.brief: 针对多面体六面体块分解难题，将其建模为组合映射上的序贯决策过程，用行为克隆加专家迭代训练策略求解。

papers.title: Who Remembers What? Multi-Granularity Memory Extraction for Multi-User, Multi-Agent Interaction
papers.abstract: Self-evolving agents improve their own skills, memory, and harness code from experience without retraining the base LLM, and group-evolving agents go further by sharing these lessons across agents. Yet most such systems overlook that sharing across users and heterogeneous agents requires deciding who can benefit from each lesson and what information must remain private. We present MixUA, a memory system that distills independent user-agent trajectories into lessons and assigns each lesson to a user-agent pair, user, agent, or global scope according to whom it benefits and what it may disclose. For evaluation, we introduce CrossLearnBench, a mixed-user-agent benchmark that pairs established agent tasks with user preferences and privacy probes that test whether private facts leak into memory other users can read. With five users and seven agents, MixUA raises pass rates by up to 16 points over no memory and 5 over a single global memory, even on tasks previously tried only by other users on other agents. It retains up to 90% of previously stated preferences, and at most 0.02% of privacy probes find a planted private fact in a forbidden scope. We hope MixUA offers a scalable path toward a global system where users and agents co-evolve.

translation.title: 谁记得什么？面向多用户多智能体交互的多粒度记忆提取
translation.abstract: 自进化智能体无需重训基座LLM即可从经验中改进自身技能、记忆与工具代码，群体进化智能体更进一步地在智能体间共享经验。然而大多数此类系统忽视了跨用户与异构智能体的共享需要决定谁能从每条经验中受益、哪些信息必须保持私密。我们提出 MixUA，一个将独立的用户-智能体轨迹蒸馏为经验教训，并根据受益对象与可能泄露的信息将其分配到用户-智能体对、用户、智能体或全局范围的记忆系统。为进行评估，我们引入 CrossLearnBench，一个混合用户-智能体基准，将成熟的智能体任务与用户偏好及隐私探针配对，测试私密事实是否会泄露到其他用户可读的记忆中。在五名用户与七个智能体的设置下，MixUA 相比无记忆最多提升16个百分点的通过率，相比单一全局记忆提升5个百分点，即使是在此前仅由其他用户在其他智能体上尝试过的任务上也如此。它保留多达90%的先前陈述偏好，且隐私探针中最多仅0.02%在禁止范围内发现植入的私密事实。我们希望 MixUA 为用户与智能体共同进化的全局系统提供一条可扩展的路径。
translation.brief: 针对多用户多智能体共享记忆时的受益归属与隐私保护问题，提出按用户/智能体/全局等多粒度范围提取并分配经验教训的记忆系统 MixUA。

papers.title: DiSARM: Diverse and Surprising Association Rule Mining with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) aims to discover informative patterns in large datasets. For transactional data, Association Rule Mining (ARM) is an established approach that facilitates EDA by efficiently generating candidate patterns. Beyond efficient mining, identifying informative rules has also been extensively studied through both objective and subjective interestingness measures. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new opportunities for assessing subjective interestingness using world knowledge. Nevertheless, relying solely on LLMs raises concerns about scalability and statistical reliability. Building on prior ARM research, we propose a hybrid framework, DiSARM, that leverages the world knowledge of LLMs to assess the subjective interestingness of rules, while maintaining statistical reliability and promoting diversity among the selected rules. Across three transactional datasets, experiments demonstrate that DiSARM effectively combines statistical reliability with surprise and diversity, offering a promising approach to ADE from transactional data.

translation.title: DiSARM：利用大语言模型进行多样且出人意料的关联规则挖掘
translation.abstract: 探索性数据分析（EDA）旨在从大型数据集中发现有信息量的模式。对于交易型数据，关联规则挖掘（ARM）是一种成熟方法，通过高效生成候选模式来辅助EDA。除了高效挖掘之外，识别有信息量的规则也已通过客观与主观趣味性度量得到广泛研究。大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展为利用世界知识评估主观趣味性提供了新机会。然而，仅依赖LLM引发了可扩展性与统计可靠性方面的担忧。在先前ARM研究基础上，我们提出混合框架 DiSARM，利用LLM的世界知识评估规则的主观趣味性，同时保持统计可靠性并促进所选规则间的多样性。在三个交易数据集上的实验表明，DiSARM 有效地结合了统计可靠性与意外性和多样性，为交易数据的EDA提供了一条有前景的途径。
translation.brief: 针对关联规则挖掘中主观趣味性评估问题，提出用LLM世界知识与统计可靠性约束相结合的混合框架筛选多样且出人意料的规则。

papers.title: The Truth Beneath the Tokens: Prompt-Space Recovery of Knowledge Edits in Language Models
papers.abstract: Model editing provides an efficient way to update factual knowledge in transformer models. Recent approaches reverse edits by modifying, masking, or decomposing model weights, but make recovery dependent on weight-space interventions. We instead show that pre-edit knowledge can be recovered through input-space interventions alone, without modifying the edited model's weights. We introduce Memento, a prompt-space mechanism for auditing residual knowledge that learns a reusable recovery signal to steer an edited model toward its pre-edit response. Memento supports both continuous recovery prefixes and discrete textual prompts for standard text interfaces. Across three LLMs and five editing techniques, Memento recovers 80.07% of held-out edited facts, achieving a 9.58% relative improvement over baselines, suggesting that editing may suppress the facts without fully eliminating their recoverability. We further investigate whether prompt-space recovery extends beyond model editing. On pristine, unedited LLMs, Memento improves average factual recall by 53.9% relative to standard inference. These results demonstrate the potential of prompt-space recovery for auditing residual knowledge in edited models and investigating the gap between factual knowledge and its accessibility during inference. We will release our source code.

translation.title: 词元之下的真相：语言模型中知识编辑的提示空间恢复
translation.abstract: 模型编辑为更新 transformer 模型中的事实知识提供了高效方式。近期方法通过修改、掩码或分解模型权重来逆转编辑，但恢复依赖于权重空间干预。我们转而证明，仅通过输入空间干预即可恢复编辑前的知识，无需修改编辑后模型的权重。我们提出 Memento，一种用于审计残留知识的提示空间机制，它学习一个可复用的恢复信号，将编辑后的模型引导回其编辑前的响应。Memento 同时支持连续恢复前缀和用于标准文本接口的离散文本提示。在三个LLM和五种编辑技术上，Memento 恢复了80.07%的保留编辑事实，相对基线提升9.58%，表明编辑可能压制了事实但并未完全消除其可恢复性。我们进一步研究提示空间恢复是否超越模型编辑范畴。在未编辑的原始LLM上，Memento 相对标准推理将平均事实召回提升53.9%。这些结果展示了提示空间恢复在审计编辑后模型残留知识、研究事实知识与推理时可达性之间差距方面的潜力。我们将发布源代码。
translation.brief: 针对如何在不改动权重的情况下恢复被编辑模型所压制知识的问题，提出通过学习提示空间恢复信号（Memento）实现知识回溯与审计。

papers.title: BunshinRL: Splitting Live Agent Workspaces for Memory-Efficient Agentic RL
papers.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) rollouts interleave model reasoning with tool calls in persistent workspaces. Scaling these rollouts incurs substantial memory costs for concurrent environments, while slow tool calls delay entire rollout batches. We present BunshinRL, an agentic RL rollout system that exploits shared environment state and recurring tool calls through three techniques: memory sharing across environments, tool-prefix caching, and speculative tool execution. These techniques build on BunshinFork, a novel live whole-workspace forking mechanism for containers. BunshinFork reconstructs process trees, shares memory copy-on-write, and preserves file, communication, and GUI state, enabling cached-state reuse and rollback after incorrect speculation. We implement BunshinRL and BunshinFork through Linux kernel module and CRIU modifications. BunshinRL reduces peak memory by up to 43%, total memory consumption by up to 51%, and end-to-end rollout latency by 23%.

translation.title: BunshinRL：切分实时智能体工作区以实现内存高效的 Agentic RL
translation.abstract: Agentic 强化学习（RL）rollout 在持久工作区中交替进行模型推理与工具调用。扩展这些 rollout 会带来并发环境的巨大内存开销，而缓慢的工具调用会拖慢整批 rollout。我们提出 BunshinRL，一种通过三项技术利用共享环境状态和重复性工具调用的 agentic RL rollout 系统：跨环境内存共享、工具前缀缓存和投机性工具执行。这些技术构建在 BunshinFork 之上，这是一种面向容器的新型实时整个工作区分叉机制。BunshinFork 重构进程树、以写时复制方式共享内存，并保留文件、通信和 GUI 状态，从而支持缓存状态复用以及错误投机后的回滚。我们通过 Linux 内核模块和 CRIU 修改实现了 BunshinRL 与 BunshinFork。BunshinRL 将峰值内存最多降低 43%，总内存消耗最多降低 51%，端到端 rollout 延迟降低 23%。
translation.brief: 解决 agentic RL rollout 中并发环境内存开销大和工具调用拖慢批次的问题，通过工作区实时分叉实现内存共享、工具前缀缓存和投机执行。

papers.title: Represented but Not Used: Value-Policy Dissociation in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents need to choose actions whose consequences unfold over multiple future steps, yet poor decisions do not reveal whether the model failed to represent those consequences or failed to use them. Mechanistic interpretability has studied internal representations of environment state and plans, but sequential decision making also requires evaluating how candidate actions change future outcomes. Reinforcement learning formalizes this as action value. We study this computation in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, and GPT-OSS-20B across a partially observed Grid environment and WebShop, a simulated web shopping environment. We find that the relative values of candidate actions are linearly decodable from intermediate hidden states, including at states where the policy prefers a worse action. We call this gap between value representation and policy choice value-policy dissociation. To investigate how represented value relates to action selection, we compare direct interventions along the value readout direction with Natural Value Transport (NVT), a transformation learned from hidden state changes that naturally result from differences in action value. While readout-direction interventions have limited and inconsistent effects, NVT more consistently influences action preferences, particularly at later layers. We also test a closed-loop controller that uses the value readout as a sensor and NVT as an actuator, observing improvements in task outcomes. These results suggest that LLM agents can represent useful prospective value without reliably translating it into policy choice.

translation.title: 表征了却未使用：LLM 智能体中的价值-策略分离
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体需要选择其后果会在未来多个步骤中展开的动作，但糟糕的决策无法揭示模型是未能表征这些后果，还是未能使用它们。机制可解释性研究已探索了环境状态和计划的内部表征，但序贯决策还需要评估候选动作如何改变未来结果。强化学习将其形式化为动作价值。我们在部分可观测的 Grid 环境和模拟网络购物环境 WebShop 上，研究 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 和 GPT-OSS-20B 中的这一计算过程。我们发现候选动作的相对价值可以从中间隐藏状态中线性解码出来，包括在策略偏好更差动作的状态下也是如此。我们将价值表征与策略选择之间的这种差距称为价值-策略分离。为探究被表征的价值与动作选择之间的关系，我们沿价值读出方向进行直接干预，并将其与 Natural Value Transport（NVT）进行比较——NVT 是从动作价值差异自然引起的隐藏状态变化中学到的变换。读出方向干预的效果有限且不一致，而 NVT 更能持续影响动作偏好，尤其是在较深的层。我们还测试了一个将价值读出作为传感器、NVT 作为执行器的闭环控制器，观察到任务结果的提升。这些结果表明，LLM 智能体可以表征有用的前瞻价值，却无法可靠地将其转化为策略选择。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 智能体是否真正使用了内部表征的动作价值，通过隐藏状态分析提出并验证一种价值-策略分离现象，并用 Natural Value Transport 干预来影响动作选择。

papers.title: LongCapHarness: Capability-Guided Auto-Harnessing for Long-Context Reasoning
papers.abstract: Existing methods enhancing an LLM's long-context reasoning capability often rely on data synthesis and follow-up LLM post-training. However, the data synthesis strategy and the post-training recipes are empirically driven and computationally intensive. In this work, we propose a new framework, dubbed LongCapHarness, to instead harness the underlying capabilities for long-context reasoning. The harnessing process recursively revises and updates capability primitive implementation, capability state and control logic through recursive self-improvement on the development set. With neither data synthesis nor LLM post-training, LongCapHarness is applied to Llama3-8B and transferred to Qwen2.5-3B. LongCapHarness substantially outperforms recent data-synthesis-based baselines on HELMET and RULER benchmarks; its estimated development cost is less than 50% of the estimated training costs of NExtLong and PolicyLong. We hope these results motivate further research into harnessing the latent capabilities of LLMs to solve tasks beyond their explicit training.

translation.title: LongCapHarness：面向长上下文推理的能力引导式自动 Harness 构建
translation.abstract: 现有增强 LLM 长上下文推理能力的方法通常依赖数据合成和后续的 LLM 后训练。然而，数据合成策略和后训练方案都是经验驱动且计算密集的。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个名为 LongCapHarness 的新框架，转而引导（harness）长上下文推理的底层能力。该引导过程通过在开发集上的递归自我改进，递归地修订和更新能力原语实现、能力状态和控制逻辑。在不使用数据合成和 LLM 后训练的情况下，LongCapHarness 应用于 Llama3-8B 并迁移到 Qwen2.5-3B。LongCapHarness 在 HELMET 和 RULER 基准上大幅超越近期基于数据合成的基线；其估计开发成本不到 NExtLong 和 PolicyLong 估计训练成本的 50%。我们希望这些结果能激发更多研究，去引导 LLM 的潜在能力以解决超出其显式训练范围的任务。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 长上下文推理依赖昂贵数据合成与后训练的问题，通过递归自我改进自动构建能力 harness 而无需训练。

papers.title: Hibana: Fast Agentic Inference on Unified-Memory Devices
papers.abstract: Local AI promises capable personal assistants that run on users' own devices, keeping data and computation under their control. Open-weight models that fit on local devices can now handle practical tasks such as coding. Yet current inference engines fall short. Popular engines such as vLLM and SGLang target datacenter GPUs with dedicated host memory, while local engines underuse the memory hierarchy of unified-memory devices. We present Hibana, an inference engine for unified-memory devices that co-optimizes model representation, memory management, and decoding strategy. Model surgery, the process of editing a trained model's architecture to suit its hardware, changes how the model computes, shrinking its memory footprint and data movement. Unified-memory management preserves each agent's state across turns, so long-running agents can resume instantly instead of recomputing their state. Adaptive speculation generates several tokens per step. Hibana codesigns these features around the shared memory capacity and limited bandwidth of unified-memory systems-on-chip to support local multi-agent workloads. On a single DGX Spark serving Qwen and Nemotron models of up to 125B parameters, Hibana completes up to 3.4$\times$ more agentic tasks per hour and delivers up to 3.9$\times$ higher decoding throughput than other established frameworks such as vLLM, NVIDIA Flare, llama.cpp, and TensorFold. Code is available at https://github.com/sharar-project/hibana.

translation.title: Hibana：统一内存设备上的快速 Agentic 推理
translation.abstract: 本地 AI 承诺在用户自己的设备上运行强大的个人助理，将数据和计算留在用户掌控之中。能装进本地设备的开放权重模型如今已能处理编码等实际任务，但现有推理引擎仍有不足。vLLM 和 SGLang 等流行引擎面向配有专用主机内存的数据中心 GPU，而本地引擎则未能充分利用统一内存设备的内存层次结构。我们提出 Hibana，一种面向统一内存设备的推理引擎，共同优化模型表示、内存管理和解码策略。模型手术（model surgery，即修改训练好的模型架构以适配硬件）改变模型的计算方式，缩小其内存占用和数据搬运量。统一内存管理跨轮次保留每个智能体的状态，使长时间运行的智能体可以即时恢复而无需重算状态。自适应投机每步生成多个 token。Hibana 围绕统一内存片上系统有限的共享内存容量和带宽对这些特性进行协同设计，以支持本地多智能体工作负载。在单台 DGX Spark 上服务最多 125B 参数的 Qwen 和 Nemotron 模型时，Hibana 每小时完成的 agentic 任务数最多提升 3.4 倍，解码吞吐量相比 vLLM、NVIDIA Flare、llama.cpp 和 TensorFold 等成熟框架最高提升 3.9 倍。代码见 https://github.com/sharar-project/hibana。
translation.brief: 解决统一内存设备上本地 agentic 推理低效的问题，通过模型手术、统一内存管理和自适应投机解码进行协同设计。

papers.title: WordEval: Evaluating Word-Native Operation Fidelity in Document Editing
papers.abstract: Microsoft Word is a central environment for office automation, and the faithful execution of its editing operations is an important capability for document agents. Unlike plain-text editing, editing in Word modifies a structured object model, where the requested effect is realized in object properties. Existing benchmarks, however, evaluate office workflows or desktop automation, treating word-processor documents as one task domain among many and verifying outcomes with keyword matching, per-task property checks, or screenshot comparison. We introduce WordEval, an operation-fidelity benchmark that instead centers evaluation on Word editing operations, testing whether each requested edit is realized as intended changes to Word objects and properties. It contains 642 cases across 15 Word feature areas, ranging from text and lists to charts, shape geometry, and SmartArt. 546 atomic cases cover 231 commands, 96 compositional cases combine multiple edits in a single document, and a Word-native oracle checks task-specific object properties and preservation conditions. Cases are constructed from editing-unit specifications, yielding controlled input documents, reference documents, and aligned oracle checks. Each compositional case is linked to corresponding atomic cases, supporting fine-grained diagnosis of editing failures. We evaluate eight agent systems and find that many struggle on the Atomic track, with performance varying across feature areas. Moreover, every system scores lower on Compositional than on Atomic, with gaps that vary substantially by system. Exact atomic-intent links and recorded failure diagnoses provide complementary views of this variation.

translation.title: WordEval：文档编辑中 Word 原生操作保真度的评测
translation.abstract: Microsoft Word 是办公自动化的核心环境，忠实执行其编辑操作是文档智能体的一项重要能力。与纯文本编辑不同，Word 编辑会修改结构化的对象模型，所请求的效果在对象属性中实现。然而现有基准评测的是办公流程或桌面自动化，把文字处理文档视为众多任务域之一，并通过关键词匹配、逐任务属性检查或截图对比来验证结果。我们提出 WordEval，一个以 Word 编辑操作为评测核心的操作保真度基准，测试每个被请求的编辑是否如预期般实现对 Word 对象和属性的更改。它包含横跨 15 个 Word 功能领域的 642 个用例，从文本和列表到图表、形状几何和 SmartArt。其中 546 个原子用例覆盖 231 条命令，96 个组合用例在单个文档中组合多次编辑，并由一个 Word 原生 oracle 检查任务特定的对象属性和保持条件。用例由编辑单元规范构造，产生可控的输入文档、参考文档和对齐的 oracle 检查。每个组合用例都与相应的原子用例关联，支持对编辑失败的细粒度诊断。我们评测了八个智能体系统，发现许多系统在 Atomic 赛道上表现挣扎，且性能因功能领域而异。此外，所有系统在 Compositional 赛道上的得分都低于 Atomic 赛道，差距因系统而显著不同。精确的原子意图链接和记录的失败诊断为这种差异提供了互补的视角。
translation.brief: 解决现有基准无法精细评测 Word 文档编辑操作保真度的问题，构建包含原子与组合用例及 Word 原生 oracle 的操作级评测基准。

papers.title: PatternBloom: Empowering Agentic RAG with Externalized RL-Distilled Graph Patterns
papers.abstract: Reinforcement-learning-trained agents for retrieval-augmented generation retrieve content (passages, knowledge-graph fragments, or hyperedges) and supervise training with outcome rewards on the final answer. Across these paradigms the reasoning route through retrieved content never leaves the language model's hidden state, conflating declarative knowledge with the procedural knowledge that recurs across queries of the same logical type; content-only methods consequently plateau as reasoning depth grows. We introduce PatternBloom, an agentic RAG framework that shifts the unit of retrieval from content (what to read) to logic (how to reason). A first RL stage scores the agent's constructed evidence graph by a frozen oracle's information gain through the Information-Density Reward (IDR), a size-normalized mutual-information surrogate. High-reward trajectories are distilled into a Graph Pattern Memory (GPM) of type-abstracted reasoning skeletons, and a second RL stage uses the Pattern-Augmented Reward (PAR) to couple policy to memory, turning procedural reasoning into a learnable, externalized structural prior. A 7B PatternBloom outperforms $27$ baselines by $+15.0$ Avg-OOD EM, with the gain compounding with reasoning depth precisely because procedural knowledge, once distilled, is reused rather than re-derived at every query. We release our code at https://github.com/EllenYiGe/PatternBloom.

translation.title: PatternBloom：用外部化的RL蒸馏图模式赋能智能体RAG
translation.abstract: 经强化学习训练的检索增强生成智能体检索内容（段落、知识图谱片段或超边），并以最终答案的结果奖励监督训练。在这些范式中，穿过检索内容的推理路径从未离开语言模型的隐状态，将陈述性知识与跨同一逻辑类型查询反复出现的程序性知识混为一谈；因此随着推理深度增长，纯内容方法会达到瓶颈。我们提出PatternBloom，一个将检索单元从内容（读什么）转移到逻辑（如何推理）的智能体RAG框架。第一阶段RL通过信息密度奖励（IDR，一种尺寸归一化的互信息替代量）用冻结oracle的信息增益为智能体构建的证据图评分。高奖励轨迹被蒸馏为类型抽象的推理骨架组成的图模式记忆（GPM），第二阶段RL使用模式增强奖励（PAR）将策略与记忆耦合，把程序性推理变成可学习、可外部化的结构先验。7B的PatternBloom以+15.0 Avg-OOD EM超越27个基线，且增益随推理深度复合增长，正因为程序性知识一旦蒸馏即可复用而非在每次查询中重新推导。代码发布于https://github.com/EllenYiGe/PatternBloom。
translation.brief: 解决agentic RAG中程序性推理知识未被外部化导致深层推理瓶颈的问题，通过两阶段RL先蒸馏证据图为推理模式记忆、再用模式奖励将策略与记忆耦合。

papers.title: On Real Eventual Exponential Positive property of complex-valued Laplacians and their pseudoinverses
papers.abstract: The property of real eventual exponential positivity guarantees the state trajectories of a linear time-invariant system to evolve asymptotically to right half of the complex-plane [1]. It has applications in the characterization of herdability and reachability of states in networked systems. Networks with complex-valued edge-weights arise in AC power systems and opinion dynamics. Recent work has introduced real eventual exponential positive (rEEP) Laplacians, for which the trajectories of the associated network flow eventually converge to consensus. We establish further properties of rEEP Laplacians and their pseudoinverses. Firstly, we show that the rEEP property for complex-valued matrices exhibits invariance under specific rotational transformations. Secondly, we establish that the property of rEEP is preserved under the MoorePenrose pseudoinverse operation, highlighting its robustness under algebraic manipulations. These results apply to effective impedance computation in AC networks and to consensus in multi-agent systems. Finally, we provide numerical examples to validate our theoretical results.

translation.title: 论复值Laplacian及其伪逆的实终指数正性
translation.abstract: 实终指数正性保证线性时不变系统的状态轨迹渐近演化到复平面右半部分，在网络化系统的可牧性和状态可达性刻画中有应用。具有复值边权重的网络出现在交流电力系统和观点动力学中。近期工作引入了实终指数正（rEEP）Laplacian，其相关网络流的轨迹最终收敛到共识。我们建立了rEEP Laplacian及其伪逆的进一步性质：首先，证明复值矩阵的rEEP性质在特定旋转变换下具有不变性；其次，证明rEEP性质在Moore-Penrose伪逆运算下得以保持，凸显其在代数操作下的稳健性。这些结果适用于AC网络的有效阻抗计算和多智能体系统的共识问题。最后我们给出数值算例验证理论结果。
translation.brief: 研究复值rEEP Laplacian矩阵的性质，证明其在旋转变换下的不变性以及在Moore-Penrose伪逆运算下的保持性。

papers.title: Sampling Is Not Curiosity: Why LLM Agents Should Investigate
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended tasks, very common in research scenarios where they are required to explore, investigate, or act curiously. At inference time, an LLM is a fixed map from context to next-token distribution, the pretrained weights determine the function, and only its conditioning changes as context accumulates. Mechanisms like temperature, best-of-N, tree search, or RAG vary how the distribution is sampled or what it is conditioned on, but do not update the agent's model of the environment. We argue that current LLM agents do not explore curiously; they explore stochastically. From how curiosity is understood in the RL literature, it requires a predictive structure over how the environment responds to the agent's actions, which improves online from current interaction, drives action selection through its predicted improvement, and persists beyond the context window. Additionally, in its open-ended form, the agent should intrinsically originate what to investigate. Thus, we propose a framework defining curiosity in LLM agents, reserving the term for systems that satisfy it. In doing so, we identify the research directions its implementation opens up.

translation.title: 采样不是好奇：为何LLM智能体应当去调查
translation.abstract: LLM智能体越来越多地用于开放式任务，这在研究场景中很常见，要求其探索、调查或表现出好奇心。在推理时，LLM是一个从上下文到下一词分布的固定映射，预训练权重决定该函数，只有条件随上下文积累而变化。温度、best-of-N、树搜索或RAG等机制只是改变分布的采样方式或条件，并不更新智能体对环境的模型。我们论证当前LLM智能体并非好奇地探索，而是随机地探索。根据RL文献中对好奇心的理解，好奇心需要对环境如何响应智能体动作的预测结构，该结构从当前交互中在线改进，通过预测的改进驱动动作选择，并超越上下文窗口持续存在。此外，在开放式形式中，智能体应内在地自主决定调查什么。因此，我们提出一个定义LLM智能体好奇心的框架，将该术语保留给满足该框架的系统，并指出其实现所开启的研究方向。
translation.brief: 论证当前LLM智能体的探索只是随机采样而非真正好奇，提出一个基于预测环境模型、在线改进和自主发起调查的好奇心定义框架。

papers.title: Distinguishing Extraction Failures and Clinical Discordance with LLM Uncertainty on Radiology Reports
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can structure clinical datasets, but extraction error must be distinguished from discordance in the underlying data. From a real-world cohort of 1{,}045 patients undergoing coronary CT angiography (CCTA), we evaluated whether LLM uncertainty during vessel-level coronary artery disease (CAD) stenosis extraction could identify extraction failure and clinical discordance. References were expert CCTA annotations (253 patients) and subsequent invasive coronary angiography (ICA; 729 patients). We quantify extraction failure as disagreement between stenosis severity in LLM extracted versus expert annotations, and clinical discordance as disagreement in stenosis severity between CCTA and subsequent ICA. Stenosis Margin, selected from ten candidate measures, was used to quantify LLM uncertainty, and generalized estimating equation logistic regression and AUC evaluated its association and incremental discrimination for each failure mode. LLM uncertainty was strongly associated with extraction failure (adjusted OR 4.15 [95% CI 2.57--6.69], $P<0.001$) and substantially improved discrimination beyond LLM-extracted CCTA stenosis severity alone (AUC 0.81 to 0.86; $Δ$AUC $+0.06$ [$+0.03$, $+0.09$], $P=0.001$). In contrast, LLM uncertainty weakly associated with clinical discordance (adjusted OR 1.22 [1.04--1.43], Holm-adjusted $P=0.118$) but provided no incremental discrimination beyond LLM-extracted CCTA stenosis severity ($Δ$AUC $+0.01$ [$-0.00$, $+0.02$], $P=0.245$). Moreover, extraction errors and clinical discordance showed little overlap, with 38 of 42 clinically discordant vessels (90%) having been extracted correctly. LLM uncertainty may identify extraction failures without identifying underlying clinical discordance, supporting failure attribution when evaluating LLM-derived clinical datasets.

translation.title: 用LLM不确定性在放射学报告中区分抽取失败与临床不一致
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可结构化临床数据集，但必须将抽取错误与底层数据的不一致区分开。基于1045名接受冠状动脉CT血管造影（CCTA）的真实患者队列，我们评估血管级冠心病（CAD）狭窄抽取过程中的LLM不确定性能否识别抽取失败和临床不一致。参考标准为专家CCTA标注（253名患者）和后续有创冠脉造影（ICA；729名患者）。我们将抽取失败量化为LLM抽取与专家标注之间狭窄程度的分歧，将临床不一致量化为CCTA与后续ICA之间狭窄程度的分歧。从十个候选度量中选出Stenosis Margin来量化LLM不确定性，用广义估计方程logistic回归和AUC评估其关联与增量判别能力。LLM不确定性与抽取失败强相关（校正OR 4.15 [95% CI 2.57–6.69]，P<0.001），并在仅用LLM抽取的CCTA狭窄程度之外显著提升判别力（AUC 0.81到0.86；ΔAUC +0.06 [+0.03, +0.09]，P=0.001）。相比之下，LLM不确定性与临床不一致仅弱相关（校正OR 1.22 [1.04–1.43]，Holm校正P=0.118），且无增量判别力（ΔAUC +0.01 [-0.00, +0.02]，P=0.245）。此外，抽取错误与临床不一致几乎不重叠，42个临床不一致血管中有38个（90%）被正确抽取。LLM不确定性可识别抽取失败但不能识别底层临床不一致，支持在评估LLM衍生临床数据集时进行失败归因。
translation.brief: 研究LLM抽取冠脉狭窄时其不确定性度量能否区分抽取失败与真实临床不一致，通过真实队列上的不确定性指标（Stenosis Margin）与专家标注及ICA对比进行验证。

papers.title: Imperfectly Imperfect: Evaluating Graded Cognitive Diversity in LLM Persona Simulations
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used as synthetic participants in social, behavioural, and decision-making research, yet it remains unclear whether they can express graded cognitive diversity as assigned when engaging in simulated behaviour. We introduce a cognition-suite evaluation that tests whether simulated populations reproduce human variation in reasoning, self-reported traits, their associations, and downstream behaviour. Agents conditioned on synthetic or human-derived profiles of cognitive reflection, Need for Cognition, and Big Five personality answer the same suite as a cohort of 473 adults: two newly assembled tests, a Cognitive Reflection Test (CRT) and a Behavioural Reflection Test (BRT) whose decision scenarios measure reflection in behaviour, alongside an established CRT and the two trait questionnaires. Across seven full-battery simulation runs of four models, agents recover Need for Cognition and Big Five trait distributions on self-report questionnaires, but fall short on simulating diversity of cognitive task performance and downstream behaviours. In the four Claude Sonnet 4.6 runs, every agent scores full marks on both CRTs, whatever reflection level its persona was assigned. In the other three runs agents make intuitive-lure errors (the tempting wrong answers CRT items invite), but 49 to 85% score full marks, against under 10% in the human sample. Claude Sonnet 5 comes closest to people's item-by-item pattern of lures; the other two runs give fewer lures and vary less between items. In the BRT scenarios, every run over-produces 8 to 11 of 15 coded behaviours by at least 20 percentage points, and people's links between reflection and behaviour carry over only in part. Useful synthetic populations must preserve not only trait descriptors but the structured variation in reasoning, error type, and behaviour those descriptors are meant to organise.

translation.title: 不完美的不完美：评估LLM人格模拟中的分级认知多样性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益被用作社会、行为和决策研究中的合成被试，但尚不清楚它们在模拟行为中能否按要求表达分级的认知多样性。我们引入一套认知评估套件，检验模拟人群能否复现人类在推理、自陈特质、其关联及下游行为上的变异。以认知反思、认知需求（Need for Cognition）和大五人格的合成或人类衍生画像为条件的智能体，回答与473名成人队列相同的套件：两个新编测验——认知反思测验（CRT）和测量行为中反思的行为反思测验（BRT）——以及一个成熟的CRT和两个特质问卷。在四个模型的七次全套件模拟运行中，智能体能在自陈问卷上复现认知需求和大五人格特质分布，但在模拟认知任务表现和下游行为的多样性上表现不足。在四次Claude Sonnet 4.6运行中，无论其人格被分配何种反思水平，每个智能体都在两个CRT上得满分。在另外三次运行中，智能体会犯直觉诱饵错误（CRT题目诱人的错误答案），但49%到85%得满分，而人类样本中不足10%。Claude Sonnet 5最接近人类逐题的诱饵模式；另外两次运行诱饵更少且题间变异更小。在BRT情景中，每次运行对15个编码行为中的8到11个的超额产出至少20个百分点，人类反思与行为之间的联系仅部分延续。有用的合成人群不仅要保留特质描述，还要保留这些描述本应组织的推理、错误类型和行为的结构化变异。
translation.brief: 评估LLM人格模拟是否能再现被分配的分级认知差异，通过CRT/BRT测验套件与473名成人对照发现智能体可复现自陈特质但无法复现认知任务表现与行为的多样性。

papers.title: Mismeasuring the Life of a Line of Code: Lessons Learned the Hard Way
papers.abstract: Studies of how long lines of code live, including lines written by AI agents, rest on choices that look technical: when a line counts as gone, what to do with lines still alive, whether to pool projects, and how to evaluate a model. We studied 32.5 million line births in 120 TypeScript repositories and got several of these choices wrong at first. For ten of them, we compare the result as we first computed it, or as commonly done, with the result after correction. All ten change conclusions, or would have. Six were our own mistakes. Counting moved and rewritten lines as dead shortens a line's median life from 3.0 years to 1.3. Counting any change as a death hides an outcome that can be predicted: within-project concordance falls from 0.71 to 0.56. Regressing observed lifetimes discards three quarters of the lines. Keeping rewritten lines at risk makes protective effects grow with age. Lines are born and removed together, so treating them as independent misleads twice: nine of fifteen effects look significant only under that assumption, and a split by file makes a barely predictable outcome look good (within-project concordance 0.71 instead of 0.61). After the corrections, removal depends on a line's age and project, but our models could barely rank it within a project. Local revision they could rank (0.71). Obvious cases aside, the top 1% of a project's new lines are revised at 2.3 times the base rate. Each pitfall leaves a symptom; we give a checklist.

translation.title: 误测一行代码的生命周期：惨痛教训
translation.abstract: 关于代码行存活时间（包括 AI 智能体所写代码行）的研究依赖于许多看似技术性的选择：何时算一行代码“死亡”、如何处理仍然存活的行、是否合并多个项目、以及如何评估模型。我们研究了 120 个 TypeScript 仓库中 3250 万次代码行的诞生，最初在若干选择上犯了错。对于其中十个选择，我们将最初（或常见）做法的结果与修正后的结果进行对比。全部十个都会改变（或本会改变）结论，其中六个是我们自己的错误。将被移动和重写的代码行计为死亡，会把代码行中位寿命从 3.0 年缩短到 1.3 年；将任何改动都计为死亡，会掩盖一个本可预测的结果：项目内一致性从 0.71 降至 0.56。对观测到的寿命做回归会丢弃四分之三的代码行；保留被重写的行使其处于风险中，会让保护性效应随年龄增长。代码行的诞生和移除是同时发生的，把它们当作独立事件会带来双重误导：十五个效应中有九个只有在该假设下才显得显著，而按文件拆分会让一个几乎不可预测的结果看起来不错（项目内一致性为 0.71 而非 0.61）。修正之后，移除取决于代码行的年龄和项目，但我们的模型在项目内部几乎无法对其排序，而局部修改则可以排序（0.71）。除明显情况外，项目新增代码行中最高的 1% 以 2.3 倍的基础速率被修改。每个陷阱都会留下症状；我们给出了一份检查清单。
translation.brief: 研究代码行生命周期测量中十种常见方法论错误如何改变结论，并通过修正这些分析选择（如死亡定义、存活行处理、项目独立性假设）给出正确测度方法与检查清单。

papers.title: In Search of Lost Time: Temporal Competence in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Today's large language models (LLMs) increasingly interact with time: AI agents schedule tasks, coordinate with people and other AI systems, and even decide how long to think. Yet LLMs only ever encounter time secondhand---in descriptions rather than experience. Does this hinder their reasoning and decisions that involve time? Our paper traces this question from a model's knowledge to its actions through four successive evaluations. We find that models know the rules of time, which can be read, but struggle to predict durations, which must be lived; while they are highly accurate (92.0-97.5\%) on a collection of questions built from the theorems of various time-related literatures, they underestimate their own completion times by up to 99.5\% and fail to identify which tasks will take them longer to run. And while they are better at estimating durations of human tasks, their duration judgments change based on how an event is worded, magnifying similar human biases by up to 1.3$\times$. Moving from estimation to action, we find that some LLMs disregard time costs completely when answering user queries, ignoring a 1,200-fold increase in wait time entirely. Together, our experiments reveal new challenges posed to LLMs as they navigate a dimension they cannot directly perceive, and highlight how their blind spots can even be simple cognitive abilities that humans take for granted.

translation.title: 寻找失去的时间：大型语言模型的时间能力
translation.abstract: 如今的大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地与时间交互：AI 智能体安排任务、与人类和其他 AI 系统协调，甚至决定自己思考多久。然而 LLM 只能二手地接触时间——通过描述而非亲身体验。这是否会妨碍其涉及时间的推理和决策？我们的论文通过四项递进式评估，从模型的知识追踪到其行为。我们发现，模型知道可以“读到”的时间规则，却难以预测必须“经历”的时长：在各种时间相关文献定理构建的问题集上，它们准确率很高（92.0-97.5%），但会把自身完成时间低估至多 99.5%，且无法判断哪些任务会花更长时间。虽然它们更擅长估计人类任务的时长，但其时长判断会随事件的措辞而变化，将人类类似的偏差放大至多 1.3 倍。从估计转向行动，我们发现某些 LLM 在回答用户查询时完全无视时间成本，对 1200 倍的等待时间增幅全然忽略。我们的实验揭示了 LLM 在驾驭其无法直接感知的维度时面临的新挑战，并凸显其盲区甚至可能包括人类视为理所当然的简单认知能力。
translation.brief: 通过四层递进评估检验 LLM 从时间知识到时间决策的能力，发现其虽掌握时间规则却严重低估自身任务耗时且忽视时间成本。

papers.title: Close and Sort: Exact Maximum-Likelihood Aggregation of Cyclic Rank-Two Preferences
papers.abstract: Pairwise probabilities arise in rank aggregation, recommendation, and human or LLM evaluation, yet converting them into a maximum-likelihood list is a weighted Kemeny problem and is NP-hard in general. Known exact algorithms for rank-two tournaments use only comparison signs and do not optimize this likelihood. We show that the weighted problem is exactly solvable when the skew-symmetric log-odds matrix $W_{ij}=\log(p_{ij}/p_{ji})$ has rank two, including when the induced preferences contain cycles. Writing $W_{ij}=\det(h_i,h_j)$ and adding the closing vector $h_0=-\sum_i h_i$ turns the objective into twice the signed area of a closed polygon. This geometry yields CloseSort, which polar-sorts the $n+1$ edge vectors, cuts after $h_0$, and returns a global maximum-likelihood order in $O(n\log n)$ time from the factors. The same geometry identifies the runner-up and gives a stability certificate beyond exact rank two. When the smallest determinant $δ$ of two consecutive edges in the closed angular cycle is positive, it is exactly the best-to-runner-up log-likelihood gap. For $W=W_0+E$, the CloseSort order of $W_0$ has regret at most $\sum_{i<j}|E_{ij}|$ on $W$ and remains optimal whenever this sum is below $δ$, a worst-case tight threshold. In 5,120 determinant-logit simulations, increasing the observations per pair from 4 to 64 raises the fraction on which rank-two projection outperforms the empirical plug-in optimum from 68.6% to 85.7%. On 3,600 Arena-Hard LLM-judge profiles drawn from 63 systems and ten judges, the leading rank-two component captures 89.2% of the log-odds energy. On profiles containing a directed majority triangle, CloseSort reduces normalized regret by 44% relative to Borda and improves the mean normalized objective over each of eight baselines. With factors supplied, it is 8,407 times faster than exact dynamic programming on 18-item rankings.

translation.title: 闭合与排序：循环秩二偏好的精确最大似然聚合
translation.abstract: 成对概率出现在排名聚合、推荐以及人类或 LLM 评估中，但把它们转换为最大似然排序是一个加权 Kemeny 问题，一般情况下是 NP 难的。已知的秩二竞赛精确算法只使用比较符号，并不优化此似然。我们证明当反对称 log-odds 矩阵 $W_{ij}=\log(p_{ij}/p_{ji})$ 的秩为二时（包括诱导偏好含循环的情形），加权问题是精确可解的。将 $W_{ij}=\det(h_i,h_j)$ 写出并加入闭合向量 $h_0=-\sum_i h_i$，目标函数即变为一个闭合多边形有向面积的两倍。这一几何结构产生了 CloseSort：对 $n+1$ 条边向量做极角排序，在 $h_0$ 处切割，即可在 $O(n\log n)$ 时间内从因子得到全局最大似然排序。同一几何结构还能识别次优解，并在精确秩二之外给出稳定性证书。当闭合角环中相邻两条边的最小行列式 $δ$ 为正时，它恰好是最优与次优之间的对数似然差距。对于 $W=W_0+E$，$W_0$ 的 CloseSort 排序在 $W$ 上的遗憾至多为 $\sum_{i<j}|E_{ij}|$，且当该和低于 $δ$（一个最坏情形紧阈值）时仍保持最优。在 5120 次 determinant-logit 模拟中，将每对的观测次数从 4 增至 64，使秩二投影优于经验 plug-in 最优的比例从 68.6% 升至 85.7%。在取自 63 个系统和十位评委的 3600 个 Arena-Hard LLM 评委画像上，主秩二分量捕获了 89.2% 的 log-odds 能量。在含有有向多数三角形的画像上，CloseSort 相对 Borda 将归一化遗憾降低 44%，并在归一化目标均值上优于全部八个基线。给定因子时，它在 18 项排序上比精确动态规划快 8407 倍。
translation.brief: 针对含循环的成对偏好排名聚合这一 NP 难问题，利用秩二 log-odds 矩阵的多边形面积几何提出 O(n log n) 的精确最大似然算法 CloseSort。

papers.title: AFVE-Bench: Measuring Abandoned-Frame Verbalization Errors in Multi-Turn LLM Revision
papers.abstract: Multi-turn revision often asks a model to replace an earlier organizing frame while preserving still-valid facts and artifact requirements. Existing instruction-following evaluations mainly assess the latest target and may therefore score an artifact as successful even when it adopts the new frame but exposes the superseded one. We call this failure an abandoned-frame verbalization error (AFVE). AFVE-Bench evaluates silent frame replacement in English and Chinese using 192 matched four-turn dialogues across eight writing domains. Each seed has zero, one, or two pre-target user requests to generate under the source frame. AFVE eligibility depends on the user-request history and applies to the one- and two-request conditions; the zero-request condition serves as a frame-bearing baseline. Eleven model configurations yielded 4,224 expected post-target response units. Two annotators independently scored 4,204 scorable responses for target adoption, source-frame verbalization, and direct usability; model and condition metadata were hidden, and disagreements were adjudicated. AFVE occurs in 25.54% (715/2,799) of history-conditioned responses. Of 2,388 target-passing history-conditioned responses, 472 (19.77%) still expose the abandoned source frame, most often through contrastive framing (423/472). For these standalone revision tasks, target adoption does not ensure source-frame silence.

translation.title: AFVE-Bench：度量多轮 LLM 修订中的弃框言语化错误
translation.abstract: 多轮修订常常要求模型替换先前的组织框架，同时保留仍然有效的事实与产出物要求。现有指令遵循评估主要针对最新目标，因而即使产出物采纳了新框架却暴露出被弃用的旧框架，也可能被评为成功。我们将这种失败称为弃框言语化错误（AFVE）。AFVE-Bench 使用跨八个写作领域的 192 段匹配的四轮对话，以英文和中文评估无声的框架替换。每个种子对话有零、一或两个在源框架下生成的先前用户请求；AFVE 资格取决于用户请求历史并适用于一请求和两请求条件，零请求条件作为带框架的基线。十一个模型配置产生了 4224 个预期的目标后响应单元。两名标注者独立对 4204 个可评分响应就目标采纳、源框架言语化和直接可用性进行打分；模型与条件元数据被隐藏，分歧经仲裁解决。AFVE 出现在历史条件响应中的 25.54%（715/2799）。在 2388 个通过目标的的历史条件响应中，472 个（19.77%）仍暴露被弃用的源框架，最常见的方式是对比式表述（423/472）。对于这些独立修订任务，目标采纳并不能保证源框架沉默。
translation.brief: 构建 AFVE-Bench 双语基准，揭示多轮修订中模型虽采纳新框架却仍暴露旧框架的弃框言语化错误并用人工标注进行度量。

papers.title: When Experience Becomes a Backdoor: Poisoning Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Failure-Aware Task Optimization
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly improve themselves through self-evolution, distilling execution experience into persistent, reusable skills. However, this persistence creates a new attack surface: malicious rules implanted into skills can compromise subsequent agent behavior. Existing skill backdoor attacks typically assume direct manipulation of the victim's skills, which is impractical when skills are constructed internally by a trusted evolver. In this paper, we study a novel problem of task-level backdoor attacks, where the attacker can only inject poisoned evolution tasks, inducing the agent to implant backdoors into its own skills. Since the attacker controls neither skill induction nor downstream execution, a natural approach is to iteratively optimize poisoned tasks based on attack success. However, our preliminary analysis reveals two key challenges: (i) failures at different stages of skill evolution and downstream execution can produce indistinguishable outcomes, providing little guidance for targeted poisoned-task updates; and (ii) unsuccessful updates may undermine earlier progress, while simply discarding them may lead to repeated ineffective updates. To address these challenges, we propose BadEvolve, a failure-aware task-poisoning framework against self-evolving LLM agents. BadEvolve diagnoses attack failures across four stages, i.e., Induction, Activation, Following, and Effect, and directs updates toward the failing stage. It further employs rollback to preserve earlier progress and failure memory to avoid repeating ineffective updates. Extensive experiments across diverse self-evolution frameworks, benchmarks, and backbone LLMs demonstrate the effectiveness of BadEvolve. Our code is available at https://github.com/ventr1c/BadEvolve.

translation.title: 当经验成为后门：通过失败感知任务优化毒化自进化 LLM 智能体
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地通过自我进化来改进自身，将执行经验蒸馏为持久可复用的技能。然而这种持久性创造了新的攻击面：植入技能中的恶意规则可能危害后续智能体行为。现有技能后门攻击通常假设直接操纵受害者的技能，而当技能由可信进化器内部构建时这并不现实。本文研究一种新的任务级后门攻击问题：攻击者只能注入毒化的进化任务，诱导智能体将后门植入自身技能。由于攻击者既不控制技能归纳也不控制下游执行，一个自然方法是基于攻击成功率迭代优化毒化任务。然而我们的初步分析揭示两个关键挑战：(i) 技能进化与下游执行不同阶段的失败可能产生不可区分的结果，难以为有针对性的毒化任务更新提供指引；(ii) 不成功的更新可能破坏先前的进展，而简单丢弃又会导致重复的无效更新。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 BadEvolve，一个针对自进化 LLM 智能体的失败感知任务毒化框架。BadEvolve 在四个阶段（归纳 Induction、激活 Activation、遵循 Following、生效 Effect）诊断攻击失败，并将更新指向失败阶段；它还采用回滚以保留先前进展，并利用失败记忆避免重复无效更新。在多种自进化框架、基准和骨干 LLM 上的大量实验证明了 BadEvolve 的有效性。代码见 https://github.com/ventr1c/BadEvolve。
translation.brief: 针对只能注入毒化进化任务的场景，提出失败感知的 BadEvolve 框架，通过四阶段失败诊断、回滚与失败记忆诱导自进化 LLM 智能体将后门写入自身技能。

papers.title: Meta-Reinforcement Learning with Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Meta-reinforcement learning (meta-RL) trains agents to adapt to novel tasks from test-time experience, but requires diverse training environments and reward functions. While environments are becoming cheaper to generate, it remains difficult to anticipate every objective an agent may be asked to pursue at test time. Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) learn policies from reward-free data and support zero-shot RL (ZSRL): adaptation to new objectives at test time using a large reward-labeled dataset. Recent work has shown that BFM task inference can instead be performed online without prior task-specific data. We note that this capability positions BFMs and meta-RL as alternative approaches for online adaptation to new reward functions in a fixed environment. We then ask whether we can extend BFMs to compete with meta-RL more broadly, including in novel environments, and identify four challenges: environment identification, online data collection, test-time exploration, and learning from mixed reward supervision. We study each individually, then propose MetaBFM, a hybrid method that addresses all four. During training, it combines supervised reward-following with unsupervised learning; at test time, it can interpolate between exploration, exploitation, and ZSRL-style reward inference. We demonstrate that MetaBFM can recover the in-distribution performance of supervised meta-RL while generalizing to reward functions outside the training set. Our work suggests that BFMs and meta-RL are complementary research directions whose combined strengths allow adaptive agents to learn more diverse behaviors from a fixed set of supervised objectives.

translation.title: 结合零样本强化学习的元强化学习
translation.abstract: 元强化学习训练智能体在测试时根据经验适应新任务，但需要多样化的训练环境和奖励函数。虽然环境生成成本日益降低，但预先预料到智能体在测试时可能被要求追求的每个目标仍然困难。行为基础模型从无奖励数据中学习策略，并支持零样本强化学习，即利用大型带奖励标注的数据集在测试时适应新目标。近期工作表明，BFM的任务推断可以在线进行而无需预先的任务特定数据。我们注意到这一能力使BFM与元强化学习成为在固定环境中对新奖励函数进行在线适应的两种替代方案。我们进而探究能否将BFM扩展到与元强化学习更广泛地竞争，包括在新环境中，并识别出四个挑战：环境识别、在线数据收集、测试时探索以及从混合奖励监督中学习。我们对每个挑战分别进行研究，随后提出混合方法MetaBFM以同时解决这四个挑战。在训练阶段，它将有监督的奖励跟随与无监督学习相结合；在测试阶段，它可以在探索、利用和ZSRL式奖励推断之间进行插值。我们证明MetaBFM能够恢复有监督元强化学习在分布内的性能，同时泛化到训练集之外的奖励函数。我们的工作表明BFM与元强化学习是互补的研究方向，二者优势的结合使自适应智能体能够从一组固定的有监督目标中学习更多样的行为。
translation.brief: 该论文解决BFM在在线适应新奖励函数时面临的四个挑战问题，采用将奖励跟随监督学习与无监督学习结合、测试时融合探索与ZSRL推断的混合方法MetaBFM。

papers.title: YRC-Bench: Benchmarking Culturally Aware Machine Translation for Historical Heritage via Tri-Level Semantic Bridging
papers.abstract: Translating historical cultural heritage poses profound challenges for machine translation systems due to the acute semantic asymmetry across eras and cultures, where terse classical syntax frequently obscures domain-specific cultural knowledge. While Large Language Models have demonstrated remarkable prowess in generic translation benchmarks, they struggle to negotiate Culturally-Specific Items and diachronic shifts in domain-rich historical texts, such as Yellow River cultural records. To bridge this critical gap, we introduce YRC-Bench, the first human-curated, multi-parallel benchmark dedicated to historical heritage translation across Classical Chinese, Modern Chinese, and nine target foreign languages. YRC-Bench establishes a tri-level parallel corpus incorporating modern explanatory glosses as explicit semantic bridges and operationalizes translation strategies through paired conserved versus substituted CSI variants categorized by cultural translatability. Systematic evaluations of nine leading LLMs across bidirectional translation directions reveal that leveraging modern Chinese glosses - especially human-curated ones - dramatically elevates both lexical fidelity and semantic adequacy. Furthermore, multidimensional human preference audits by native experts unveil distinct cross-cultural preferences between Sinographic-tradition and non-Sinographic language groups.

translation.title: YRC-Bench：基于三层语义桥接的历史文化遗产文化感知机器翻译基准
translation.abstract: 翻译历史文化遗产对机器翻译系统构成深刻挑战，因为跨时代、跨文化的语义不对称问题突出，简练的古典句法常常掩盖了领域特定的文化知识。尽管大型语言模型在通用翻译基准上表现出卓越能力，但它们难以处理领域丰富的历史文本（如黄河文化记录）中的文化特定条目（CSI）和历时性演变。为弥合这一关键差距，我们提出YRC-Bench，这是首个由人工精心整理、面向古典中文、现代中文与九种目标外语之间历史遗产翻译的多平行基准。YRC-Bench构建了三层平行语料库，将现代解释性注释作为显式语义桥梁，并通过按文化可译性分类的保留与替换CSI变体配对来操作化翻译策略。对九个领先LLM在双向翻译方向的系统评估表明，利用现代中文注释（尤其是人工整理的注释）能显著提升词汇忠实度和语义充分性。此外，由母语专家进行的多维人工偏好审计揭示了汉字文化圈与非汉字文化圈语言群体之间明显不同的跨文化偏好。
translation.brief: 该论文解决历史文化遗产翻译中文化特定条目与语义不对称的评估缺失问题，采用人工整理的三层平行语料并配合CSI保留/替换变体构建YRC-Bench基准。

papers.title: ROLECUE: Diagnosing Cross-Lingual Role-Binding Failures in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can recognize events in images and parse sentences, but it remains unclear when they bind visual Agent-Patient structure to linguistic semantic roles across languages whose role cues depend on morphology, word order or construction. We introduce ROLECUE, a controlled diagnostic that pairs 192 validated two-person action images with German, Turkish, Japanese, English, Korean and Bangla sentences in canonical and patient-first orders. The evaluation separates image-only role recognition, text-only role parsing, direct image-sentence matching, response-compliance behavior and an external modular composition of the model's own component predictions. Across eight recent open-weight VLMs, ROLECUE reveals a structured spectrum: some models fail visual or linguistic component tests, some largely solve the diagnostic, some collapse to constant semantic assent and several show component-joint gaps in which reliable image-only and text-only role predictions do not survive direct joint inference. The largest non-degenerate gaps reach 44.9 percentage points, with final bootstrap intervals confirming that the effect is not a point-estimate artifact. These results reveal multilingual component-joint performance gaps and acceptance biases hidden by aggregate VLM benchmarks and show why component diagnostics are necessary before interpreting joint multimodal errors.

translation.title: ROLECUE：诊断视觉-语言模型中的跨语言角色绑定失败
translation.abstract: 视觉-语言模型能够识别图像中的事件并解析句子，但尚不清楚它们何时能将视觉上的施事-受事结构绑定到语言语义角色上——尤其是在角色线索依赖形态、语序或句式构造的多种语言之间。我们提出ROLECUE，一个受控诊断基准，将192张经过验证的双人动作图像与德语、土耳其语、日语、英语、韩语和孟加拉语的规范语序与受事优先语序句子配对。评估区分仅图像角色识别、仅文本角色解析、直接的图文匹配、响应依从行为，以及模型自身组件预测的外部模块化组合。在八个近期开源权重VLM上的评估揭示了结构化的能力谱系：一些模型在视觉或语言组件测试中失败，一些基本通过诊断，一些退化为恒定的语义肯定，还有若干模型表现出组件-联合差距——即可靠的仅图像与仅文本角色预测无法在直接联合推断中保持。最大的非退化差距达44.9个百分点，且bootstrap区间证实该效应并非点估计假象。这些结果揭示了被聚合式VLM基准掩盖的多语言组件-联合性能差距和接受偏差，并说明在解读联合多模态错误之前进行组件诊断的必要性。
translation.brief: 该论文解决VLM在不同语言中能否将视觉Agent-Patient结构正确绑定到语义角色的未知问题，采用受控的六语种图文角色绑定诊断基准ROLECUE进行组件化与联合评估。

papers.title: Global Context Guidance for Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Diffusion large language models (LLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs, enabling parallel generation through iterative denoising. Recent guidance methods improve diffusion LLMs by introducing a weak model to guide the prediction of the base model during denoising. However, the influence of the weak model during denoising remains less clear, and computing its prediction requires an additional forward pass at each denoising step. We present in this paper an in-depth analysis of how diffusion LLMs use contextual information during denoising. Our analysis reveals that diffusion LLMs rely more heavily on local context while often underutilizing global context. Based on this observation, we introduce Global Context Guidance (GCG), a feature-space guidance method that enhances global-context utilization without constructing an explicit weak model. Extensive experiments on LLaDA-8B, Dream-7B, and LLaDA-1.5 across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that GCG consistently outperforms existing guidance methods, while incurring much lower inference overhead.

translation.title: 扩散大语言模型的全局上下文引导
translation.abstract: 扩散大语言模型近来作为自回归LLM的有前景替代方案而兴起，通过迭代去噪实现并行生成。近期的引导方法通过引入一个弱模型在去噪过程中引导基础模型的预测来改进扩散LLM。然而，弱模型在去噪过程中的影响尚不清楚，且计算其预测需要在每个去噪步骤额外进行一次前向传播。本文对扩散LLM在去噪过程中如何使用上下文信息进行了深入分析。我们的分析揭示，扩散LLM更依赖局部上下文，而常常利用不足全局上下文。基于这一观察，我们提出全局上下文引导，一种特征空间引导方法，无需构建显式弱模型即可增强全局上下文利用。在LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B和LLaDA-1.5上跨多样基准的广泛实验表明，GCG持续优于现有引导方法，同时推理开销显著更低。
translation.brief: 该论文解决扩散LLM在去噪中过度依赖局部上下文、全局上下文利用不足的问题，采用无需弱模型的特征空间引导方法GCG增强全局上下文利用。

papers.title: Safe by Accident: Crash-Testing LLM-Written Code
papers.abstract: Evaluations of LLM-written code run it once, in one environment, and credit the code with whatever passes. We show that this credit can belong to the environment. We crashed LLM-written backend code just before each database, file and email call, re-ran it as an operator would, and judged the result under two transaction modes of Python's sqlite3: the default, in which the library quietly opens a transaction, and autocommit, in which it does not. Across 9,100 solutions from ten models on 24 backend tasks, more than half (54%) of the database code that survives every crash in the default mode is left half-updated in autocommit mode. This holds for every model, and it hides in ordinary code, including with conn: blocks that look like transactions but open none. Telling the model that its connection is in autocommit mode does not change what the local code models write, while the API models' unsafe share falls by 30 points. Asking for crash safety helps every model, and strong models repair nearly all unsafe code, but often write safe code only when asked. Thus, much of the crash safety that LLM-written database code appears to have is borrowed from the library rather than designed into it, and a second test under a less forgiving configuration reveals the difference.

translation.title: 意外的安全：对LLM编写代码的崩溃测试
translation.abstract: 对LLM编写代码的评估通常只在一个环境中运行一次，并将通过的测试归功于代码。我们证明这种功劳可能属于环境。我们在每次数据库、文件和邮件调用之前使LLM编写的后端代码崩溃，像运维人员那样重新运行，并在Python sqlite3的两种事务模式下评判结果：默认模式（库会悄悄开启事务）和自动提交模式（不会）。在十个模型于24个后端任务上的9100个解法中，默认模式下通过所有崩溃测试的数据库代码有超过一半（54%）在自动提交模式下处于半更新状态。这一现象在所有模型上都成立，且隐藏在普通代码中，包括看似事务但实际未开启事务的with conn:块。告知模型其连接处于自动提交模式并不会改变本地代码模型所写的内容，而API模型的不安全比例下降30个百分点。要求崩溃安全性对每个模型都有帮助，强模型几乎能修复所有不安全代码，但往往只在被要求时才编写安全代码。因此，LLM编写的数据库代码表面上的崩溃安全性很大程度是借自数据库库而非自身设计所得，而在更严格配置下的第二次测试能揭示这一差别。
translation.brief: 该论文解决LLM编写数据库代码的安全性被库默认事务机制掩盖而非代码自身设计保证的问题，采用崩溃测试结合默认/自动提交双事务模式对照的方法进行评估。

papers.title: M3FT: Micro-Macro-Micro Reasoning for Multi-Agent Cryptocurrency Perpetual Futures Trading
papers.abstract: Cryptocurrency perpetual futures form a large-scale online financial market in which automated agents manage interacting asset positions under changing conditions. Policies relying solely on micro-level numerical states may overlook cross-asset relationships and become vulnerable to regime shifts, while macro-level linguistic judgments alone cannot ensure precise measurement or optimize positions under trading costs and risk constraints. Connecting market interpretation to coordinated multi-asset decisions remains challenging. We propose M3FT, a micro-macro-micro framework for multi-agent perpetual futures trading. The first micro stage constructs time-aligned numerical states from exchange and account observations through deterministic processing. The macro stage transforms these measured states into explicit market interpretations without adding external market information. Four asset-specific teams, each comprising a Market Interpreter, an Asset Communicator, and a Risk Reviewer, refine these interpretations through experience retrieval, cross-asset communication, and review of joint-position risks. The final micro stage combines encoded linguistic representations with the original numerical states to learn continuous target positions. We implement this framework with a language-conditioned multi-agent policy: asset actors use global and private numerical states together with linguistic context, while centralized critics evaluate joint actions using portfolio-wide information and shared-account rewards.
