Experiments on real cryptocurrency perpetual futures data, including comparisons across language models and policy-learning algorithms and component ablations, show that the best-performing M3FT configuration achieves a higher mean test return than the evaluated direct LLM, numerical RL, and rule-based baselines.

translation.title: M3FT：面向多智能体加密货币永续合约交易的微观-宏观-微观推理
translation.abstract: 加密货币永续合约是一个大规模在线金融市场，自动化智能体需要在不断变化的条件下管理相互关联的资产仓位。仅依赖微观层面数值状态的策略可能忽视跨资产关系，并容易受市场状态切换影响；而仅靠宏观层面的语言判断又无法保证精确度量，或在交易成本与风险约束下优化仓位。如何将市场解读与协调的多资产决策连接起来仍然具有挑战性。我们提出M3FT，一个面向多智能体永续合约交易的微观-宏观-微观框架。第一个微观阶段通过确定性处理，从交易所和账户观测中构建时间对齐的数值状态。宏观阶段将这些可度量的状态转化为显式的市场解读，而不引入额外的外部市场信息。四个资产专属团队（每个团队由Market Interpreter、Asset Communicator和Risk Reviewer组成）通过经验检索、跨资产通信和联合仓位风险审查来完善这些解读。最后的微观阶段将编码后的语言表示与原始数值状态相结合，以学习连续的目标仓位。我们用一个语言条件化的多智能体策略实现该框架：资产actor同时使用全局和私有数值状态以及语言上下文，而集中式critic则利用组合层面的信息和共享账户奖励来评估联合动作。在真实加密货币永续合约数据上的实验（包括跨语言模型和策略学习算法的比较以及组件消融）表明，表现最佳的M3FT配置取得了比所评估的直接LLM、数值RL和基于规则的基线更高的平均测试收益。
translation.brief: 解决永续合约交易中微观状态与宏观市场解读难以衔接的问题，提出微观-宏观-微观框架并结合语言条件化多智能体策略学习连续目标仓位。

papers.title: MotionGraphicsBench: Evaluating Motion Graphics Generation with Programmatic Verification
papers.abstract: Large language models can generate motion graphics from static images and natural language requests, but it remains difficult to evaluate how well models can follow requests that combine spatial, appearance, and temporal requirements. We introduce MotionGraphicsBench, an expert-curated benchmark of 100 instances for animating an input static SVG with a motion edit prompt. By supplying all required visual elements, our editing task reflects a designer-like workflow and isolates motion generation from graphic generation. Derived from real-world Lottie motion designs, our benchmark contains diverse combinations of spatio-temporal animation behaviors. Each benchmark instance pairs its model input with a deterministic, human-readable verification program that accepts different valid implementations and reports which prompt requirements pass or fail, rather than comparing against a reference animation or using a VLM judge. We construct these programs with a multi-agent pipeline using human-labeled animations and synthesized test cases. On a balanced test set of 180 animations, our programs achieve 93.3% raw agreement with human judgments, compared with 83.3% for a GPT-6 Astra VLM baseline, and outperform the baseline in both approval and rejection recall. Across 47 configurations from 32 LLMs and 12 providers, pass@1 ranges from 6.0% to 67.7%. Across 15 models evaluated at their highest available reasoning effort with 32 attempts per instance, additional attempts improve every model, but pass@32 still ranges from 38.0% to 95.0%. Our analysis of verification programs reveals that generated animations often fail to match reference poses, follow requested motion trajectories, or coordinate related events. We release our benchmark at https://huggingface.co/datasets/figma-ai/motion-graphics-bench.

translation.title: MotionGraphicsBench：基于程序化验证评估动态图形生成
translation.abstract: 大语言模型可以根据静态图像和自然语言请求生成动态图形，但评估模型能否遵循结合空间、外观和时间要求的请求仍然困难。我们提出MotionGraphicsBench，一个由专家精心整理的基准，包含100个实例，任务是根据运动编辑提示对输入的静态SVG进行动画化。通过提供所有必需的视觉元素，我们的编辑任务反映了类似设计师的工作流程，并将运动生成与图形生成分离开来。该基准源自真实世界的Lottie动效设计，包含多样化的时空动画行为组合。每个基准实例将模型输入与一个确定性、人类可读的验证程序配对，该程序接受不同的有效实现，并报告哪些提示要求通过或失败，而不是与参考动画进行比较或使用VLM评判。我们使用多智能体流水线构建这些程序，结合人工标注的动画和合成的测试用例。在一个包含180个动画的均衡测试集上，我们的程序与人类判断的原始一致率达到93.3%，而GPT-6 Astra VLM基线为83.3%，且在批准召回率和拒绝召回率上均优于基线。在来自32个LLM和12家提供商的47种配置中，pass@1从6.0%到67.7%不等。在以最高可用推理力度、每实例32次尝试评估的15个模型中，额外尝试提升了每个模型的表现，但pass@32仍在38.0%到95.0%之间。我们对验证程序的分析表明，生成的动画常常无法匹配参考姿态、遵循所要求的运动轨迹或协调相关事件。我们在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/figma-ai/motion-graphics-bench 发布了该基准。
translation.brief: 解决动态图形生成难以评估的问题，构建专家基准并采用确定性程序化验证替代VLM评判。

papers.title: InfoOrgBench: Can Agents Turn Scattered Information into Coherent Hierarchies?
papers.abstract: When agents organize records into folders, they may correctly group the excerpts of a design proposal yet place the proposal under the wrong owning group. Existing agent benchmarks do not directly measure such higher-level errors. We introduce InfoOrgBench, a benchmark of 150 tasks in which agents organize scattered records from meeting recaps, issue threads and design proposals into hierarchies. Integrity checks verify that every record is preserved, and a Structure Score measures agreement with the source hierarchy at every level, independent of folder names and order. We evaluate 45 systems that pair nine models with five agent harnesses. The best system scores 83.2 out of 100, but no system exceeds 78 on meeting recaps or issue threads. Model choice affects scores far more than harness choice: model means span about 27 points, whereas the average effect of each harness is below one point. More importantly, parent-level relations have higher error rates than leaf-level relations in all three domains. In design proposals, nearly half of the outputs analyzed by level make exactly this kind of error. These results show that evaluating information organization requires measuring higher-level relations separately from record preservation and local grouping.

translation.title: InfoOrgBench：智能体能将零散信息转化为连贯的层级结构吗？
translation.abstract: 当智能体将记录组织到文件夹中时，它们可能正确地将一份设计提案的摘录分组，却将该提案放在了错误的所有者组之下。现有的智能体基准并未直接度量这类更高层级的错误。我们提出InfoOrgBench，一个包含150个任务的基准，要求智能体将来自会议纪要、issue讨论和设计提案的零散记录组织成层级结构。完整性检查验证每条记录都被保留，而结构分数（Structure Score）在与源层级不依赖文件夹名称和顺序的情况下，在每一层级上度量与源层级的一致性。我们评估了45个系统，将九个模型与五种智能体harness配对。最佳系统得分为83.2/100，但在会议纪要或issue讨论上没有系统超过78分。模型选择对分数的影响远大于harness选择：模型均值相差约27分，而每个harness的平均影响不足一分。更重要的是，在所有三个领域中，父层级关系的错误率都高于叶层级关系。在设计提案中，按层级分析的结果里近一半恰好出现这类错误。这些结果表明，评估信息组织需要将更高层级关系与记录保留和局部分组分开度量。
translation.brief: 解决现有基准无法度量智能体在信息组织中的高层级结构错误的问题，构建带完整性检查与层级一致性评分的InfoOrgBench基准。

papers.title: AI in the Clinical Documentation Loop: Effects of LLM-Induced Note Bloat and Diagnostic Overcall on Downstream LLMs
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to process medical records for healthcare tasks such as clinical documentation. Because these tools also generate documentation, the relationship is now bidirectional: models both read from and write to the record. Understanding how LLMs behave when reading records that already contain LLM-authored content is therefore critical for their safe deployment. In this study, we examine how LLM-authored content in the medical record affects downstream LLMs that read the same record. We consider two types of LLM-induced artifacts: bloat, in which LLM-generated summaries accumulate in the record and change the length and provenance of its content over time; and distortion, in which LLMs subtly alter clinical findings rather than fabricating facts outright. As a case of distortion, we study diagnostic overcall (documenting an unconfirmed differential diagnosis in the record) and test whether it propagates to the reader LLM's output. Across seven reader models from four families, we find evidence of both effects. First, LLM-generated summary notes modestly but consistently degraded downstream hospital-course generation compared with copy-forward and templated text of matched length. Second, injected overcalls reappeared in downstream outputs at rates that varied by reader model, without detectable changes in standard quality metrics. These findings show the need to monitor AI-generated content in medical records and to account for it when those records are later processed by AI.

translation.title: 临床文档闭环中的AI：LLM导致的病历膨胀与诊断过度记录对下游LLM的影响
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于处理医疗记录以完成临床文档等医疗任务。由于这些工具也会生成文档，这种关系现在是双向的：模型既从记录中读取内容，也向记录中写入内容。因此，理解LLM在读取已包含LLM撰写内容的记录时的行为，对其安全部署至关重要。在本研究中，我们考察医疗记录中LLM撰写的内容如何影响读取同一记录的下游LLM。我们考虑两类LLM导致的伪影：膨胀（bloat），即LLM生成的摘要不断累积在记录中，随时间改变内容的长度和来源；以及扭曲（distortion），即LLM微妙地改变临床发现而非凭空捏造事实。作为扭曲的一个案例，我们研究了诊断过度记录（diagnostic overcall，即在记录中写入未经确认的鉴别诊断），并测试其是否会传播到读取方LLM的输出中。在来自四个家族的七个读取模型上，我们发现了两种效应的证据。首先，与等长的复制粘贴和模板文本相比，LLM生成的摘要笔记对下游住院病程生成造成了轻微但一致的退化。其次，注入的过度记录以因读取模型而异的比率再次出现在下游输出中，而标准质量指标未检测到变化。这些发现表明，需要监控医疗记录中的AI生成内容，并在这些记录随后被AI处理时将其纳入考量。
translation.brief: 研究LLM写入病历的内容（摘要膨胀与诊断过度记录）如何影响下游读取该病历的LLM，通过注入实验在多个读取模型上验证其传播效应。

papers.title: An LLM-Orchestrated Multi-Modal Chatbot for Tomato Disease Consultant
papers.abstract: This paper introduces a chatbot developed to assist in diagnosing common diseases in tomato plants through natural language interaction. Users can describe symptoms in text. Then, the chatbot responds with the most likely disease, and basic treatment suggestions and related image-based reasoning. The system leverages pre-trained Mistral and Llama 3.2 large language models. The system is also built using LangChain and Streamlit to provide a lightweight and offline-friendly interface. This work targets to support tomato growers a fast and accessible tomato plant health guidance when the technical expertise is not available nearby, especially in the remote areas. The experimental results are promising and encourage further improvement of the chatbot for future real-world deployment.

translation.title: 面向番茄病害咨询的LLM编排多模态聊天机器人
translation.abstract: 本文介绍了一个通过自然语言交互协助诊断番茄常见病害的聊天机器人。用户可以用文本描述症状，聊天机器人随后给出最可能的病害、基本治疗建议以及相关的基于图像的推理。该系统利用预训练的Mistral和Llama 3.2大语言模型，并使用LangChain和Streamlit构建，提供轻量且支持离线的界面。这项工作旨在为番茄种植者提供快速、可及的植物健康指导，特别是在附近缺乏技术专业知识、偏远地区的场景。实验结果令人鼓舞，为该聊天机器人未来在真实世界部署中的进一步改进奠定了基础。
translation.brief: 解决偏远地区番茄种植者缺乏病害诊断专家的问题，基于Mistral、Llama 3.2结合LangChain与Streamlit构建多模态咨询聊天机器人。

papers.title: Efficient LLM Adaptation with Forward-Only Passes
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference serving is undergoing rapid growth and large-scale deployment, motivating us to rethink how the inference process itself can be leveraged to enable efficient task-specific LLM adaptation. In this paper, we propose a forward-only approach for efficient LLM adaptation with forward-only passes in LLM inference serving. We exploit the angle concentration of activations induced by each singular value decomposition (SVD) component to measure its contribution-dispersed or concentrated-to the angle concentration of the hidden states. Based on this, our forward-only search then efficiently identifies the weight matrix with the highest dispersion that merits rank reduction. We then selectively remove the higher-order components and retain the lower-order components in SVD. Empirical results across diverse datasets demonstrate the competitive accuracy of our forward-only approach, while theoretical analysis shows lower peak memory and greater speedup than the gradient-based approach and greater speedup than the exhaustive search approach. The experiments further present the robustness and generalization of our forward-only approach to various LLMs with up to 57B parameters. The code is included in the supplementary material.

translation.title: 基于纯前向传播的高效大语言模型适配
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）推理服务正在经历快速增长和大规模部署，这促使我们重新思考如何利用推理过程本身来实现高效的任务特定 LLM 适配。本文提出一种纯前向（forward-only）方法，在 LLM 推理服务中仅通过前向传播实现高效的任务适配。我们利用每个奇异值分解（SVD）分量引起的激活角度集中度来衡量其对隐状态角度集中度的贡献是分散还是集中。基于此，我们的纯前向搜索高效地识别出分散度最高、值得进行秩缩减的权重矩阵。随后，我们在 SVD 中选择性地移除高阶分量、保留低阶分量。在多种数据集上的实证结果表明，该纯前向方法具有有竞争力的准确率；理论分析表明其峰值内存低于基于梯度的方法，且相比基于梯度的方法和穷举搜索方法具有更大的加速。实验进一步展示了该方法对最高 57B 参数的多种 LLM 的鲁棒性和泛化能力。代码包含在补充材料中。
translation.brief: 提出仅用前向传播（无需梯度）基于 SVD 分量角度集中度搜索并裁剪权重矩阵秩的方法，实现高效的任务特定 LLM 适配。

papers.title: Detent: Batch-Invariant LLM Serving and RL Rollouts at Near-Stock Speed
papers.abstract: Reproducible evaluation, verifiable inference and on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) need an LLM engine to give a request the same output bits whichever requests share its batch. Batch-invariant kernels exist, but engines still select each kernel and its parameters from the batch. Two kernels that compute the same sum can round it differently. The engines' deterministic modes remove the choice by keeping one conservative kernel per operator and pay for it in latency. Many fast kernels are batch-invariant by themselves, so it is enough to fix the few batch-dependent values that kernel selection reads. Detent expresses kernel selection as a program that the engine executes. It finds the fewest values in this program that must be fixed and tunes them for the workload before deployment. On multi-GPU deployments of Llama-3.1-70B and Qwen3-30B-A3B in vLLM and SGLang, Detent is batch-invariant. Tuned per load, it serves at 1.04-1.17x the latency per output token of Stock (each engine with its standard settings), against 1.67-10.3x for the deterministic modes. In SGLang it matches the GSM8K accuracy of SGLang's deterministic mode. Detent covers multiple deployment combinations, including multiple engines, GPU generations, tensor-parallel degrees, and dense and MoE models. Seeded RL rollouts of models up to Llama-3.1-70B replay bit for bit under other batches and cache splits. A trainer on Detent's kernels and values matches every rollout logprob bit for bit at 1.03x Stock's rollout time per token. BF16 GRPO then stays stable where Stock's run collapses.

translation.title: Detent：以接近原生速度实现批量无关的 LLM 服务与 RL rollout
translation.abstract: 可复现评估、可验证推理和 on-policy 强化学习（RL）需要 LLM 引擎对一个请求给出相同的输出比特，无论哪些请求与其共享同一批次。批量无关（batch-invariant）kernel 已经存在，但引擎仍从批次中读取信息来选择每个 kernel 及其参数。计算同一个和的两个 kernel 可能以不同方式舍入。引擎的确定性模式通过为每个算子保留一个保守 kernel 来消除选择，但代价是延迟。许多快速 kernel 本身就是批量无关的，因此只需固定 kernel 选择所读取的少数几个批次相关值即可。Detent 将 kernel 选择表达为引擎执行的程序，找出该程序中必须固定的最少值，并在部署前针对工作负载进行调优。在 vLLM 和 SGLang 中对 Llama-3.1-70B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 的多 GPU 部署上，Detent 实现了批量无关性。按负载调优后，其每个输出 token 的延迟为 Stock（各引擎标准设置）的 1.04-1.17 倍，而确定性模式为 1.67-10.3 倍。在 SGLang 中，其 GSM8K 准确率与 SGLang 确定性模式持平。Detent 覆盖多种部署组合，包括多引擎、多代 GPU、多张量并行度以及稠密和 MoE 模型。最高至 Llama-3.1-70B 的模型的带种子 RL rollout 可在其他批次和缓存切分下逐比特重放。基于 Detent kernel 和值的 trainer 在 1.03 倍 Stock 每-token rollout 时间内逐比特匹配每个 rollout 的 logprob。BF16 GRPO 在 Stock 崩溃的情况下保持稳定。
translation.brief: 提出 Detent，通过固定 kernel 选择程序中少数批次相关取值，在不牺牲速度的前提下实现批量无关（逐比特可复现）的 LLM 推理与 RL rollout。

papers.title: An Agentic Multi-Agent Framework for System Log Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract: As enterprise systems grow in scale and complexity, manual log analysis and conventional SIEM tools struggle to keep pace with the volume and diversity of incidents. To address this challenge, this paper proposed a multi-agent AI framework supporting in analyzing the system log to trace the attack forensic in the system more effectively and efficiently. The framework is designed using n8n platform and Gemini large language model. The framework consists of 7 AI agent layers. Each agent work on a specific task. When the task is done, the agent will forward the result to the output-associated agent of the next layer. The multi agent model improves the analysis velocity, so it is able to support numerous log analysis requirement at the same time. We deployed 16 test cases to test operation of the multi agent workflow, and evaluate the accuracy per test case and the operative performance. The result findings are very promising.

translation.title: 用于系统日志异常检测的智能体化多智能体框架
translation.abstract: 随着企业系统规模和复杂性的增长，人工日志分析和传统 SIEM 工具难以应对事件的规模和多样性。为应对这一挑战，本文提出了一个多智能体 AI 框架，支持分析系统日志以更高效、更有效地追踪系统中的攻击取证。该框架基于 n8n 平台和 Gemini 大语言模型设计，由 7 层 AI 智能体组成。每个智能体负责特定任务，任务完成后将结果转发给下一层相关联的输出智能体。多智能体模型提升了分析速度，因此能够同时支持大量日志分析需求。我们部署了 16 个测试用例来测试多智能体工作流的运行，并评估每个测试用例的准确率和运行性能，结果非常有前景。
translation.brief: 构建基于 n8n 与 Gemini 的七层多智能体框架，对系统日志进行自动化异常检测与攻击取证分析。

papers.title: On the Convergence of First-Order Methods in Signaling Games
papers.abstract: We study first-order learning dynamics in Bayesian signaling games, a minimal extensive-form model of strategic interaction under asymmetric information. In these games, a Sender observes a private type and chooses a signal, after which a Receiver forms a posterior belief and selects an action. This Bayesian belief update makes the induced learning field fundamentally different from the affine game-gradient fields of normal-form games. Empirically, we find a sharp dichotomy: standard online learning algorithms reliably converge to strict Perfect Bayesian Equilibria (PE), but not to non-strict ones. We show that this behavior cannot be explained by the global geometric conditions commonly used to prove last-iterate convergence, such as monotonicity or the Minty variational inequality. Indeed, these conditions can fail even in binary signaling games. Instead, we identify the relevant local geometry. Our main result characterizes variational stability in finite signaling games: a PE is variationally stable if and only if it is strict. This yields local last-iterate convergence guarantees for online mirror descent and regularized dual averaging near every strict PE. We then study global average-iterate convergence and identify a class of signaling games in which coarse-trigger regret-minimizing dynamics converge to the unique PE. Finally, we complement the theory with experiments comparing projected gradient ascent, mirror-based methods, optimistic variants, and PPO across canonical signaling-game families. The results position signaling games as a compact testbed for understanding how Bayesian belief formation reshapes the convergence geometry of multi-agent learning.

translation.title: 论一阶方法在信号博弈中的收敛性
translation.abstract: 我们研究贝叶斯信号博弈中的一阶学习动力学，信号博弈是不对称信息下策略交互的极简扩展式模型。在这类博弈中，Sender 观察到私有类型并选择信号，随后 Receiver 形成后验信念并选择行动。这种贝叶斯信念更新使得诱导的学习场与标准式博弈的仿射博弈梯度场有本质不同。实证上我们发现一个鲜明的二分现象：标准在线学习算法能可靠地收敛到严格完美贝叶斯均衡（PE），但不能收敛到非严格的。我们证明该行为无法用通常用于证明末次迭代收敛的全局几何条件（如单调性或 Minty 变分不等式）来解释——这些条件甚至在二元信号博弈中也会失效。相反，我们识别出相关的局部几何。我们的主要结果刻画了有限信号博弈中的变分稳定性：一个 PE 是变分稳定的当且仅当它是严格的。这为 online mirror descent 和 regularized dual averaging 在每个严格 PE 附近的局部末次迭代收敛提供了保证。随后我们研究全局平均迭代收敛，并识别出一类信号博弈，其中 coarse-trigger regret 最小化动力学收敛到唯一 PE。最后，我们用实验比较了 projected gradient ascent、镜像方法、乐观变体和 PPO 在经典信号博弈族上的表现。这些结果将信号博弈定位为理解贝叶斯信念形成如何重塑多智能体学习收敛几何的紧凑测试平台。
translation.brief: 刻画信号博弈中变分稳定的充要条件（严格 PE），据此给出在线一阶算法在严格均衡附近的局部末次迭代收敛保证。

papers.title: What Do Collusion Probes Read? Three Pitfalls in Evaluating Multi-Agent Collusion Monitors
papers.abstract: Activation probes look like near-perfect monitors for secret collusion among large language model (LLM) agents. We show that they mostly detect that an agent was told to collude, not that it decided to. Our benchmark (2,500 committee and 1,476 code-review episodes) adds agents who receive the collusion instruction and refuse it, separating instruction from decision. Published detectors barely tell colluders from these refusers, and our best probe separates them mostly by reading the instruction: without it, agent AUROC falls from 1.00 to 0.61. Two further pitfalls inflate reported results: scored after the vote, a rule that only reads the votes reaches AUROC 0.990 but finds nothing before it; and in 57% of attempts no colluder argues for the target in public. The decision is still there: a probe trained on agents' own choices reads it (AUROC 0.73 without the instruction), and probes find colluders whose goal was fine-tuned into the weights (AUROC 0.995; pre-registered). We turn the controls into a protocol for testing any collusion monitor, and adapt scan statistics into an online monitor for groups of any size.

translation.title: 共谋探针究竟读取到了什么？评估多智能体共谋监测器的三个陷阱
translation.abstract: 激活探针看似是检测 LLM 智能体间秘密共谋的近乎完美的监测器。我们表明，它们主要检测到的是智能体被告知要共谋，而非它自己决定共谋。我们的基准（2,500 个委员会场景和 1,476 个代码审查场景）加入了收到共谋指令但拒绝执行的智能体，从而将指令与决策区分开。已发表的检测器几乎无法将这些共谋者与拒绝者区分开，而我们最好的探针主要是通过读取指令来区分它们：去掉指令后，智能体 AUROC 从 1.00 降至 0.61。另外两个陷阱会虚高报告的结果：在投票后评分时，仅读取投票的规则可达到 AUROC 0.990，但在投票前什么也发现不了；且在 57% 的尝试中，没有共谋者在公开场合为目标辩护。决策本身仍然存在：基于智能体自身选择训练的探针能读取它（无指令时 AUROC 0.73），且探针能发现共谋目标已被微调进权重的智能体（AUROC 0.995；预注册）。我们将这些控制手段转化为测试任何共谋监测器的协议，并将 scan statistics 改造为适用于任意规模群体在线监测的监测器。
translation.brief: 通过引入“收到指令但拒绝”的对照智能体与后置评分等控制，揭示激活探针检测的是共谋指令而非共谋决策，并给出评估共谋监测器的协议。

papers.title: EndoSCOP-V: A Multi-Turn Video Understanding Evaluation Framework for Multimodal Models in Endoscopy Reporting and Clinical Reasoning
papers.abstract: Endoscopic diagnosis unfolds over native video, where a single positive finding during traversal of the gastrointestinal tract sets off a multi-minute chain of reasoning over location, morphology, severity and intervention. Existing endoscopy multimodal benchmarks test only static images or single-disease videos, which miss the temporal and clinical reasoning that real-world reporting demands. We introduce EndoSCOP-V, a video-grounded multi-turn evaluation framework for structured endoscopy reporting and clinical reasoning. It contains 1,307 real-world endoscopy and colonoscopy videos (63.2 h; 97% 1080p) averaging about 174 s. Its 20,274 question-answer turns are instantiated deterministically from clinician-filled structured endoscopy-reporting EHRs, so no per-case annotation is synthetic or LLM-rephrased. They come from 1,033 clinician-reviewed templates, about 18 per disease, that span a clinically aligned 9-task x 30-sub-task reporting taxonomy over 54 World Endoscopy Organization (WEO) MST 3.0 diseases. 22% of procedures carry co-existing pathologies, up to six per case. A Markovian context-pruned oracle-forcing protocol evaluates the dialogue turn by turn, injecting the gold answer before each subsequent turn so that per-turn reasoning is isolated from cascading dialogue errors. A panel of 15 board-certified endoscopists sets a 78% strict-accuracy baseline on 1,500 questions. Across 14 open-weight LMMs, the best 27B-class model reaches 59.8% strict accuracy, falling to 53.4% once format-trivial disease-rejection items are excluded. On a between-subjects spot-check, the best of 3 frontier proprietary models trails the clinician panel by 23 pp on strict NDR accuracy. Sub-task analysis reveals consistent gaps in quantitative measurement, multi-variable grading and intervention reasoning on long-horizon video. Data: Hugging Face (EndoSCOP-V). Code: GitHub (abhi25t/EndoSCOP-V).

translation.title: EndoSCOP-V：面向内镜报告与临床推理的多模态模型多轮视频理解评估框架
translation.abstract: 内镜诊断是一个在原生视频上展开的过程：在消化道行进过程中出现的一个阳性发现，会引发长达数分钟的关于部位、形态、严重程度和干预措施的推理链。现有内镜多模态基准仅测试静态图像或单病种视频，无法涵盖真实报告所要求的时间和临床推理。我们提出 EndoSCOP-V，一个以视频为基础、面向结构化内镜报告和临床推理的多轮评估框架。它包含 1,307 条真实内镜和结肠镜视频（共 63.2 小时，97% 为 1080p），平均时长约 174 秒。其 20,274 个问答轮次由医生填写并结构化的内镜报告 EHR 确定性生成，因此没有任何逐例标注是合成或经 LLM 改写的。它们来自 1,033 个经医生审核的模板（每种病约 18 个），覆盖 54 种世界内镜组织（WEO）MST 3.0 疾病，构成与临床对齐的 9 任务 × 30 子任务报告分类体系。22% 的检查病例存在并存病变，每例最多 6 处。一种马尔可夫式上下文裁剪的 oracle 注入协议逐轮评估对话，在每一后续轮次之前注入标准答案，从而将逐轮推理与级联的对话错误隔离开来。由 15 位获得执业认证的内镜医生组成的专家组在 1,500 个问题上设定了 78% 的严格准确率基线。在 14 个开源权重 LMM 中，最好的 27B 级模型达到 59.8% 的严格准确率，剔除格式性质的疾病排除题后降至 53.4%。在一次被试间抽查中，3 个前沿专有模型中最好的一个在严格 NDR 准确率上落后医生专家组 23 个百分点。子任务分析显示，在长时程视频上的定量测量、多变量分级和干预推理方面存在一致差距。数据：Hugging Face (EndoSCOP-V)。代码：GitHub (abhi25t/EndoSCOP-V)。
translation.brief: 构建了基于真实内镜视频的多轮评估框架 EndoSCOP-V，通过从医生填写的结构化 EHR 确定性生成问答并用 oracle 注入协议逐轮隔离评估多模态模型的临床推理能力。

papers.title: Towards Identity-Preserving LLM Agents under Model Transition
papers.abstract: When an LLM agent's backend model is upgraded or replaced, operators typically reload the same persona, memory, and rules onto the new model and assume the agent will behave as before. We show this assumption requires empirical validation-and that whether identity is preserved depends on the specific model pairing. Across 5,760 compliance-testing runs in 12 regulated domains with three open-weight models, we find that some transitions produce significant behavioral drift while others do not, even when the agent's external state remains identical. Crucially, this drift is invisible to verbal verification: every model claims full policy compliance, yet actual decisions under pressure differ across models. The same external state can reorder which model is most compliant-a large positive effect on one substrate, negligible on the other two. Practitioners should treat model transitions as behavioral changes requiring action-level empirical testing, not as transparent infrastructure operations.

translation.title: 迈向模型切换下保持身份的 LLM 智能体
translation.abstract: 当 LLM 智能体的后端模型被升级或替换时，运营者通常会将相同的人格、记忆和规则重新加载到新模型上，并假设智能体会像以前一样行事。我们证明这一假设需要经验验证——且身份是否得以保持取决于具体的模型配对。在 12 个受监管领域、使用三个开源权重模型进行的 5,760 次合规性测试运行中，我们发现某些切换会产生显著的行为漂移，而另一些则不会，即使智能体的外部状态保持完全一致。关键在于，这种漂移对口头验证是不可见的：每个模型都声称完全遵守政策，但在压力下的实际决策在不同模型之间存在差异。相同的外部状态可以改变哪个模型最合规——对一个底座模型有较大的正向效应，对另外两个则可忽略不计。从业者应将模型切换视为需要行动级实证测试的行为变化，而非透明的基础设施操作。
translation.brief: 通过 5,760 次合规性测试实证表明，LLM 智能体在更换后端模型后即使外部状态不变也会出现行为漂移，因此模型切换需进行行动级经验验证。

papers.title: DFT-Agent Bench: Scaffold Effects and Execution Provenance in Autonomous DFT
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents for first-principles materials simulation. We report empirical findings from DFT-Agent Bench, a benchmark of 200+ Quantum ESPRESSO tasks spanning relaxation, electronic structure, equation-of-state, and elastic-tensor pipelines over multiple material tiers. Each task carries a QE-derived ground truth with public-reference cross-checks where available, and a provenance audit checks whether the required QE execution contract was met. Under one execution harness, we compare a near-bare ReAct baseline with a bundled v5.1 scaffold on two models. The complete scaffold improves bands+DOS by +0.08/+0.11 and d-electron vc-relax by +0.17 on both models, while high-scoring relaxation and equation-of-state cells leave little room for improvement. The elastic result is model-dependent (0.18 to 0.40 for deepseek-v4-pro and 0.62 to 0.59 for claude-opus-4-8). A fixed 100-task analysis with retrieval disabled supports the aggregate pattern: the fully frozen DeepSeek comparison gains +0.17, while the Opus comparison gains +0.10 against a historical pool baseline (p < 0.001). The provenance gate catches incomplete or unmarked executions that can receive high rubric scores; it is an execution-contract check, not a test for intentional fraud. These results characterize the evaluated DFT workflows. The anonymous review artifact contains the frozen diagnostic slice, prompts, scorer, and solver revisions: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/231e31re91287h/README.md.

translation.title: DFT-Agent Bench：自主 DFT 中的脚手架效应与执行溯源
translation.abstract: 大语言模型正日益被部署为用于第一性原理材料模拟的自主智能体。我们报告来自 DFT-Agent Bench 的实证发现，该基准包含 200 多个 Quantum ESPRESSO 任务，涵盖多层级材料上的弛豫、电子结构、状态方程和弹性张量流程。每个任务都带有 QE 导出的标准答案（在可用时与公开参考文献交叉验证），并通过溯源审计检查是否满足了所需的 QE 执行契约。在同一个执行框架下，我们在两个模型上比较了接近裸机的 ReAct 基线与打包的 v5.1 脚手架。完整脚手架在两个模型上使 bands+DOS 提升 +0.08/+0.11，使 d 电子 vc-relax 提升 +0.17，而高分值的弛豫和状态方程单元已几乎没有改进空间。弹性结果是模型依赖的（deepseek-v4-pro 从 0.18 到 0.40；claude-opus-4-8 从 0.62 到 0.59）。一项关闭检索的固定 100 任务分析支持总体模式：完全冻结的 DeepSeek 对比获得 +0.17，而 Opus 对比相对于历史池基线获得 +0.10（p < 0.001）。溯源门能捕获可能获得高评分但执行不完整或未标记的情况；它是一项执行契约检查，而非针对蓄意作弊的测试。这些结果刻画了所评估的 DFT 工作流。匿名评审工件包含冻结的诊断切片、提示词、评分器和解算器修订：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/231e31re91287h/README.md。
translation.brief: 提出包含 200 多个 Quantum ESPRESSO 任务的 DFT-Agent Bench，用以评估 LLM 智能体在自主 DFT 计算中的脚手架效应并引入执行溯源审计以验证任务是否真正被执行。

papers.title: Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention: Closed-Loop Quality Control for Long-Context LLM Decoding
papers.abstract: Sparse attention accelerates long-context decoding by reading a subset of the KV cache, but existing methods are open-loop: the kernel commits to its selection with no signal indicating whether enough attention mass was preserved and no recovery path when it was not. The needed signal already exists inside the kernel. The fraction of softmax mass on the selected tokens, which we call coverage, satisfies an exact algebraic equality with per-step output error and serves a dual role as the acceptance criterion and the interpolation weight for recovery. Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention (CVSA) turns coverage into a training-free, closed-loop verify-then-correct decode loop that accepts high-coverage drafts and recovers only the heads that fall short, with no sampling, no draft model, and no speculative-decoding infrastructure. Quality varies by only $0.14$ points across the threshold sweep; budget and scheduling ablations characterize the deployed operating point. On LongBench at 7B and 70B, CVSA comes within $1.13$ points of dense attention, statistically matching it at 70B, and it loses $0.8$ points on RULER; measured median decode-step speedup reaches $6.21\times$ at 128K context.

translation.title: 覆盖度验证的稀疏注意力：面向长上下文 LLM 解码的闭环质量控制
translation.abstract: 稀疏注意力通过读取 KV cache 的一个子集来加速长上下文解码，但现有方法是开环的：kernel 一旦做出选择便不再回头，没有任何信号表明是否保留了足够的注意力质量，也没有在不足时的恢复路径。所需的信号其实已存在于 kernel 内部。所选 token 上的 softmax 质量占比（我们称之为覆盖度，coverage）与每步输出误差之间满足精确的代数等式，可同时充当接受判据和恢复时的插值权重。Coverage-Verified Sparse Attention（CVSA）将覆盖度转化为一个免训练的闭环“先验证后纠错”解码循环：接受高覆盖度的草稿，仅对未达标的 head 进行恢复，无需采样、草稿模型或投机解码基础设施。质量在阈值扫描范围内仅波动 0.14 分；预算与调度消融实验刻画了部署工作点。在 7B 和 70B 的 LongBench 上，CVSA 与稠密注意力的差距在 1.13 分以内，在 70B 上统计上与之持平；在 RULER 上损失 0.8 分；实测 128K 上下文下解码步速中位数加速达 6.21 倍。
translation.brief: 利用 kernel 内部可精确度量输出误差的 softmax 覆盖度信号，构建免训练的闭环验证-纠错稀疏注意力解码机制，在保持质量的同时实现长上下文加速。

papers.title: SLA-Aware Task Offloading in the IoT Edge-Cloud Continuum: Class-Weighted Deep Reinforcement Learning Against an Exact Optimum
papers.abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) is often used to decide where Internet of Things (IoT) tasks with different latency limits run in the edge-cloud continuum, yet some methods give every missed task the same penalty and few compare their agents with an optimal policy. This benchmark study builds four offloading systems small enough to solve exactly by dynamic programming and measures reward and learner against the optimum. A bonus for a met limit makes each miss cost its penalty plus the bonus, which shifts the class weights of published per-class rewards. A class-blind penalty stays 65% to 118% above the optimal cost even with a perfect learner, while a corrected per-class penalty comes within 0.13% of the optimum. With a per-class reward, tuned proximal policy optimization (PPO) agents come within 9% to 11% of the optimum in the smallest system, and the corrected one beats a tuned reservation rule in 9 of 10 seeds. In larger systems the agents stay 41% to 76% above the optimum, and a tuned rule beats their mean. Training ten times longer does not close this gap, and a PPO-Lagrangian agent with reachable targets does no better than the per-class reward.

translation.title: 面向 SLA 的 IoT 边缘-云连续体任务卸载：以精确最优解为参照的类加权深度强化学习
translation.abstract: 深度强化学习（RL）常被用于决定具有不同时延限制的物联网（IoT）任务在边缘-云连续体中的运行位置，但一些方法对每个未达标任务给予相同的惩罚，且很少有方法将其智能体与最优策略进行比较。这项基准研究构建了四个小到可以用动态规划精确求解的卸载系统，并对照最优解度量奖励与学习器。对达成 SLA 的奖励使每次违约的成本等于惩罚加上奖励，这改变了已发表的按类别奖励的类权重。即使学习器完美，类盲惩罚的成本仍比最优成本高 65% 至 118%，而修正后的按类惩罚可逼近最优解至 0.13% 以内。采用按类奖励时，调优后的 proximal policy optimization（PPO）智能体在最小系统中达到最优解的 9% 至 11% 以内，且修正版本在 10 个随机种子中的 9 个上胜过调优后的预留规则。在更大的系统中，智能体仍比最优解高出 41% 至 76%，且调优规则胜过它们的平均值。将训练时长延长十倍也无法缩小这一差距，而带有可达目标的 PPO-Lagrangian 智能体也不比按类奖励更好。
translation.brief: 构建可用动态规划精确求解的 IoT 任务卸载基准，揭示类盲惩罚设计的缺陷并通过类加权奖励修正来改进深度强化学习卸载策略。

papers.title: Agent2BIM: A Systematic Evaluation of Reality-Capture Configurations and Prior Models for As-Built Modeling
papers.abstract: AI agents can generate as-built Building Information Models (BIMs) from reality-capture data, but the evidence required for accurate reconstruction remains unclear. This paper presents Agent2BIM, an agent-based Scan-to-BIM framework, and evaluates seven capture configurations in a research laboratory and a mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) scene. Inputs include 360° panoramas, smartphone video, smartphone LiDAR, terrestrial laser scanning (TLS), TLS with posed panoramas, and imagery supplemented by prior IFC models. Outputs are compared against TLS-verified reference models for component detection, geometric accuracy, and MEP connectivity. In the laboratory, component recall ranged from 84% to 100%, but only 9% of components reconstructed from panoramas were within 20 cm of their reference positions, compared with 86% using smartphone LiDAR. In the MEP scene, scale-free inputs recovered 11 - 43% of components, versus 75 - 93% for metric inputs. Prior IFC models improved MEP reconstruction but could propagate inaccuracies. The results highlight the complementary roles of visual and metric evidence in agent-based Scan-to-BIM.

translation.title: Agent2BIM：面向竣工建模的实景采集配置与先验模型的系统性评估
translation.abstract: AI 智能体可以从实景采集数据生成竣工建筑信息模型（BIM），但精确重建所需的证据仍不清楚。本文提出 Agent2BIM，一个基于智能体的 Scan-to-BIM 框架，并在一个研究实验室和一个机电管道（MEP）场景中评估了七种采集配置。输入包括 360° 全景图、智能手机视频、智能手机 LiDAR、地面激光扫描（TLS）、带位姿全景图的 TLS，以及由先验 IFC 模型补充的影像。输出与经 TLS 验证的参考模型在构件检测、几何精度和 MEP 连接性方面进行比较。在实验室中，构件召回率在 84% 到 100% 之间，但从全景图重建的构件中只有 9% 位于参考位置 20 cm 以内，而使用智能手机 LiDAR 时为 86%。在 MEP 场景中，无尺度输入恢复了 11% - 43% 的构件，而带尺度输入为 75% - 93%。先验 IFC 模型改善了 MEP 重建，但可能传播不准确信息。结果突出了视觉证据与度量证据在基于智能体的 Scan-to-BIM 中的互补作用。
translation.brief: 该论文通过 Agent2BIM 智能体框架系统评估七种实景采集配置（及 IFC 先验模型）在 Scan-to-BIM 竣工建模中的表现，核心方法是对比不同输入证据与 TLS 参考模型在构件检测、几何精度与 MEP 连接性上的重建效果。

papers.title: MMGraph-Agent: Agentic Multimodal RAG via Cache-Inspired Multimodal Knowledge HyperGraphs
papers.abstract: Driven by increasingly complex real-world applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has evolved from textual pipelines to multimodal settings, comprising two complementary dimensions: knowledge organization and retrieval enhancement. However, existing methods still face challenges of high construction cost, context window limitations, and the lack of unified training across offline and online knowledge sources. To address these challenges, we propose MMGraph-Agent, a unified multimodal RAG framework based on cache-inspired multimodal knowledge hypergraphs. MMGraph-Agent enables extremely lightweight hypergraph construction with zero API cost and dynamic memory-based retrieval that alleviates long-context issues. Experiments across offline, online, and joint retrieval settings demonstrate consistent improvements in performance, efficiency, and architectural unification. Our software and data are publicly available at https://github.com/LHRLAB/MMGraph-Agent.

translation.title: MMGraph-Agent：基于缓存启发的多模态知识超图的智能体多模态 RAG
translation.abstract: 在日益复杂的现实应用驱动下，检索增强生成（RAG）已从文本流水线发展为多模态场景，包含两个互补维度：知识组织与检索增强。然而，现有方法仍面临构建成本高、上下文窗口限制以及离线与在线知识源缺乏统一训练等挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出 MMGraph-Agent，一个基于缓存启发的多模态知识超图的统一多模态 RAG 框架。MMGraph-Agent 以零 API 成本实现极轻量的超图构建，并通过基于动态记忆的检索缓解长上下文问题。在离线、在线和联合检索设置下的实验表明，该方法在性能、效率和架构统一性方面均取得一致提升。我们的软件与数据已在 https://github.com/LHRLAB/MMGraph-Agent 公开。
translation.brief: 该论文针对多模态 RAG 构建成本高与长上下文受限的问题，提出以缓存启发的多模态知识超图为核心的统一框架 MMGraph-Agent，实现零 API 成本的轻量超图构建与动态记忆检索。

papers.title: Two-Timescale Trajectory Control, Task Reassignment and Resource Scheduling for Multi-UAV Cooperative Mobile Edge Computing
papers.abstract: Uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV)-assisted mobile edge computing (MEC) is a promising technology, leveraging the advantages of UAVs including flexible deployment, wide coverage, and reliable wireless communication. In this paper, we study the task reassignment and offloading problem in a multi-UAV cooperative operating environment, and consider the real occurrence that the computing tasks arrive more frequently than UAVs make flight decisions. In addition, we also take into account the position offset of the UAV during flight and the unavailability of the UAV due to external interference. We propose a two-timescale optimization framework, where the trajectory of the UAV is carried out on a large timescale, while the task reassignment and computing resource allocation are jointly optimized on a small timescale. The core objective is to maximize the long-term average system gain, which takes both energy consumption and task delay into account. To address the UAV trajectory optimization problem under large timescale constraints, we propose a constrained multi-agent deep reinforcement learning algorithm. For decision-making within small timescale, to jointly optimize task offloading decisions and computing resource allocation, we integrate convex optimization with a heuristic algorithm. Finally, we conduct extensive simulations to evaluate the proposed algorithms against the baseline, achieving a 24% reduction in latency and a 28% reduction in total system cost.

translation.title: 多无人机协同移动边缘计算的双时间尺度轨迹控制、任务重分配与资源调度
translation.abstract: 无人机（UAV）辅助的移动边缘计算（MEC）是一项前景广阔的技术，具有部署灵活、覆盖范围广和无线通信可靠等优势。本文研究多无人机协同运行环境下的任务重分配与卸载问题，并考虑计算任务到达频率高于无人机飞行决策频率的真实情形。此外，我们还考虑无人机飞行过程中的位置偏移以及因外部干扰导致无人机不可用的情况。我们提出一个双时间尺度优化框架：无人机轨迹在大时间尺度上执行，而任务重分配与计算资源分配在小时间尺度上联合优化。核心目标是最大化兼顾能耗与任务时延的长期平均系统收益。为解决大时间尺度约束下的无人机轨迹优化问题，我们提出一种带约束的多智能体深度强化学习算法；对于小时间尺度的决策，我们将凸优化与启发式算法相结合，联合优化任务卸载决策与计算资源分配。最后，我们通过大量仿真将所提算法与基线进行对比评估，时延降低 24%，系统总成本降低 28%。
translation.brief: 该论文解决多无人机协同 MEC 中任务重分配与资源调度问题，提出双时间尺度框架：大尺度用带约束多智能体深度强化学习优化无人机轨迹，小尺度用凸优化结合启发式算法联合优化任务卸载与资源分配。

papers.title: Formalizing Patient-Set Semantics for OMOP CDM-Based Clinical Trial Feasibility Assessment:A Neuro-Symbolic Methodology for Traceable Site-Feasibility Patient Counts
papers.abstract: This study examines the interpretation and execution of natural-language eligibility criteria for clinical trial site-feasibility patient-count estimation using the OMOP Common Data Model (CDM). It treats each count as the size of a patient set produced under explicitly declared choices about clinical concepts, temporal conditions, exclusions, proxies, and available data. The study presents NS-CoT, a neuro-symbolic pipeline that uses an LLM to interpret and structure criteria, followed by symbolic processing and deterministic SQL compilation. Intermediate representations and execution records document how criteria are translated into patient sets and counts. Evaluation uses synthetic OMOP CDM data, controlled benchmarks, and a multi-site simulation. Comparisons with a direct-SQL baseline examine execution success, count agreement, patient-set agreement, and preservation of reference-defined site-feasibility labels and rankings. Performance varies across evaluation settings. Layer-wise inspection also supports the identification of implementation and policy errors, followed by correction and re-evaluation. The work investigates the reviewability and fidelity of cohort computation relative to declared reference definitions. It does not establish that these definitions capture a unique clinical ground truth or demonstrate improved recruitment, site selection, or trial outcomes in practice.

translation.title: 基于 OMOP CDM 的临床试验可行性评估中患者集合语义的形式化：一种可追溯站点可行性患者计数的神经符号方法
translation.abstract: 本研究探讨利用 OMOP 通用数据模型（CDM）对自然语言入组标准进行解释与执行，用于临床试验站点可行性的患者计数估计。研究将每个计数视为在明确声明的临床概念、时间条件、排除规则、代理变量及可用数据等选择下生成的患者集合的大小。该研究提出 NS-CoT，一种神经符号流水线：利用 LLM 解释并结构化入组标准，随后进行符号处理和确定性 SQL 编译。中间表示与执行记录记载了标准如何被转换为患者集合与计数。评估使用合成 OMOP CDM 数据、受控基准和多站点模拟。与直接 SQL 基线的比较考察了执行成功率、计数一致性、患者集合一致性，以及参考定义的站点可行性标签与排名的保留程度。性能因评估场景而异。分层检查还有助于识别实现与策略错误，随后进行纠正与重新评估。这项工作探讨了相对于已声明参考定义的队列计算的可审查性与保真度。它并未证明这些定义能捕捉唯一的临床真实标准，也未在实际中证明能改善患者招募、站点选择或试验结果。
translation.brief: 该论文解决临床试验站点可行性患者计数中自然语言入组标准的可追溯执行问题，提出 NS-CoT 神经符号流水线，用 LLM 结构化标准后经符号处理和确定性 SQL 编译生成可审查的患者集合。

papers.title: TransMem: Transition-Aware Retrieval for Evolving Personal Memory
papers.abstract: Long-term personalized agents are increasingly expected to answer queries over user histories in which preferences, goals, and constraints evolve across interleaved conversations. Existing retrieval-based and structured-memory systems can surface relevant facts, but often return isolated memory units that do not explain which earlier preference was refined, contradicted, or superseded by later evidence. We introduce TransMem, a transition-aware memory retrieval framework that stores preference updates as explicit retrieval units alongside ordinary factual memories. During memory construction, TransMem routes user interaction history into topic-structured memory graphs, detects shift events, and grounds them as transition records. At inference time, TransMem first retrieves factual anchors and then adaptively expands over transition records, producing a compact context of factual anchors and accepted transition records. Experiments on PersonaMem and PersonaBench across two Qwen backbones show that TransMem outperforms representative retrieval-based and structured-memory baselines. Controlled analyses further show that transition records and adaptive expansion contribute beyond factual anchoring, chronological expansion, flat transition retrieval, and fixed-hop traversal. These results suggest that preference-update records are useful retrieval units for long-term personalization.

translation.title: TransMem：面向演化型个人记忆的转换感知检索
translation.abstract: 长期个性化智能体越来越被期望能回答涉及用户历史的问题，其中偏好、目标和约束在交错的对话中不断演化。现有的基于检索和结构化记忆的系统可以呈现相关事实，但通常返回孤立的记忆单元，无法说明哪个较早的偏好被后续证据细化、矛盾或取代。我们提出 TransMem，一个转换感知的记忆检索框架，将偏好更新作为显式检索单元与普通事实记忆一同存储。在记忆构建阶段，TransMem 将用户交互历史路由到主题结构的记忆图中，检测转变事件并将其落地为转换记录。在推理阶段，TransMem 首先检索事实锚点，然后自适应地在转换记录上扩展，生成由事实锚点和被接受的转换记录组成的紧凑上下文。在 PersonaMem 和 PersonaBench 上、基于两种 Qwen 骨干模型的实验表明，TransMem 优于代表性的基于检索和结构化记忆的基线。受控分析进一步表明，转换记录与自适应扩展的贡献超越了事实锚定、时间顺序扩展、扁平转换检索和固定跳数遍历。这些结果表明，偏好更新记录是长期个性化中有效的检索单元。
translation.brief: 该论文解决个人记忆检索无法表达偏好演化关系的问题，提出 TransMem 框架，将偏好更新显式存为转换记录检索单元，并在推理时从事实锚点自适应扩展以构建上下文。

papers.title: RetinaGuard: Risk-Controlled Agentic Triage for Multi-Disease Retinal Screening
papers.abstract: Retinal screening programmes need to know which automated decisions can be accepted without review. This paper presents RetinaGuard, an agentic triage framework in which quality, diagnostic, uncertainty, verification and explanation agents gather evidence for each fundus photograph, a learned failure predictor estimates the probability that the decision is unsafe, auxiliary tools are invoked only when their expected value of information exceeds their cost, and the acceptance threshold is certified by conformal risk control. On the RFMiD test split, RetinaGuard was compared with confidence and calibrated-uncertainty referral at matched referral budgets and equal certified safety, using two RETFound primary models of different strength. With the weaker model (macro-AUROC 0.896), verifier disagreement added significant information, RetinaGuard captured 119 of 280 unsafe decisions at a 20% budget against 88 for lowest-confidence referral, and at a nominal 5% unsafe level it accepted 37.0% of cases against 10.3%. With the stronger model (0.925) the verifier added nothing beyond uncertainty and the advantage shrank to a few percentage points. In both settings its coverage at the nominal 5% level stayed near 37.7%, gating cut computation by about 30%, and a quality agent reduced unsafe acceptances under most image corruptions. The benefit of agentic evidence gathering thus depends on how much the primary model's own uncertainty already reveals about its errors.

translation.title: RetinaGuard：面向多疾病视网膜筛查的风险可控智能体分诊框架
translation.abstract: 视网膜筛查项目需要知道哪些自动化决策可以在不经人工复核的情况下被接受。本文提出RetinaGuard，这是一个智能体分诊框架：质量、诊断、不确定性、验证和解释等智能体为每张眼底照片收集证据，学习到的失败预测器估计决策不安全的概率，只有当辅助工具的信息期望价值超过其成本时才调用它们，接受阈值则通过conformal risk control进行认证。在RFMiD测试集上，RetinaGuard在相同转诊预算和同等认证安全水平下与基于置信度和校准不确定性的转诊方法进行比较，使用了两个不同强度的RETFound主模型。在较弱模型（macro-AUROC 0.896）下，验证器分歧提供了显著信息：在20%预算下RetinaGuard捕获了280个不安全决策中的119个，而最低置信度转诊仅捕获88个；在名义5%不安全水平下，它接受了37.0%的病例，而对比方法仅接受10.3%。在较强模型（0.925）下，验证器在不确定性之外没有额外贡献，优势缩小到几个百分点。在两种设置下，其在名义5%水平的覆盖率均保持在37.7%附近，门控机制将计算量削减约30%，质量智能体在大多数图像损坏下减少了不安全接受。因此，智能体证据收集的收益取决于主模型自身的不确定性在多大程度上已经揭示了其错误。
translation.brief: 解决视网膜筛查自动化决策何时可免人工复核的问题，核心方法是让多个智能体收集证据并用失败预测器与conformal risk control认证接受阈值。

papers.title: Machine Hearing: Can Audio LLMs Generalize Beyond Human Auditory Perception?
papers.abstract: Multimodal LLMs have made remarkable progress in perceiving the physical world, while their perceptual scope remains largely human-centric, focusing on what humans can directly see or hear. This progress raises the prospect of perception beyond human limits, such as extending hearing to sounds that are inaudible to humans. More broadly, the physical world is full of waves, vibrations, and oscillations, only a small fraction of which are directly audible to humans. This invites the extension of multimodal LLMs toward a broader form of machine hearing, which remains largely underexplored. To investigate this direction, we introduce the Machine Hearing Benchmark (MHB), comprising 6,128 instances across 13 tasks and seven domains. MHB spans highly heterogeneous input regimes, with sampling rates from approximately $10^{-5}$ to $10^6$ Hz, sequence lengths from $10^1$ to $10^6$ samples, and both single- and multi-channel inputs. Evaluations of current open-source and proprietary Audio LLMs (ALLMs) reveal limited zero-shot transfer to machine hearing. Supervised adaptation on machine-hearing data alone does not close this gap, suggesting that the challenge extends beyond data exposure to a systematic mismatch between existing audio front ends and machine-hearing inputs. To address this mismatch, we introduce MachEar, a lightweight encoder extension that complements the pretrained Audio LLM for machine-hearing inputs. The results show that MachEar equips a pretrained Audio LLM with stronger machine-hearing capabilities while largely preserving its existing audio understanding performance.

translation.title: 机器听觉：音频LLM能否泛化到人类听觉感知之外？
translation.abstract: 多模态LLM在感知物理世界方面取得了显著进展，但其感知范围仍以人类为中心，聚焦于人类能直接看到或听到的东西。这一进展引发了超越人类极限的感知前景，例如将听觉扩展到人类听不到的声音。更广泛地说，物理世界充满波、振动和振荡，其中只有一小部分能被人类直接听到。这促使我们将多模态LLM扩展为更广义的机器听觉，而这在很大程度上仍待探索。为研究这一方向，我们引入了机器听觉基准MHB，包含13个任务、七个领域的6,128个实例。MHB涵盖高度异构的输入模式：采样率从约10^-5到10^6 Hz，序列长度从10^1到10^6个样本，以及单通道和多通道输入。对当前开源和专有Audio LLM（ALLM）的评估显示，它们在机器听觉上的零样本迁移能力有限。仅在机器听觉数据上做监督微调也无法弥合这一差距，表明挑战不仅在于数据暴露不足，更在于现有音频前端与机器听觉输入之间的系统性失配。为此，我们提出MachEar，一个轻量级编码器扩展，为预训练Audio LLM补充机器听觉输入处理能力。结果表明，MachEar使预训练Audio LLM具备更强的机器听觉能力，同时大体保留了其原有音频理解性能。
translation.brief: 解决音频LLM难以处理人类可听范围外信号的问题，核心方法是构建MHB基准并提出轻量编码器扩展MachEar。

papers.title: Perception, Not Reasoning, Limits Visual Theory of Mind
papers.abstract: Vision-language models pass text-based false-belief probes at near-human levels but drop by over twenty percentage points on abstract panels the moment the same problem is conveyed visually. The consensus diagnosis is conceptual, prescribing new belief-reasoning modules. We argue the dominant bottleneck is perceptual: not what the model cannot reason about, but what it cannot see. We propose a five-condition dissociation protocol that holds the reasoning task constant while varying perceptual fidelity from visual only to text only, and quantify the result with the Perceptual Contribution Ratio, the share of the visual-to-text gap a given fidelity closes. We test this on two kinds of scenes: abstract 2D panels in the Heider--Simmel tradition, and naturalistic 3D game scenes from MuMA-ToM and MindPower. The evaluation covers seven VLMs and roughly 159,000 API calls. Ground-truth scaffolds substantially close the gap in every setting, and on the abstract panels and MuMA-ToM they match or exceed the text-only reasoning. Whereas scaffolds built by automatic parsers, including frontier VLMs, fail. The most common error in the visual-only condition is \emph{reality bias}, which accounts for 60\% of false-belief failures. Models report where an object actually is, not where an absent agent believes it is. This points to a perceptual front-end that fails to track which agents were present at each moment. Under the evaluated protocol, structured visual scene-state extraction, rather than belief inference, is the dominant bottleneck for visual ToM.

translation.title: 限制视觉心理理论的是感知而非推理
translation.abstract: 视觉语言模型在基于文本的错误信念探测中接近人类水平，但当同样的问题以视觉形式呈现在抽象图版上时，成绩下降超过二十个百分点。普遍的诊断是概念性的，主张加入新的信念推理模块。我们认为主要瓶颈是感知性的：不是模型无法推理什么，而是模型看不到什么。我们提出一个五条件分离协议，在保持推理任务不变的同时，将感知保真度从纯视觉变化到纯文本，并用感知贡献率来量化结果——即给定保真度能弥合的视觉到文本差距的比例。我们在两类场景上测试：Heider-Simmel传统的抽象2D图版，以及来自MuMA-ToM和MindPower的自然3D游戏场景。评估涵盖七个VLM和约159,000次API调用。真值脚手架在所有设置下都能显著弥合差距，在抽象图版和MuMA-ToM上甚至达到或超过纯文本推理水平；而由自动解析器（包括前沿VLM）构建的脚手架则失败。纯视觉条件下最常见的错误是现实偏见，占错误信念失败的60%：模型报告物体的实际位置，而非缺席智能体相信的位置。这表明感知前端未能跟踪每个时刻哪些智能体在场。在评估协议下，结构化的视觉场景状态提取而非信念推断，是视觉心理理论的主要瓶颈。
translation.brief: 解决VLM视觉心理理论失败的归因问题，核心方法是通过五条件分离协议证明瓶颈在于视觉场景状态提取等感知环节而非推理。

papers.title: R-BED: A Consequence-Aware Framework for System-Level AI Evaluation and Continuous Assurance
papers.abstract: Evaluations of AI systems usually report properties of a model, while decisions to deploy concern a configured system: a model together with prompts, tools, permissions, data, safeguards and an operating context. We ask how evidence about technical failures, deployment-control effectiveness and real-world consequences can be connected to defensible authorization decisions throughout the lifecycle of a deployed system. We present R-BED (Risk-Based Evaluability Design), a specification-level methodology with a fixed 6+4+3 architecture of thirteen diagnostic dimensions (technical failure, deployment controls, consequence and impact); a failure-mediated expected-loss identity that is kept separate from intended-behavior and misuse pathways; bounded evidence statuses with independence levels; a control assurance ladder; five authorization dispositions governed by eight rules; and a Continuous System Evaluation (CSE) layer in which evidence carries a configuration pin, an expiry and declared dependencies, so that a change invalidates evidence in proportion rather than wholesale. We work through a synthetic refund-agent walkthrough, with a deterministic script that reproduces every number, to show how a task-success view can miss a consequential control weakness that the procedure identifies as missing evidence. The contribution is a reproducible methodological specification. Most components are standard practice integrated into one evidence-to-decision record; the Evidence Validity Register, the authority envelope and the tier rules are proposals. None has been empirically validated, and we state seven hypotheses for independent testing.

translation.title: R-BED：面向系统级AI评估与持续保障的后果感知框架
translation.abstract: 对AI系统的评估通常报告模型层面的属性，而部署决策针对的是一个配置好的系统：模型连同提示词、工具、权限、数据、防护措施及运行环境。我们探讨如何将技术故障、部署控制有效性和现实后果的证据，与部署系统整个生命周期中可辩护的授权决策相连接。我们提出R-BED（基于风险的可评估性设计），这是一种规范级方法论，包含固定的6+4+3架构的十三个诊断维度（技术故障、部署控制、后果与影响）；一个故障中介的期望损失恒等式，与预期行为和滥用路径相分离；带独立性级别的有界证据状态；控制保障阶梯；由八条规则管理的五种授权处置；以及持续系统评估（CSE）层——其中证据携带配置钉、有效期和声明的依赖关系，使变更按比例而非整体性地使证据失效。我们通过一个合成退款智能体的演练（附确定性脚本可复现每个数字）展示任务成功视角如何漏掉一个该流程识别为证据缺失的重要控制弱点。其贡献是一份可复现的方法学规范：多数组件是整合进单一证据到决策记录的标准实践，而证据有效性登记簿、权限包和分层规则属于提案，均未经实证验证，我们提出七个假设供独立检验。
translation.brief: 解决AI部署授权缺乏系统级证据到决策方法论的问题，核心方法是提出R-BED规范，将技术故障、部署控制与后果证据通过期望损失恒等式和持续评估层关联到授权决策。

papers.title: AbductionBench: Benchmarking Abductive Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Abductive reasoning is the inference of plausible explanations for observed evidence. Evaluating this capability requires more than a single task: a system may need to generate an explanation, discriminate among competing hypotheses, revise its hypotheses as evidence arrives, or decide what evidence to seek next. Yet these capabilities are typically evaluated through isolated benchmarks with different task formulations and scoring procedures, so claims that a model is ``good at abduction'' may reflect only a narrow aspect of this capability. We introduce AbductionBench, a unified framework whose taxonomy characterizes abductive tasks. We instantiate this framework on 27 datasets spanning ten domains and evaluate eight LLMs from four model families evaluated on single-choice selection tasks. Beyond harmonizing heterogeneous tasks, AbductionBench separates final-answer evaluation from analysis of the observable reasoning traces and interaction histories produced alongside those answers. We analyze written traces as observable model outputs rather than faithful representations of internal computation, characterizing evidence use, hypothesis comparison, uncertainty, contradiction handling, and answer commitment. Jev matches or exceeds small LLMs when selecting among explanations over compact evidence but falls substantially behind on longer cases, suggesting that candidate discrimination and extended evidence integration place different demands on a system. In interactive tasks, the proportion of actions judged relevant declines at later steps, and a relevant first question is associated with a correct final answer; in the passive task, models rarely revise their initial hypothesis as new evidence arrives. Together, these findings highlight the value of evaluating abductive reasoning through both final answers and observable evidence use, hypothesis revision, and information gathering.

translation.title: AbductionBench：大型语言模型溯因推理能力基准
translation.abstract: 溯因推理是对观测证据推断合理解释的过程。评估这一能力需要的不仅仅是单一任务：系统可能需要生成解释、在竞争假设之间判别、随证据到来修正假设，或决定下一步寻找什么证据。然而这些能力通常通过任务形式和评分程序各异的孤立基准来评估，因此模型擅长溯因的说法可能只反映该能力的一个狭窄侧面。我们提出AbductionBench，一个以分类体系刻画溯因任务的统一框架。我们在横跨十个领域的27个数据集上实例化该框架，评估来自四个模型家族的八个LLM在单选题任务上的表现。除了统一异构任务外，AbductionBench还将最终答案评估与对模型产生的可观测推理轨迹和交互历史的分析分开。我们将书面轨迹作为可观测的模型输出而非内部计算的忠实表征来分析，刻画证据使用、假设比较、不确定性、矛盾处理和答案承诺。Jev在与紧凑证据上的解释选择任务中达到或超过小型LLM，但在较长案例上明显落后，表明候选判别与长证据整合对系统的要求不同。在交互任务中，相关动作的比例在后续步骤中下降，且首个相关问题与最终正确答案相关；在被动任务中，模型很少随新证据到来修正初始假设。这些发现共同凸显了通过最终答案与可观测的证据使用、假设修正和信息收集来评估溯因推理的价值。
translation.brief: 解决溯因推理评估碎片化的问题，核心方法是构建统一分类体系AbductionBench，并结合最终答案与可观测推理轨迹分析来评估LLM。

papers.title: Distributed Intelligent Ad Hoc Routing Agents for Communication at Protests During Internet Shutdowns
papers.abstract: Governments around the world are increasingly using internet shutdowns to block digital communication. Internet shutdowns are particularly dangerous during political protests, as they inhibit protesters' ability to organize and communicate critical, potentially life-saving information and may be used to prevent awareness of state-based violence. Recent prior works have explored secure, private messaging systems for use during political protests and internet shutdowns but have encountered long delivery delays or low delivery rates under challenging conditions. In this work, we explore the use of distributed, adaptive, social- and congestion-aware heuristics and efficient communication patterns to create an intelligent ad hoc routing protocol in which network agents learn and leverage the network social environment and monitor and respond to dynamic network congestion behaviour to route messages in a time- and resource-efficient manner. Through this exploration, we contribute an intelligent algorithm and protocol which overall achieves comparable or higher delivery rates relative to the leading dynamic clique routing protocol which it extends while also transmitting messages through notably fewer carriers and, when network devices have larger amounts of buffer storage, transmitting fewer message-related packets. We additionally contribute a further understanding of routing limitations and challenges and conceptualizations of extensions of intelligent dynamic clique routing to overcome them.

translation.title: 面向互联网断网期间抗议活动通信的分布式智能 Ad Hoc 路由代理
translation.abstract: 世界各国政府日益使用互联网断网来阻断数字通信。断网在政治抗议期间尤其危险，因为它阻碍抗议者组织和传达关键的、可能救命的信息的能力，并可能被用来阻止人们知悉国家暴力行为。近期已有工作探索了在政治抗议和断网期间使用的安全、私密的通信系统，但在困难条件下遇到了送达延迟长或送达率低的问题。在本工作中，我们探索使用分布式、自适应、社交感知与拥塞感知的启发式方法以及高效的通信模式，构建一种智能 ad hoc 路由协议，其中网络代理学习并利用网络社交环境，监测并响应动态网络拥塞行为，以在时间和资源上高效的方式路由消息。通过这一探索，我们贡献了一种智能算法和协议，总体上相比其扩展所基于的领先动态派系路由协议（dynamic clique routing protocol）取得了相当或更高的送达率，同时使用明显更少的携带者传输消息，并且当网络设备拥有更大缓冲存储时，传输更少与消息相关的数据包。我们还进一步深化了对路由限制与挑战的理解，并提出了智能动态派系路由的扩展构想以克服这些困难。
translation.brief: 解决互联网断网下抗议者消息送达率低、延迟高的问题，方法是构建融合社交与拥塞感知的自适应智能 ad hoc 路由协议。

papers.title: From User Behaviors to Satisfaction Judgments: Reasoning about User Satisfaction with AI Overviews
papers.abstract: The growing presence of AI overviews in everyday search makes their effective evaluation essential. Response quality has been the primary focus of existing evaluation research, with only a small number of studies examining the user perspective. These evaluations rely on queries and response content, leaving the information conveyed by user behavior insufficiently utilized. This work investigates satisfaction prediction for AI overviews from a user-centered perspective and incorporates behavioral signals into the prediction process. Applying existing behavior-based satisfaction prediction methods from traditional information retrieval to this setting, however, presents limitations. We address these limitations with STaRS, an LLM-based approach designed specifically for predicting satisfaction with AI overviews. At its core is a structured reasoning procedure: individual behavioral signals are interpreted first, and their implications then inform the prediction of user satisfaction. Reinforcement learning further optimizes this procedure, while a reward shaping mechanism alleviates reward sparsity during training. Evaluation on two real-world datasets demonstrates that STaRS outperforms the comparison methods in satisfaction prediction, providing search providers with a practical means of accurately estimating users' satisfaction with AI overviews.

translation.title: 从用户行为到满意度判断：对 AI Overviews 用户满意度的推理
translation.abstract: AI overviews 在日常搜索中日益普及，使其有效评估变得至关重要。响应质量一直是现有评估研究的主要焦点，只有少数研究考察用户视角。这些评估依赖查询和响应内容，而用户行为所传达的信息未被充分利用。本工作从以用户为中心的视角研究 AI overviews 的满意度预测，并将行为信号纳入预测过程。然而，将传统信息检索中现有的基于行为的满意度预测方法应用于此场景存在局限。我们用 STaRS 解决这些局限，这是一种专为预测 AI overviews 满意度设计的基于 LLM 的方法。其核心是一个结构化推理过程：先解读单个行为信号，再利用其含义预测用户满意度。强化学习进一步优化该过程，同时奖励塑形（reward shaping）机制缓解训练中的奖励稀疏问题。在两个真实数据集上的评估表明，STaRS 在满意度预测上优于对比方法，为搜索服务提供商提供了准确估计用户对 AI overviews 满意度的实用手段。
translation.brief: 解决仅靠查询与响应内容无法有效评估 AI Overviews 用户满意度的问题，方法是提出基于 LLM 结构化行为信号推理并结合强化学习的 STaRS 方法。

papers.title: No Second Run: Does RSI Stop at Frontier Pre-training?
papers.abstract: Pre-training is where every foundation model begins; bringing recursive self-improvement (RSI) there would let AI improve the process that creates AI. Yet public RSI work has so far targeted only post-training, which starts from an existing base model, runs trials costing GPU-hours, and returns verifiable scores. Pre-training breaks all three conditions at orders-of-magnitude higher cost: a run consumes hundreds of thousands of GPU-hours over months and cannot be repeated; its objective, post-training headroom, cannot be read off any single score; and what must improve is not a model but the whole production system, from data pipelines and training infrastructure to the teams that run them. To our knowledge, we are the first to apply RSI to an entire frontier pre-training run from scratch and to report it in detail. RSI does not stop at frontier pre-training, but it changes form: since no end-to-end loop can close over a single unrepeatable run, we decompose it into smaller loops that can, each repairing a step the full run breaks. The result is 801-30B-A3B-Base, a 30B-A3B MoE trained from scratch on 11.8T tokens in three months by a newly formed team. We release it as a base model; the lightweight SFT reported here (6B tokens, no RL) only probes post-training headroom. As a base model, 801-30B-A3B outperforms Qwen3-30B-A3B and Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B, trailing only the larger Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, and keeps this position under identical SFT; with lightweight SFT alone, it achieves the highest average on four agentic benchmarks against fully post-trained models, including Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Since post-training RSI presupposes a strong base model, bringing RSI into pre-training acts on the foundation every later stage builds on. We open-source 801-30B-A3B-Base and the lightweight SFT data at https://github.com/GAIR-NLP/801-30B .

translation.title: 没有第二次运行：RSI 止步于前沿预训练吗？
translation.abstract: 预训练是每个基础模型的起点；将递归自我改进（RSI）引入预训练将使 AI 能够改进创造 AI 的过程。然而公开的 RSI 工作迄今仅针对后训练，其从已有基础模型出发，运行耗费 GPU 小时的试验，并返回可验证的分数。预训练在数量级更高的成本下打破了所有这三个条件：一次运行消耗数十万 GPU 小时、历时数月且不可重复；其目标——后训练的提升空间——无法从任何单一分数中读取；需要改进的不是模型，而是整个生产系统，从数据管线、训练基础设施到运行它们的团队。据我们所知，我们是首个将 RSI 应用于从零开始的完整前沿预训练运行并详细报告的工作。RSI 并未止步于前沿预训练，而是改变了形式：由于没有任何端到端闭环能够围绕单次不可重复的运行闭合，我们将其分解为更小的、可闭合的循环，每个循环修复完整运行所打破的一个环节。其结果是 801-30B-A3B-Base，一个由新组建团队在三个月内用 11.8T tokens 从零训练的 30B-A3B MoE 模型。我们以基础模型形式发布它；本文报告的轻量 SFT（6B tokens，无 RL）仅用于探测后训练提升空间。作为基础模型，801-30B-A3B 优于 Qwen3-30B-A3B 和 Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B，仅落后于更大的 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，并在相同 SFT 下保持这一位置；仅凭轻量 SFT，它在四个 agentic 基准上对包括 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在内的完全后训练模型取得最高平均分。由于后训练 RSI 预设了强大的基础模型，将 RSI 引入预训练作用于所有后续阶段赖以构建的基础。我们在 https://github.com/GAIR-NLP/801-30B 开源了 801-30B-A3B-Base 和轻量 SFT 数据。
translation.brief: 解决如何将递归自我改进（RSI）应用于不可重复、高成本的前沿预训练的问题，方法是将其分解为多个可闭合的小循环并由新团队三个月内从零训练出 801-30B-A3B-Base 模型。

papers.title: Behavioral Evaluation of Large Language Models Under Cognitive Biases in HAZOP Studies
papers.abstract: Hazard and Operability (HAZOP) studies safeguard industrial processes against catastrophic accidents. Large language models (LLMs) increasingly assist HAZOP drafting, yet evaluations rely on lexical overlap. Because LLMs internalize human heuristics, prompts may trigger biased judgments. Whether frontier LLMs withstand cognitive perturbations in safety-critical workflows remains unknown. Here we show across 420 trials that three frontier LLMs resisted 96.8% of cognitive manipulations, rendering overall susceptibility statistically inconclusive. Contrary to assumed broad fragility, models rejected confirmation and availability cues. However, safety-critical risk downgrades emerged under low anchors and gain frames. Thus, automated hazard analysis requires disciplined human-in-the-loop validation.

translation.title: HAZOP 研究中认知偏差下大语言模型的行为评估
translation.abstract: 危险与可操作性（HAZOP）研究保障工业过程免受灾难性事故。大语言模型（LLM）日益协助 HAZOP 起草，但评估依赖词汇重叠。由于 LLM 内化了人类启发式思维，提示可能触发有偏的判断。前沿 LLM 能否在安全关键工作流程中抵御认知扰动仍属未知。我们在 420 次试验中表明，三个前沿 LLM 抵御了 96.8% 的认知操纵，使总体易感性在统计上无法定论。与所假设的普遍脆弱性相反，模型拒绝了确认与可得性线索。然而，在低锚定和收益框架下出现了安全关键的风险降级。因此，自动化危害分析需要严格的人在回路（human-in-the-loop）验证。
translation.brief: 解决前沿 LLM 在 HAZOP 安全关键流程中是否易受认知偏差影响这一未知问题，方法是通过 420 次试验注入锚定、框架等认知操纵进行行为评估。

papers.title: CyberBinGym: Can AI Agents Turn Binary Patches into Real Exploits?
papers.abstract: Security fixes usually reach users as compiled updates, but deployment delays leave unpatched systems exposed. During this window, comparing patched and unpatched binaries can reveal how to exploit a vulnerability, turning a defensive update into actionable information for attackers. Existing benchmarks do not measure this capability: they expose source code, rely on human-crafted challenges, or evaluate binary comprehension without requiring exploitation. We introduce CyberBinGym, a benchmark containing 100 tasks derived from real vulnerabilities in 53 widely used projects, spanning six vulnerability families and three levels of analysis complexity. Agents receive stripped vulnerable and patched binaries without source code or vulnerability information, and must combine static and dynamic analysis to recover and exploit the vulnerability. Evaluation separately measures vulnerability recovery through differential crash testing and end-to-end exploitation through flag retrieval, with trajectory audits to reject reward hacking. The strongest evaluated agent recovers the target vulnerability in 88% of tasks and exploits it in 20%. Providing the patched binary raises its exploit rate from 10% to 25% on a matched 20-task subset; with standard binary hardening enabled, it still exploits two of its 20 previously successful tasks. These results demonstrate that current agents can turn released binary patches into working exploits in a controlled setting, although exploitation remains unreliable. These capabilities lower the barriers to targeting unpatched software and compress defenders' effective response window, increasing the urgency of timely patch deployment.

translation.title: CyberBinGym：AI 代理能否将二进制补丁转化为真实漏洞利用？
translation.abstract: 安全修复通常以编译后的更新形式到达用户，但部署延迟使未打补丁的系统暴露在外。在此窗口期内，比较已打补丁与未打补丁的二进制文件可以揭示如何利用漏洞，将防御性更新转化为对攻击者可利用的信息。现有基准无法衡量这一能力：它们暴露源代码、依赖人工构造的挑战，或仅评估二进制理解而不要求漏洞利用。我们提出 CyberBinGym，一个包含 100 个任务的基准，任务源自 53 个广泛使用项目中的真实漏洞，涵盖六类漏洞和三个分析复杂度级别。代理获得去除符号的易受攻击和已修补二进制文件，无源代码或漏洞信息，必须结合静态与动态分析来恢复并利用漏洞。评估分别通过差分崩溃测试衡量漏洞恢复能力，通过获取 flag 衡量端到端利用能力，并以轨迹审计拒绝奖励作弊（reward hacking）。被评估的最强代理在 88% 的任务中恢复目标漏洞，在 20% 中实现利用。在匹配的 20 任务子集上，提供已修补二进制使其利用率从 10% 提升至 25%；在启用标准二进制加固的情况下，它仍能利用此前成功的 20 个任务中的 2 个。这些结果表明，当前代理能在受控环境中将已发布的二进制补丁转化为可用利用程序，尽管利用仍不可靠。这些能力降低了针对未打补丁软件的门槛并压缩了防御者的有效响应窗口，加剧了及时部署补丁的紧迫性。
translation.brief: 解决缺乏衡量 AI 代理仅凭二进制补丁实现漏洞利用能力基准的问题，方法是构建源自真实漏洞的 CyberBinGym 基准并结合静态与动态分析评估漏洞恢复与端到端利用。

papers.title: REINS: A Self-Evolving Agent Harness for Real-Time Trajectory Planning
papers.abstract: Agent harnesses -- runtime scaffolds that wrap an LLM's reasoning loop with tool dispatch, verification, and persistent memory -- have become the standard substrate for deploying LLMs as autonomous agents, as demonstrated by Claude Code and Codex in software engineering. In trajectory planning, however, this paradigm has not taken hold: existing LLM-based trajectory planning methods either keep the LLM in the decision loop, exceeding the millisecond-level control budget, or offload it to offline rules or training-time supervision -- leaving the runtime planner non-evolving. Intermediate hybrids still lack the verification-and-consolidation loop that makes harnesses reliable. We ask: what runtime harness would let an LLM planner meet real-time constraints while self-evolving into a deployable one? We propose REINS, a harness built on three LLM-planner couplings: LLM outputs are (i) grounded to a learned variable-level dynamics model, (ii) verified via calibrated predicates and forward rollout, and (iii) consolidated into an indexed rule memory that serves future scenes in O(log n) without re-invoking the LLM. The harness closes a self-evolution loop: familiar scenes resolve by memory lookup; novel scenes invoke the LLM, whose verified outputs enrich the memory. Without modifying LLM weights, REINS attains 98%+ compliance, nearly 50% collision reduction, and 1.9-4.6 ms latency on simulated and real-world benchmarks at the tactical decision layer, with LLM invocation rate monotonically declining as memory matures. Code: https://github.com/ZhihongCui/REINS

translation.title: REINS：面向实时轨迹规划的自进化智能体框架
translation.abstract: Agent harness——将LLM的推理循环与工具调度、验证和持久记忆包装起来的运行时支架——已成为将LLM部署为自主智能体的标准基础，Claude Code和Codex在软件工程中的表现即是例证。然而在轨迹规划中，这一范式尚未确立：现有基于LLM的轨迹规划方法要么让LLM处于决策环路中，超出毫秒级控制预算；要么将其卸载到离线规则或训练时监督——导致运行时规划器无法进化。中间的混合方案仍缺乏使harness可靠运行的验证-巩固循环。我们提出的问题：什么样的运行时harness能让LLM规划器满足实时约束，同时自我进化为可部署的规划器？我们提出REINS，一个建立在三种LLM-规划器耦合之上的harness：LLM输出被 (i) 接地到学习到的变量级动力学模型，(ii) 通过校准谓词和前向推演进行验证，(iii) 巩固到索引化规则记忆中，未来场景以O(log n)复杂度直接检索而无需重新调用LLM。该harness闭合了自进化循环：熟悉场景通过记忆查找解决；新场景调用LLM，其经验证的输出进一步充实记忆。在不修改LLM权重的情况下，REINS在仿真和真实世界基准的战术决策层上达到98%+的合规率、近50%的碰撞减少和1.9-4.6毫秒的延迟，且LLM调用率随记忆成熟而单调下降。代码：https://github.com/ZhihongCui/REINS
translation.brief: 该论文解决LLM轨迹规划器难以同时满足实时约束和自我进化的问题，提出通过动力学接地、验证和规则记忆巩固三种耦合构建自进化运行时harness REINS。

papers.title: AERO: Adaptive Ensemble-Disagreement Routing for Oracle Feedback in Sample-Efficient Online RLHF
papers.abstract: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has driven substantial improvements across a wide range of tasks, but the cost of acquiring preference labels remains the dominant bottleneck in the alignment pipeline. While many recent alignment methods improve sample efficiency through active exploration over candidate responses, they typically query the oracle uniformly across contexts, even for contexts where the learned reward estimates are already reliable enough to provide synthetic labels. We propose Adaptive Ensemble-disagreement Routing for Oracle feedback (AERO), a fully online RLHF algorithm built on a Dyna-style model-based RL architecture, in which an ensemble-based Epistemic Reward Model (ERM) serves both as a reward posterior for exploration and as a learned preference-feedback model for synthetic labeling. AERO uses ensemble vote entropy, a Query-by-Committee disagreement measure, combined with an adaptive thresholding mechanism to decide which contexts require oracle feedback and which can instead receive ERM-based synthetic preference labels, concentrating expensive labels where they are most informative. Empirical results across different model families and scales show that AERO achieves highly competitive alignment performance while reducing the required oracle-query budget compared to online DPO and strong active-exploration baselines.

translation.title: AERO：面向样本高效在线RLHF的基于集成分歧的自适应Oracle反馈路由
translation.abstract: 通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）将大语言模型（LLM）与人类偏好对齐已在众多任务上带来显著提升，但获取偏好标注的成本仍是对齐流程中的主要瓶颈。尽管许多近期的对齐方法通过对候选响应的主动探索提高样本效率，它们通常在所有上下文中均匀地查询Oracle，即便在学习到的奖励估计已足够可靠、可提供合成标签的上下文中也是如此。我们提出面向Oracle反馈的自适应集成分歧路由（AERO），一种建立在Dyna式基于模型的RL架构之上的完全在线RLHF算法，其中基于集成的认知奖励模型（ERM）既作为探索用的奖励后验，又作为学习到的偏好反馈模型用于合成标注。AERO使用集成投票熵——一种Query-by-Committee分歧度量——结合自适应阈值机制，决定哪些上下文需要Oracle反馈、哪些可以改用基于ERM的合成偏好标签，从而将昂贵的标注集中在信息量最大的地方。在不同模型家族和规模上的实证结果表明，AERO在降低所需Oracle查询预算的同时，相比在线DPO和强主动探索基线取得了极具竞争力的对齐性能。
translation.brief: 该论文解决RLHF中Oracle偏好标注成本过高的问题，提出AERO用集成投票熵和自适应阈值决定何时查询Oracle、何时使用模型合成标签。

papers.title: Mirage: Provable Defense Against LLM KV Cache Timing Side Channels with Topology-Aware Isolation
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as shared multi-tenant services, relying on advanced optimizations like KV cache and prefix sharing to improve throughput and reduce latency. However, these optimizations introduce a critical vulnerability: attackers can exploit time-to-first-token (TTFT) variations between KV cache hits and misses to infer sensitive prompt tokens via prefix-matching side-channel attacks. Existing defenses indiscriminately restrict cross-tenant cache sharing, which incurs prohibitive performance overhead and negates the fundamental efficiency benefits of the KV cache. We propose Mirage, a topology-aware emission obfuscation framework that provably bounds timing leakage without sacrificing the performance gains of cache sharing. Instead of stalling the GPU or forcing redundant recomputations, Mirage delays token emission at the gateway so the attacker observes a natural cache miss distribution, while the GPU seamlessly continues serving other requests at full speed. Mirage uses a Privacy Odometer that persistently tracks the topological novelty of prefix fan-out expansions to distinguish aggressive probing from benign traffic. Once a prefix exceeds a safety threshold, Mirage engages a two-phase policy that uses a dynamic estimator to pad the TTFT to a calibrated cache-miss baseline. On a 500-sample public corpus across three models, Mirage suppresses the timing side-channel to near the random-guessing floor, while maintaining a significantly lower TTFT than defense baselines. We further show that Mirage withstands a strong adaptive adversary and the same principle carries over to semantic caching layers.

translation.title: Mirage：基于拓扑感知隔离的、可证明防御LLM KV缓存时序侧信道的方法
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署为共享的多租户服务，依赖KV缓存和前缀共享等高级优化来提高吞吐量并降低延迟。然而，这些优化引入了一个关键漏洞：攻击者可以利用KV缓存命中与未命中之间的首token时间（TTFT）差异，通过前缀匹配侧信道攻击推断敏感的prompt token。现有防御不加区分地限制跨租户缓存共享，导致过高的性能开销，抵消了KV缓存的根本效率优势。我们提出Mirage，一个拓扑感知的发射混淆框架，可在不牺牲缓存共享性能收益的情况下可证明地限制时序泄露。Mirage不是暂停GPU或强制冗余重计算，而是在网关处延迟token发射，使攻击者观察到自然的缓存未命中分布，而GPU以全速无缝继续服务其他请求。Mirage使用一个隐私里程表（Privacy Odometer）持续跟踪前缀扇出扩展的拓扑新颖性，以区分激进探测与良性流量。一旦某个前缀超过安全阈值，Mirage启动两阶段策略，使用动态估计器将TTFT填充到校准后的缓存未命中基线。在三个模型上共500样本的公开语料库中，Mirage将时序侧信道压制到接近随机猜测的水平，同时TTFT显著低于防御基线。我们进一步表明Mirage能抵御强自适应攻击者，且同一原理可推广到语义缓存层。
translation.brief: 该论文解决LLM共享服务中前缀匹配KV缓存时序侧信道泄露敏感prompt的问题，提出Mirage通过网关延迟token发射并动态填充TTFT来混淆时序而不牺牲缓存性能。

papers.title: BlenderFORGE: Framework for Optimizing Reactive 3D-Graphics Editing Ability of MLLMs
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promise as interactive agents, yet precise, programmatic 3D graphics editing remains difficult to train because existing systems largely rely on closed-source model APIs and lack deterministic, state-verifiable execution environments. We present BlenderFORGE, a trainable data-environment-optimization framework for open-weight MLLM agents that edit explicit Blender scenes through Blender Python (bpy) code generation. BlenderFORGE targets four fundamental state-verifiable editing task families: object placement, shape-key editing, lighting adjustment, and material modification. It integrates three components: (1) a scalable perturbation-based data generation pipeline built from curated assets and large-scale 3D scene repositories; (2) an isolated Blender Sandbox for deterministic code execution, structured state export, and closed-loop reward computation; and (3) a two-stage training pipeline that uses offline teacher trajectories for cold-start Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and sandbox-computed rewards for multi-turn tool-agentic Reinforcement Learning (AgentLoop-RL). Experiments across the four task families show that the resulting open-weight Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3.5-9B BlenderFORGE agents substantially improve over their base models and achieve competitive performance with several zero-shot proprietary MLLM baselines on selected metrics. Additional cross-benchmark evaluations and camera-reframing experiments provide evidence of transfer beyond the original training setting.

translation.title: BlenderFORGE：优化MLLM反应式3D图形编辑能力的框架
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）作为交互式智能体已展现出前景，但精确的、程序化的3D图形编辑仍难以训练，因为现有系统大多依赖闭源模型API，且缺乏确定性的、状态可验证的执行环境。我们提出BlenderFORGE，一个面向开放权重MLLM智能体的可训练的数据-环境-优化框架，这些智能体通过生成Blender Python（bpy）代码来编辑显式的Blender场景。BlenderFORGE面向四类基本的状态可验证编辑任务族：物体放置、形状键编辑、光照调整和材质修改。它集成了三个组件：(1) 基于精选资产和大规模3D场景仓库的可扩展的基于扰动的数据生成管线；(2) 用于确定性代码执行、结构化状态导出和闭环奖励计算的隔离Blender沙箱；(3) 两阶段训练管线，使用离线教师轨迹进行冷启动监督微调（SFT），并使用沙箱计算的奖励进行多轮工具智能体强化学习（AgentLoop-RL）。跨四个任务族的实验表明，得到的开放权重Qwen3-VL-8B和Qwen3.5-9B BlenderFORGE智能体显著优于其基座模型，并在部分指标上与若干零样本专有MLLM基线取得有竞争力的表现。额外的跨基准评估和相机重置实验提供了超越原始训练设置的迁移证据。
translation.brief: 该论文解决开源MLLM缺乏可训练的程序化3D场景编辑能力的问题，提出BlenderFORGE，包含数据生成管线、确定性Blender沙箱和SFT+RL两阶段训练。

papers.title: SIExBench: A Benchmark for Automated Repair of Sensitive Information Exposure
papers.abstract: Modern software systems routinely process credentials, personal records, and other sensitive information. A sensitive information exposure (SIEx) defect makes such information accessible to an unauthorized actor and can cause serious and often irreversible disclosure. However, prior research has focused largely on detecting such exposures rather than repairing the underlying defects, and existing repository-level issue-resolution benchmarks do not specifically target this defect class. We present SIExBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark dedicated to automated repair of SIEx defects. SIExBench contains 161 execution-verified instances from 64 widely used Python and Java repositories, each with an issue report, buggy repository snapshot, developer patch, executable exposure and regression tests, and defect characterization. We evaluate six repair systems with three LLMs, yielding 18 configurations, and systematically analyze their overall effectiveness, performance across defect characteristics, and failure mechanisms. The strongest configuration resolves only 39.1% of the instances, while 40.4% remain unresolved by all 18 configurations. More importantly, 62.1% of unsuccessful attempts produce a valid patch that still leaves sensitive information exposed, making incomplete exposure removal a central challenge. Systems often generate plausible patches and modify relevant code without fully eliminating the exposure, indicating that effective repair must ensure that all relevant paths to sensitive-information exposure are closed. Overall, SIExBench provides a foundation for systematically evaluating and advancing automated repair of sensitive information exposure defects.

translation.title: SIExBench：敏感信息暴露自动修复的基准
translation.abstract: 现代软件系统日常处理凭证、个人记录和其他敏感信息。敏感信息暴露（SIEx）缺陷使这些信息可被未授权者访问，可能导致严重且往往不可逆的泄露。然而，以往研究主要聚焦于检测此类暴露而非修复底层缺陷，且现有的仓库级issue解决基准并未专门针对这一缺陷类别。我们提出SIExBench，据我们所知是首个专门面向SIEx缺陷自动修复的基准。SIExBench包含来自64个广泛使用的Python和Java仓库的161个经执行验证的实例，每个实例都带有issue报告、有缺陷的仓库快照、开发者补丁、可执行的暴露测试和回归测试，以及缺陷特征描述。我们用三个LLM评估了六个修复系统，共产生18种配置，并系统分析了它们的整体效果、在不同缺陷特征上的表现以及失败机制。最强的配置仅解决了39.1%的实例，而40.4%的实例未被全部18种配置中的任何一种解决。更重要的是，62.1%的失败尝试产生了有效补丁但敏感信息仍然暴露，使不完整的暴露消除成为核心挑战。这些系统常常生成看似合理的补丁并修改相关代码，却未完全消除暴露，表明有效的修复必须确保所有敏感信息暴露的相关路径都被关闭。总体而言，SIExBench为系统评估和推进敏感信息暴露缺陷的自动修复提供了基础。
translation.brief: 该论文解决敏感信息暴露缺陷缺乏自动修复基准的问题，提出SIExBench，包含161个经执行验证的实例，并系统评估18种LLM修复配置及其失败机制。

papers.title: Real-Time Threat Classification in Multi-Agent Systems via Topology-Coupled Hidden Markov Models
papers.abstract: Networked multi-agent systems coordinating in adversarial environments face compound cyber threats that alternate between false-data injection (FDI), denial-of-service (DoS), and stealthy decoy perturbations designed to mimic benign operational anomalies. Because the switching policy is latent and the plant dynamics evolve continuously, deterministic threshold detectors struggle to isolate deception without causing excessive false alarms. This paper presents an online, data-driven framework that couples distributed continuous time unknown input observers (UIOs) with a topology-aware Hidden Markov Model (HMM) for real-time attack detection and classification under unknown adversarial strategies. By decoupling FDI signals from augmented node states, distributed observers deployed across the network generate local augmented residuals that are discretized into emission sequences. The HMM embeds the underlying directed communication graph into the off-diagonal blocks of its transition probability matrix, explicitly capturing inter-agent attack propagation. Both transition and observation probabilities are updated recursively online via an Expectation-Maximization (EM) scheme, adapting the classifier to evolving threat behaviours without prior offline calibration. Numerical simulations on a directed network demonstrate that incorporating graph topology into the latent transition dynamics resolves the severe classification ambiguity between nominal and decoy modes, outperforming decoupled agent-independent decoders while restricting observer deployment to a sparse subset of nodes.

translation.title: 基于拓扑耦合隐马尔可夫模型的多智能体系统实时威胁分类
translation.abstract: 在对抗环境中协同工作的网络化多智能体系统面临复合网络威胁，这些威胁在虚假数据注入（FDI）、拒绝服务（DoS）以及旨在模仿良性运行异常的隐蔽诱饵扰动之间交替切换。由于切换策略是潜在的且对象动力学连续演化，确定性阈值检测器难以在不产生过多误报的情况下分离欺骗行为。本文提出一种在线数据驱动框架，将分布式连续时间未知输入观测器（UIO）与拓扑感知隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）耦合，用于在未知对抗策略下的实时攻击检测与分类。通过将FDI信号与增广节点状态解耦，部署在网络中的分布式观测器生成局部增广残差，并将其离散化为发射序列。HMM将底层有向通信图嵌入其转移概率矩阵的非对角块中，显式捕捉智能体间的攻击传播。转移概率和观测概率均通过期望最大化（EM）方案在线递归更新，使分类器适应不断演变的威胁行为，无需预先离线校准。在有向网络上的数值仿真表明，将图拓扑融入潜在转移动力学能够解决正常模式与诱饵模式之间严重的分类歧义，优于解耦的智能体独立解码器，同时将观测器部署限制在节点的稀疏子集上。
translation.brief: 该论文解决未知对抗策略下多智能体网络的实时攻击检测与分类问题，核心方法是将分布式未知输入观测器与嵌入通信图拓扑的隐马尔可夫模型在线耦合。

papers.title: Proximal Preference Optimization: A Unified Framework for Stable and Reward-Free Alignment
papers.abstract: We introduce a proximal preference optimization framework that unifies the implicit reward formulation of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) with the trust-region stability of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). Our framework yields two complementary algorithms. P$^2$O (Proximal Preference Optimization) introduces a clipped importance ratio directly into the DPO preference margin, producing a reward-model-free algorithm that supports safe dataset reuse, bounded policy divergence, and monotonic preference improvement guarantees. PKTO (Proximal Kahneman-Tversky Optimization) extends P$^2$O by replacing the DPO margin with KTO's prospect-theoretic utility margins, adding a self-regulating adaptive baseline that tightens the effective trust region as the policy drifts, and an asymmetric weighting that handles imbalanced or asymmetric preference datasets. We provide a unified theoretical analysis, including Kullback Leibler (KL) trust-region bounds, a policy-improvement lower bound, and convergence guarantees under multi-epoch proximal updates. Empirically, P$^2$O and PKTO match or exceed DPO and KTO in alignment quality while maintaining better stability under repeated dataset reuse across multiple LLMs on three preference benchmarks. The code base is available here.

translation.title: 近端偏好优化：稳定且免奖励对齐的统一框架
