We release the extracted dataset with the complete LLM judge audit logs, as well as the Chemistry Data Extractor Toolkit, an open-source application implementing this end-to-end pipeline in a code-free, browser-based environment for document parsing, customizable schema and prompt design, model-agnostic extraction and auditing, interactive provenance-highlighted review, and reproducible dataset bundling.

translation.title: 用LLM构建与审计化学数据集：应用于均相催化PET解聚的通用LLM-as-a-Judge框架
translation.abstract: 大语言模型可以快速从化学文献中提取结构化的多变量实验数据，但在没有真实标注的情况下验证数千条生成记录仍然困难。我们提出一种通用的、基于引用的提取与验证方法，其核心是一个独立的"LLM-as-a-judge"，并应用于均相催化聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（PET）解聚的文献。在该管道中，提取LLM从研究论文生成遵循模式的记录，并附带指向以全局唯一标识符（UUID）标记的文档片段的引用；随后独立的LLM评判者阅读完整论文和每条记录，标记无支撑的字段，并提出带引用的修正。提示消融实验表明，要求片段级引用不仅提供了精确到具体段落和表格的来源追溯，还提高了提取准确性。在大规模部署评判者之前，我们用手动评估对其进行了基准测试，测试对象是从295个离子液体催化PET糖酵解实验的手工整理参考集中提取的内容。评判者与人类评估在85.7%的审阅记录上达成一致，且在发现相关实验间的错误方面显著优于启发式字符串匹配基线。部署于来自561篇论文的3942条提取记录后，该框架按原样接受了67.5%的记录。其提出的修正集中于定量字段，提取器在这些字段中常混淆相关实验。我们发布了提取数据集及完整的LLM评判者审计日志，以及Chemistry Data Extractor Toolkit——一个开源应用，在无代码的浏览器环境中实现这一端到端管道，涵盖文档解析、可定制的模式与提示设计、模型无关的提取与审计、交互式的来源高亮审阅以及可复现的数据集打包。
translation.brief: 该论文提出基于引用溯源的LLM-as-a-judge框架，从化学文献提取结构化实验数据并由独立LLM评判者审计修正，解决了无真实标注时大规模数据验证的难题。

papers.title: Finite-Sample and Communication-Efficient Networked Information Aggregation
papers.abstract: Building on SODA 2026 work Kearns et al. (2026), we study learning in directed acyclic graphs in which each agent observes only a subset of the input coordinates and may use the predictions of its parents as additional features. In the finite-sample protocol, the message sent along each edge is the agent's prediction vector on a shared sample, so the communication cost is linear in the sample size $m$. In this paper we study this model under communication constraints. First, we revisit the finite-sample analysis of the full-message protocol. We identify a gap in the finite-sample proof of Kearns et al. (2026) and develop a different argument that establishes a finite-sample population-risk guarantee along paths satisfying deterministic $M$-coverage. Second, we introduce a shared-sketch protocol in which each agent sends a $k$-dimensional linear sketch of its prediction vector instead of the full $m$-dimensional message, where $k\ll m$. We analyze this protocol through a reduction to least squares on the compressed sample together with an oblivious subspace embedding argument. The resulting bound separates statistics from communication: the statistical term is still governed by the original sample size $m$, while the additional error due to compression is controlled by the sketch dimension $k$. For Gaussian sketches, we obtain an explicit high-probability population-risk bound, showing that row subsampling is not the only possible communication-statistics tradeoff for networked information aggregation.

translation.title: 有限样本与通信高效的网络化信息聚合
translation.abstract: 基于 SODA 2026 的 Kearns et al. (2026) 工作，我们研究有向无环图中的学习问题，其中每个智能体仅观察输入坐标的一个子集，并可将父节点的预测作为附加特征。在有限样本协议下，每条边传输的消息是智能体在共享样本上的预测向量，因此通信成本与样本量 $m$ 成线性关系。本文在该模型下研究通信约束问题。首先，我们重新审视全消息协议的有限样本分析，指出 Kearns et al. (2026) 有限样本证明中的一个缺陷，并采用不同的论证方法，在满足确定性 $M$-覆盖的路径上建立了有限样本总体风险保证。其次，我们提出共享草图协议，每个智能体发送其预测向量的 $k$ 维线性草图（$k\ll m$）而非完整的 $m$ 维消息，并通过归约到压缩样本上的最小二乘结合无意识子空间嵌入论证进行分析。所得界限将统计与通信分离：统计项仍由原始样本量 $m$ 决定，而压缩带来的额外误差由草图维度 $k$ 控制。对于高斯草图，我们得到显式的高概率总体风险界，表明行子采样并非网络化信息聚合中唯一可能的通信-统计权衡方式。
translation.brief: 解决有向无环图网络化学习中通信成本过高的问题，核心方法是通过 $k$ 维共享线性草图压缩节点间传输的消息，并修复原有限样本分析的证明缺陷。

papers.title: When Is High-Bandwidth Flash Cost-Effective for LLM Inference?
papers.abstract: Can high-bandwidth flash (HBF) make LLM inference cheaper than adding GPUs? By storing weights closer to the GPU than SSD, HBF may reduce the number of GPUs needed for model capacity. However, this integration is only justified if it meets service targets and its cost is recovered. We simulate this integration using public component data across nine dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, five workloads, two GPU platforms, and 1--100 GPUs. At fixed demand, HBF reduces the minimum GPU count to meet a service target in 98 of 468 comparisons; majority of them are paused and short sessions, 63 remain cost-effective at half a GPU price per HBF stack. For single short-chat users, HBF enables large MoEs, e.g. DeepSeek V3 and Kimi K2, to meet a relaxed service target on one RTX~4090 GPU, where conventional serving fails. At fixed GPU count, HBF improves throughput in 48\% of matched comparisons below 16 GPUs and 13\% at larger counts. Even at 100 RTX~4090-scale GPUs, cascaded HBF raises offline throughput by 16.4--26.5$\times$ for three large MoEs. We found savings and throughput gains arise in different scenarios.

translation.title: 高带宽闪存在何时对 LLM 推理具有成本效益？
translation.abstract: 高带宽闪存（HBF）能否让 LLM 推理比增加 GPU 更便宜？通过将权重存储在比 SSD 更靠近 GPU 的位置，HBF 可能减少满足模型容量所需的 GPU 数量。然而，只有当这种集成满足服务目标且成本能够回收时才是合理的。我们使用公开组件数据，在九个稠密和混合专家（MoE）模型、五种工作负载、两个 GPU 平台以及 1–100 个 GPU 的设置下模拟这种集成。在固定需求下，HBF 在 468 项比较中的 98 项里减少了满足服务目标所需的最小 GPU 数量，其中多数为暂停和短会话场景，63 项在每 HBF 堆栈半价 GPU 的价格下仍具成本效益。对于单个短对话用户，HBF 使大型 MoE 模型（如 DeepSeek V3 和 Kimi K2）能够在单个 RTX 4090 GPU 上满足宽松的服务目标，而传统服务方式则无法做到。在固定 GPU 数量下，HBF 在低于 16 GPU 的匹配比较中 48% 提升了吞吐量，在更大规模下为 13%。即使达到 100 个 RTX 4090 规模的 GPU，级联 HBF 仍为三个大型 MoE 模型将离线吞吐量提升 16.4–26.5 倍。我们发现成本节约和吞吐量提升出现在不同的场景中。
translation.brief: 解决高带宽闪存（HBF）集成到 LLM 推理系统中是否划算的问题，核心方法是基于公开组件数据在多种模型、工作负载和 GPU 规模下进行成本与吞吐量的模拟评估。

papers.title: Advancements in Cloud-Native Systems: A Systematic Mapping Study of Reliability and Scalability across Cloud-Native, Edge-Native and AI-Enabled Systems
papers.abstract: Cloud-native systems now extend to the network edge and host artificial-intelligence (AI) workloads, including AI agents, but evidence on their reliability and scalability is scattered and uneven. We report a PRISMA 2020 systematic mapping study with an evidence-graded synthesis. Five logged OpenAlex searches on 11 October 2026 covered cloud-native systems, edge AI, agentic AI for operations, reliability of agentic applications and physical AI; 189 records from an earlier exploratory search were added separately. After 301 duplicate removals and an automated peer-review venue rule, 4,611 records were screened against written criteria and a five-level relevance scale. The review includes 1,794 primary studies from 2017-2026 and 95 secondary studies, with every decision released in Dataset S1. Each primary study was assigned to a 13-category taxonomy and graded as simulation, prototype or testbed, production data, production deployment, or not determinable from the abstract. Of 1,003 studies with a determinable level, 66.2% used prototypes or testbeds, 18.0% simulations and 15.8% production data or deployments. A 93-study synthesis core, appraised from indexed abstracts, shows production deployments of cascading-failure prevention, trace- and graph-based root-cause analysis and predictive autoscaling, and production-trace evaluations of cold-start mitigation. Edge reliability and physical AI rely mainly on simulations and testbeds. AI-agent reliability uses tool-grounded diagnosis, explicit safety properties, trace-driven repair and workload-aware scheduling, while empirical studies show that agent frameworks remain fragile. Conclusions are limited to the documented corpus. The principal gaps are production evidence for edge-native systems, shared resilience benchmarks and dependable agentic operations.

translation.title: 云原生系统的进展：关于云原生、边缘原生与 AI 使能系统可靠性与可扩展性的系统性映射研究
translation.abstract: 云原生系统现已扩展到网络边缘并承载人工智能（AI）工作负载（包括 AI 智能体），但关于其可靠性和可扩展性的证据分散且不均衡。我们报告了一项基于 PRISMA 2020 的系统性映射研究，并采用证据分级综合。2026 年 10 月 11 日在 OpenAlex 上记录了五次检索，涵盖云原生系统、边缘 AI、面向运维的智能体 AI、智能体应用的可靠性以及物理 AI；另单独加入来自早期探索性检索的 189 条记录。经 301 次去重和自动同行评审期刊规则处理后，依据书面标准和五级相关性量表筛选了 4,611 条记录。该综述纳入 2017–2026 年的 1,794 项原始研究和 95 项次级研究，所有决策均发布于 Dataset S1。每项原始研究被归入 13 类分类体系，并分级为仿真、原型或试验台、生产数据、生产部署，或无法从摘要判定。在 1,003 项可判定等级的研究中，66.2% 使用原型或试验台，18.0% 使用仿真，15.8% 使用生产数据或部署。由 93 项研究构成的综述核心（基于索引摘要评估）显示：级联故障预防、基于轨迹和图的根因分析以及预测性自动扩缩容已有生产部署，冷启动缓解也有了生产轨迹评估。边缘可靠性和物理 AI 主要依赖仿真和试验台。AI 智能体可靠性采用基于工具的诊断、显式安全属性、轨迹驱动的修复和工作负载感知调度，而实证研究表明智能体框架仍然脆弱。结论仅限于所收录的文献。主要缺口是边缘原生系统的生产证据、共享的韧性基准以及可靠的智能体化运维。
translation.brief: 解决云原生、边缘原生与 AI 使能系统可靠性与可扩展性研究证据分散的问题，核心方法是按 PRISMA 2020 开展系统性映射研究并做证据分级综合。

papers.title: Agents Propose, Code Verifies, Humans Decide: Verified Agentic Ingestion of Heterogeneous Scientific Tables into Relational Databases
papers.abstract: Public scientific datasets rarely arrive analysis-ready. They arrive as messy folders of wide matrices, long tables, spreadsheets, and per-cohort files whose keys and encodings differ, and every reanalysis must reconnect them first. A coding agent can automate this, but its mistakes can look plausible, and without an audit trail, a mistake that corrupts data can go uncaught. We present an AI-assisted ingestion pipeline built on one rule: LLM agents propose, deterministic code verifies, and humans decide. Narrow agents see compact, citable evidence about the files, never the data, and return typed proposals. A verifier with 39 check types tests each proposal against that evidence in two loops, one for the schema's structure and one for its meaning, and a human reviewer approves the schema and the load. Code compiles PostgreSQL DDL, reshapes the data, quarantines rows it cannot place, records provenance, and reconciles every staged row against the database. On four public biomedical datasets, one held out from development, 9 of 20 first proposals failed a check and every failure was caught: the loops repaired eight, and a one-line reviewer edit fixed the ninth. All 45.1 million values loaded with zero reconciliation gap. Discovering a dataset's structure took 4-7 LLM calls and preparing its data at most one more, costing under $0.50 per dataset. In a separate test, each of nine planted data errors was quarantined with a reason or recorded in an audit log.

translation.title: 智能体提议、代码验证、人类决策：经验证的异构科学表格向关系数据库的智能体化摄取
translation.abstract: 公开科学数据集很少以可直接分析的形态出现。它们以杂乱的文件夹形式到来，包含宽矩阵、长表、电子表格和按队列划分的文件，其键和编码各不相同，每次再分析都必须先重新关联它们。编码智能体可以自动化这一过程，但其错误可能看起来合理，且若没有审计记录，损坏数据的错误可能不被发现。我们提出一个 AI 辅助的摄取管线，基于一条规则：LLM 智能体提议，确定性代码验证，人类决策。狭窄的智能体只看到关于文件的紧凑、可引用的证据，而不接触数据本身，并返回带类型的提议。一个包含 39 种检查类型的验证器在两个循环中根据证据测试每个提议，一个针对模式的结构，一个针对其含义，人类审阅者则批准模式和加载。代码编译 PostgreSQL DDL、重塑数据、隔离无法安放的行、记录数据来源，并将每个暂存行与数据库进行核对。在四个公开生物医学数据集（其中一个在开发过程中保留）上，20 个首次提议中有 9 个未通过检查且每个失败都被捕获：循环修复了八个，审阅者的一行编辑修复了第九个。全部 4510 万个值以零核对差异完成加载。发现一个数据集的结构需要 4–7 次 LLM 调用，准备数据最多再多一次，每个数据集成本低于 0.50 美元。在另一项测试中，九个植入的数据错误每个都被隔离并给出原因或记录在审计日志中。
translation.brief: 解决异构科学数据集难以自动化加载入关系数据库且 LLM 错误难被发现的问题，核心方法是让 LLM 智能体提议、确定性代码双循环验证、人类最终决策并全程记录审计线索。

papers.title: PRISM: Preference-based Reward and Uncertainty-Integrated Synthesis Minimization for RTL PPA Optimization
papers.abstract: This paper introduces a budget-aware, multi-objective framework (called PRISM) for RTL optimization that improves power, performance, and area (PPA) while sharply limiting expensive commercial synthesis tool calls. Starting from a synthesizable baseline and functional testbench, the method iterates through LLM-driven rewrite generation, fast compile/simulation equivalence filtering, low-cost proxy feature extraction, and selective commercial synthesis tool (Synopsys Design Compiler (DC)) evaluation. To prioritize which candidates deserve high-quality synthesis, we train a preference-based reward model using pairwise ranking supervision derived from commercial synthesis tool outcomes, and combine ensemble uncertainty with a diversity-aware acquisition rule to avoid early bias and redundant evaluations. A key advantage is that PRISM maintains a best-tradeoff set G of non-dominated designs throughout the run: G preserves the best solutions found so far, is fed back into generation and refinement, and enables consistent, cumulative improvements rather than repeatedly restarting from the baseline. Across RTLLM v2.0 modules, the approach consistently yields post-synthesis gains under fixed commercial synthesis tool call budgets, and ablations confirm that reward-guided selection and candidate dropping are central to sample-efficient progress. PRISM efficacy is evaluated across multiple technology nodes (7 nm, 15 nm, and 45 nm) using identical pipelines without retraining.

translation.title: PRISM：面向 RTL PPA 优化的偏好型奖励与不确定性融合的综合最小化方法
translation.abstract: 本文提出一个预算感知的多目标框架（称为 PRISM）用于 RTL 优化，在大幅限制昂贵的商业综合工具调用次数的同时改善功耗、性能和面积（PPA）。从一个可综合的基线和功能测试台出发，该方法迭代进行 LLM 驱动的重写生成、快速编译/仿真等价性过滤、低成本代理特征提取以及选择性的商业综合工具（Synopsys Design Compiler (DC)）评估。为了优先选择值得高质量综合的候选设计，我们使用从商业综合工具结果中得到的成对排序监督训练一个偏好型奖励模型，并将集成不确定性与多样性感知的采集规则相结合，以避免早期偏差和冗余评估。一个关键优势是 PRISM 在整个运行过程中维护一个非支配设计的最优权衡集合 G：G 保留迄今找到的最佳解，并反馈到生成和精炼环节，从而实现持续的累积改进，而不是反复从基线重启。在 RTLLM v2.0 模块上，该方法在固定的商业综合工具调用预算下始终带来综合后收益，消融实验证实奖励引导的选择和候选剔除是样本高效进展的核心。PRISM 的有效性在多个工艺节点（7 nm、15 nm 和 45 nm）上以相同管线、无需重新训练进行评估。
translation.brief: 解决 RTL PPA 优化中商业综合工具调用成本过高的问题，核心方法是结合 LLM 重写生成、偏好型奖励模型与不确定性及多样性感知的候选选择，并维护非支配设计集合持续迭代改进。

papers.title: Symbolic Synthesis with Token-Level LLM Guidance
papers.abstract: We propose a synergistic combination of classical program synthesis techniques and contemporary large language models (LLMs) to solve the problem of recursive program synthesis from first-order logic specifications. Our approach leverages the strengths of both paradigms: we use LLMs as a source of statistical bias to guide the search for a correct program. At the same time we use techniques from classical synthesis to short-circuit on semantically incorrect prefixes and to avoid sampling semantically equivalent responses. The statistical bias is derived from the next-token distribution of an LLM, which is highly context-dependent. We operate with the understanding that (1) there is some class of synthesis instances that can be discharged by small models and symbolic tools, and (2) every other instance can be decomposed into these instances. Therefore, our intention is to expand the reach of small, open-weight LLMs and symbolic synthesis techniques, not to compete with proprietary frontier models on every possible instance. These are different tools for different jobs. In our experimental evaluation, we find that our method solves more benchmarks than either small LLMs or classical synthesis techniques alone. Our method solves 30/32 benchmarks using only a Qwen2.5 model with 32 billion parameters. Qwen2.5 solves 0 benchmarks on its own, and only solves a few additional benchmarks when combined with traditional constrained decoding techniques.

translation.title: 基于词元级 LLM 引导的符号化程序合成
translation.abstract: 我们提出将经典程序合成技术与当代大语言模型（LLM）协同结合，以解决从一阶逻辑规约出发的递归程序合成问题。我们的方法利用两种范式各自的优势：使用 LLM 作为统计偏置的来源来引导正确程序的搜索；同时使用经典合成技术在语义错误的前缀上快速剪枝，并避免采样语义等价的响应。统计偏置源自 LLM 的下一词元分布，该分布高度依赖上下文。我们的出发点是：(1) 存在某类合成实例可以由小模型和符号工具解决；(2) 其余实例都可以分解为这类实例。因此，我们的目标是扩展小型开源权重 LLM 和符号合成技术的能力范围，而不是在所有可能的实例上与专有前沿模型竞争。这些是针对不同工作的不同工具。在实验评估中，我们发现我们的方法比单独使用小型 LLM 或经典合成技术解决了更多的基准问题。我们的方法仅使用一个 320 亿参数的 Qwen2.5 模型就解决了 30/32 个基准问题。Qwen2.5 单独使用时解决了 0 个基准问题，即使与传统的约束解码技术结合也只能多解决几个基准问题。
translation.brief: 针对从一阶逻辑规约进行递归程序合成的问题，提出用 LLM 下一词元分布作为统计偏置引导符号化搜索，并结合经典合成技术剪除语义错误前缀、避免等价响应。

papers.title: What Does Multiple Choice Actually Measure? Disentangling Video Understanding from Option Exploitation
papers.abstract: Video understanding evaluations are intended to measure a model's proficiency in video perception and task solving. However, current VideoQA benchmarks struggle to isolate these capabilities due to their reliance on multiple-choice (MC) answer guidance, language priors, and fragile scoring pipelines. Disentangling these confounding factors reveals how much of a model's score is supplied by the evaluation context rather than earned through faithful perception. Across six VideoQA benchmarks of varying length, we find that accuracy is significantly above chance without any visual input. This is caused by shortcutting and option-prior reliance. We express these effects in the language of faithfulness: option-exploitation and answer-conditioned reasoning traces are unfaithful even when they are correct. Together, our results show that a VideoQA score is jointly determined by language priors, option timing, and how outputs and labels are converted into correctness. We produce a novel Option-Delayed Replay (ODR) mechanism that discloses options at controlled stages of an open-ended (OE) trajectory, to obtain objective MC scores from faithful option-free inference. Our work demonstrates that agentic methods with ODR and faithful inference can match option-exploiting performance. Finally, we formalize our diagnostic collection and ODR as a reproducible evaluation protocol, and we release a human-relabelled edition of LVBench (correcting $20.5\%$ of keys) to remove annotation noise as a confounding variable.

translation.title: 选择题究竟测的是什么？将视频理解能力与选项利用解耦
translation.abstract: 视频理解评测旨在衡量模型在视频感知与任务求解方面的能力。然而，当前的 VideoQA 基准因依赖选择题（MC）答案提示、语言先验以及脆弱的评分流程，难以隔离这些能力。将这些混淆因素解耦后，可以揭示模型得分中有多少来自评测环境本身，而非通过忠实感知获得。在六个长度各异的 VideoQA 基准上，我们发现在没有任何视觉输入的情况下，准确率仍显著高于随机水平。这是由走捷径和对选项先验的依赖造成的。我们用忠实性的语言来表达这些效应：即使答案是正确的，选项利用和以答案为条件的推理轨迹也是不忠实的。我们的结果表明，VideoQA 分数是由语言先验、选项呈现时机以及输出与标签如何转换为正确性共同决定的。我们提出了一种新颖的选项延迟回放（Option-Delayed Replay, ODR）机制，在开放式（OE）推理轨迹的受控阶段才揭示选项，从而从无选项的忠实推理中获得客观的 MC 分数。我们的工作表明，结合 ODR 与忠实推理的智能体方法可以达到选项利用式方法的性能。最后，我们将诊断数据集与 ODR 形式化为可复现的评测协议，并发布了经过人工重新标注的 LVBench 版本（修正了 20.5% 的答案键），以消除标注噪声这一混淆变量。
translation.brief: 针对 VideoQA 多选评测中选项利用与语言先验混淆模型真实视频理解能力的问题，提出在开放式推理轨迹受控阶段延迟揭示选项的 ODR 机制并发布人工修正的 LVBench。

papers.title: GARP: Real-Time Generative Agents on Local Hardware in a Game Engine
papers.abstract: Generative agents are game characters whose plans, conversations, and memories are written on the fly by a large language model (LLM). The original Generative Agents demonstration used cloud inference in a custom simulation. We present GARP, a platform for real-time generative agents inside Godot, and describe the Character Behavior System used in GARP 2. The complete loop runs on local hardware using a 3B-parameter open-weight model and no cloud service. Alongside the original planning, memory, and reflection, GARP gives each agent an emotion system driven by LLM appraisal, four graded personality axes drawn from the Big Five that set simulation parameters as well as prompt text, six needs whose urgency grows over time, and pairwise relationships updated after every conversation. The system narrows 50+ candidate actions to typically 3-8, constrains model responses with JSON schemas, and surfaces important memories in decision prompts. A layered optimization strategy (an adjustable game clock, decisions taken ahead of need, multi-tier caching, prompt compression, and fully asynchronous execution) keeps the game responsive while the model thinks. In a nine-scenario evaluation, 25 of 27 runs passed log-based checks. Both failures occurred in the birthday party scenario, where one guest omitted the event from their daily plan.

translation.title: GARP：在游戏引擎中运行于本地硬件的实时生成式智能体
translation.abstract: 生成式智能体是游戏角色，其计划、对话和记忆由大语言模型（LLM）实时生成。最初的 Generative Agents 演示在自定义模拟中使用了云端推理。我们提出 GARP，一个在 Godot 中实现实时生成式智能体的平台，并介绍 GARP 2 中使用的角色行为系统（Character Behavior System）。完整的循环运行在本地硬件上，使用 30 亿参数的开源权重模型，不依赖云服务。在原有的规划、记忆和反思机制之外，GARP 为每个智能体提供了由 LLM 认知评估驱动的情绪系统、源自大五人格的四个分级人格轴（同时设定模拟参数与提示文本）、六种随时间推移紧迫性增长的需求，以及每次对话后更新的成对关系。系统将 50 多个候选动作缩减到通常 3-8 个，用 JSON schema 约束模型响应，并在决策提示中呈现重要记忆。分层优化策略（可调节的游戏时钟、提前于需求做决策、多级缓存、提示压缩以及完全异步执行）保证模型思考期间游戏保持响应。在九个场景的评估中，27 次运行中有 25 次通过了基于日志的检查。两次失败都发生在生日聚会场景中，其中一位宾客将事件遗漏在自己的日程计划之外。
translation.brief: 针对在本地硬件上实时运行 LLM 驱动游戏智能体的问题，在 Godot 中构建 GARP 平台，用 3B 开源模型结合情绪、人格、需求和关系系统及分层优化策略实现完整闭环。

papers.title: Beyond AUROC: Deployment-Aware Evaluation of Model-Internal Jailbreak Detectors
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in user-facing systems, where jailbreak attacks can bypass safety controls and induce harmful and policy-violating outputs. Recent model-internal detectors use hidden representations, gradients, or internal signals to identify such prompts, but their practical security value depends critically on behavior at low false-positive operating points rather than on area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) alone. We study two data dependencies that shape this behavior: calibration data, which determine the detection threshold, and reference data, which can influence detector scores. Across four model-internal detectors, four LLMs, and twelve jailbreak families, thresholds calibrated on curated benign prompts frequently fail to preserve their false-positive rate (FPR) budgets on real-user traffic. Recalibration improves false-positive control but reveals substantial family-level coverage gaps, including cases with high AUROC but low true-positive rate (TPR). Causal reference-set interventions show that changing reference composition can substantially alter family-level detection and that improving coverage of one attack family can reduce coverage of others. These findings show that calibration and reference data are part of a detector's security behavior. We therefore recommend evaluating model-internal jailbreak defenses using realized FPR on deployment-like traffic and per-family TPR at explicit low-FPR operating points, with AUROC used as a complementary ranking metric rather than the primary security measure.

translation.title: 超越 AUROC：模型内部越狱检测器的部署感知评测
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地部署在面向用户的系统中，越狱攻击可以绕过安全控制并诱发生成有害和违反策略的输出。近期基于模型内部信号的检测器利用隐藏表示、梯度或内部信号来识别此类提示，但其实际安全价值关键取决于低误报工作点上的行为，而不仅仅是受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）。我们研究了塑造这种行为的两类数据依赖：决定检测阈值的校准数据，以及可能影响检测器得分的参考数据。在四种模型内部检测器、四个 LLM 和十二个越狱攻击家族上的实验表明，基于精选良性提示校准的阈值在真实用户流量上经常无法维持其误报率（FPR）预算。重新校准可以改善误报控制，但暴露出显著的家族级覆盖缺口，包括 AUROC 高但真阳性率（TPR）低的情况。对参考集的因果干预表明，改变参考集构成可以大幅改变家族级检测结果，且提升一个攻击家族的覆盖可能降低其他家族的覆盖。这些发现表明，校准数据和参考数据本身是检测器安全行为的一部分。因此，我们建议在部署式流量的实际 FPR 上以及明确低 FPR 工作点的家族级 TPR 上评测模型内部越狱防御，将 AUROC 仅作为辅助排序指标而非主要安全度量。
translation.brief: 针对模型内部越狱检测器评测中 AUROC 无法反映低误报实际部署表现的问题，通过分析校准数据与参考数据两类依赖，提出以部署式流量上的实际 FPR 和各攻击家族 TPR 为核心的评测方法。

papers.title: System Prompts Affect Response Bias More Than Discriminability in LLM Safety
papers.abstract: Large language model safety evaluations often focus on a compliance-refusal tradeoff: models should refuse unsafe requests without refusing safe ones. We argue that this misses a broader form of prompt-conditioned task selection, where the same request can elicit different behaviors depending on the system prompt. We investigate this using a controlled evaluation crossing eight safety-task prompt families with three clarity levels across HarmBench, XSTest, and IHEval. Holding benchmark items fixed, we evaluate 13 models and use signal detection theory to distinguish two possibilities: whether models become better at telling safe from unsafe requests (discriminability), or simply more willing to refuse (response criterion). We find substantial differences in discriminability across models, but system prompts primarily shift the willingness to refuse, with smaller and less consistent effects on discriminability. Increasing prompt clarity makes models more willing to refuse without reliably improving their ability to distinguish safe from unsafe requests. Beyond refusal, prompt families also shift responses among six distinct behavioral policies, including clarification and safe help. Together, these findings show that system prompts primarily change how models respond to safety-relevant requests rather than consistently improving their ability to distinguish safe from unsafe ones.

translation.title: 系统提示对 LLM 安全性的影响更多体现在响应偏置而非判别能力
translation.abstract: 大语言模型安全评测通常聚焦于合规-拒绝的权衡：模型应拒绝不安全请求，同时不拒绝安全请求。我们认为这忽略了更广泛的一种由提示条件化引发的任务选择现象：同一请求可能因系统提示不同而引发不同行为。我们通过受控评测来研究这一点，在 HarmBench、XSTest 和 IHEval 上交叉组合八个安全任务提示族与三个清晰度级别。在固定基准题目的条件下，我们评测了 13 个模型，并使用信号检测理论区分两种可能性：模型是更善于区分安全与不安全请求（判别力），还是仅仅更愿意拒绝（响应标准）。我们发现模型之间的判别力差异显著，但系统提示主要改变的是拒绝的意愿，对判别力的影响较小且不一致。提高提示清晰度会让模型更愿意拒绝，但并不能可靠地提升其区分安全与不安全请求的能力。除拒绝之外，提示族还会在六种不同的行为策略之间改变响应，包括请求澄清和提供安全帮助。这些发现表明，系统提示主要改变的是模型对安全相关请求的响应方式，而非持续提升其区分安全与不安全请求的能力。
translation.brief: 针对系统提示如何影响 LLM 安全行为的问题，用信号检测理论在多个基准上区分判别力与响应标准，发现系统提示主要改变拒绝意愿而非安全判别能力。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Guided Reward Labeling for Reinforcement Learning under Limited Feedback
papers.abstract: In reinforcement learning from limited feedback (RLLF), only a small fraction of an offline dataset can be labeled with rewards, and the central question is which samples should be labeled to learn a high-performing policy from the resulting partially labeled dataset. Prior work formalized this as a reward-selection problem by focusing on the selection stage while treating downstream policy learning as a black box, in a regime where queried rewards are not retained for reward-model training. We instead study the retained-label setting, where queried rewards can be stored and used to fit a reward model before policy learning. We bound the suboptimality of the learned policy in terms of two sources of error: one arising from offline RL on a fixed, offline dataset, and the other from uncertainty in the reward model. Since reward selection cannot change the offline dataset, the limited labeling budget must be used to strategically reduce reward uncertainty. Motivated by RLLF's observation that useful rewards tend to keep the agent on high-return trajectories, we introduce Successor-Guided Uncertainty REduction (SURE), a novel method that uses successor features to select rewards that are both uncertain and associated with states from which high-valued states are reachable. We formally derive SURE from a bound-induced design objective and characterize its exact one-step marginal gain. Empirically, SURE reaches near full-feedback performance with few reward labels across a variety of domains and offline-RL backbones, yielding an effective method for feedback-efficient reinforcement learning.

translation.title: 面向有限反馈强化学习的不确定性引导奖励标注
translation.abstract: 在有限反馈强化学习（RLLF）中，只有离线数据集的一小部分样本能被标注奖励，核心问题在于应选择哪些样本进行标注，以便从由此产生的部分标注数据集中学习出高性能策略。先前工作将其形式化为奖励选择问题，聚焦于选择阶段而将下游策略学习视为黑盒，且该场景中查询到的奖励不会被保留用于奖励模型训练。我们转而研究保留标签的设定，即查询到的奖励可以存储并用于在策略学习前拟合奖励模型。我们从两方面误差来源对所学策略的次优性进行了界定：一是来自固定离线数据集上的 offline RL，二是来自奖励模型的不确定性。由于奖励选择无法改变离线数据集，有限的标注预算必须被策略性地用于降低奖励不确定性。受 RLLF 中“有用的奖励往往能让智能体保持在高回报轨迹上”这一观察的启发，我们提出了 Successor-Guided Uncertainty REduction（SURE），一种利用后继特征（successor features）来选择既不确定又与可到达高价值状态的状态相关联的奖励的新方法。我们从由界诱导的设计目标出发形式化推导了 SURE，并刻画了其精确的单步边际增益。实验表明，SURE 在多种领域和 offline RL 骨干上仅用少量奖励标签即可达到接近全反馈的性能，是反馈高效强化学习的一种有效方法。
translation.brief: 研究在部分奖励标注的离线强化学习中选择哪些样本标注奖励的问题，提出利用后继特征选择能同时降低奖励模型不确定性的样本的 SURE 方法。

papers.title: Application-Defined Abstractions to Separate Numerical Intent from Computation Orchestration
papers.abstract: In High-performance Computing the holy grail has been to translate numerical algorithms expressed in mathematical notation into code that performs well across a range of platforms. A variety of portability frameworks have abstracted data layout, parallelization and orchestration from application's view, however, the resulting format is still code that conforms to the idioms of the framework. Additionally, substantial refactoring is typically needed to achieve performance goals. Increasing sophistication of Large Language Models (LLMs) naturally raises the question whether they can be used to make application codes and/or solvers both portable and performant. The obstacle is the lack of correctness guarantee in LLM produced code. In this paper we pose the question differently -- can we start with expressing numerical intent of the code into an immutable core arithmetic component isolated from the surrounding code such that the surrounding code can be safely generated by the LLMs? We answer this question by using Spark, a mature compressible hydrodynamics solver in Flash-X, a multiphysics software system. We use LLM assistance in devising the abstractions and embedding them in the solver. Once properly verified, the resulting solver is lowered to concrete realization deterministically with tools also built with LLM assistance. The driver of the numerics and the code for interfacing with the application are generated by the LLMs. The resulting solver is exercised within Flash-X and with a separate environment we built for this experiment. Our results show that this is a viable approach for producing correct and performance portable code.

translation.title: 应用自定义抽象以将数值意图与计算编排分离
translation.abstract: 高性能计算领域长期追求将数学表示的数值算法转化为在多种平台上都有良好性能的代码。各类可移植性框架已从应用视角抽象了数据布局、并行化和编排，但产出仍是符合框架惯用法的代码，且通常需要大量重构才能达到性能目标。大语言模型（LLM）日益成熟，自然引出了能否用其使应用代码和/或求解器既可移植又高性能的问题，但障碍在于 LLM 生成代码缺乏正确性保证。本文换个角度提出问题：能否先将代码的数值意图表达为一个与周边代码隔离的不可变核心算术组件，从而周边代码可以安全地由 LLM 生成？我们以 Flash-X 多物理场软件系统中成熟的可压缩流体求解器 Spark 来回答这一问题。我们借助 LLM 协助设计抽象并将其嵌入求解器；经过验证后，用同样有 LLM 协助构建的工具将该求解器确定性地降级为具体实现，其中数值驱动和与应用接口的代码由 LLM 生成。该求解器在 Flash-X 及我们为本实验构建的独立环境中运行。结果表明这是产生正确且性能可移植代码的一条可行路径。
translation.brief: 提出将数值算法核心意图封装为不可变算术组件、由 LLM 安全生成周边代码并确定性降级实现的思路，以兼顾代码正确性与可移植高性能。

papers.title: Task presentation and execution paths shape LLM mathematical performance
papers.abstract: Mathematical performance depends on how a language model receives information, uses generated text and submits an answer. We study these dependencies through paired comparisons that separate submission requirements, draft reuse and candidate availability. On 65 development problems, an instruction permitting continued derivation produced no valid final answers in 390 short-output calls; a single-line submission instruction produced 390 format-valid outputs, including 389 parseable answers. Under the fixed submission protocol, 198 problems with failed initial submissions were answered correctly in 9.09p of cases with the question alone, 33.84p with its draft, 46.46p with candidates, and 59.60p with both. Drafts added 13.13 percentage points with candidates fixed, and candidates added 25.76 points with drafts fixed; both effects were significant after Holm correction and were subadditive on the accuracy scale. Retaining a trailing excerpt outperformed retaining a leading excerpt of similar average length by 10.10 points Holm-adjusted p 0.027. A second completion model showed the same directions of input effects on the fixed materials. In a cohort with parseable initial submissions, candidates added no correct answers when the previous draft was supplied, but added 27 points when it was absent. These results establish a conditional value of generated text: a failed submission can leave useful material, whose contribution depends on what else is supplied and what is retained.

translation.title: 任务呈现与执行路径塑造 LLM 的数学表现
translation.abstract: 数学表现取决于语言模型如何接收信息、使用生成的文本以及提交答案。我们通过成对比较来研究这些依赖关系，分别考察提交要求、草稿复用和候选答案可用性。在 65 个开发问题上，允许继续推导的指令在 390 次短输出调用中未产生有效的最终答案；而单行提交指令产生了 390 个格式有效输出，其中 389 个答案可解析。在固定提交协议下，198 个初始提交失败的问题在仅给问题时正确率为 9.09%，附带草稿为 33.84%，附带候选答案为 46.46%，两者皆有时为 59.60%。在候选答案固定的条件下草稿带来 13.13 个百分点提升，在草稿固定条件下候选答案带来 25.76 个百分点提升；经 Holm 校正后两者均显著，且在准确率尺度上呈次可加性。保留尾部摘录比保留平均长度相近的前部摘录高 10.10 个百分点（Holm 校正 p=0.027）。另一个补全模型在相同材料上表现出一致方向上的输入效应。在初始提交可解析的群体中，提供先前草稿时候选答案未带来新的正确答案，而缺失草稿时带来 27 个百分点的提升。这些结果确立了生成文本的条件性价值：一次失败的提交可能留下有用材料，其贡献取决于还提供了什么以及保留了什么。
translation.brief: 通过成对控制实验研究任务呈现方式、提交格式、草稿与候选答案的复用如何影响 LLM 数学作答，发现保留概率/草稿等中间文本能显著提升正确率。

papers.title: Tracing MCP Security Vulnerabilities: Constructing and Analyzing an MCP Security Vulnerability Dataset
papers.abstract: As a core protocol for integrating large language models (LLMs) with external data sources and tools, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) has quickly become a key interface in emerging AI agent systems. As the MCP ecosystem expands, reported vulnerabilities have also increased, creating a growing software-security attack surface. However, MCP vulnerability information remains scattered, noisy, and difficult to study systematically. This paper addresses that gap by constructing a curated MCP vulnerability dataset from CVE disclosures. Starting from 119 MCP-related records retrieved through February 2026, we filter unrelated cases out and obtain a validated snapshot of 24 MCP vulnerabilities. Our filtering methodology explicitly addresses acronym ambiguity and achieves 96.7% inter-rater agreement on a sampled exclusion audit while retaining all known high-severity MCP cases identified in public advisories. Using this initial dataset snapshot, we find that 87.5% of validated vulnerabilities are Critical or High severity, and that injection and path traversal vulnerabilities account for 66.7% of cases. We further identify recurring issues involving insufficient input validation, inadequate access control, and protocol-level security gaps. Through six representative case studies, we illustrate common exploitation patterns and map them to practical defenses. We release the dataset, reproducibility tooling, and a sustainable maintenance workflow as a foundation for future MCP security measurement, benchmarking, and defense research.

translation.title: 追踪 MCP 安全漏洞：构建并分析 MCP 安全漏洞数据集
translation.abstract: 作为将大语言模型（LLM）与外部数据源和工具集成的核心协议，Model Context Protocol（MCP）已迅速成为新兴 AI 智能体系统的关键接口。随着 MCP 生态扩张，报告的漏洞也不断增加，形成了日益增大的软件安全攻击面。然而 MCP 漏洞信息仍然零散、嘈杂且难以系统研究。本文通过从 CVE 披露中构建一个精选的 MCP 漏洞数据集来填补这一空白。从截至 2026 年 2 月检索到的 119 条 MCP 相关记录出发，我们过滤掉无关案例，得到包含 24 个 MCP 漏洞的经过验证的快照。我们的过滤方法明确处理缩写歧义，在抽样排除审计中达到 96.7% 的评分者间一致性，同时保留了公开公告中已识别的全部已知高危 MCP 案例。基于这一初始数据集快照，我们发现 87.5% 的已验证漏洞为 Critical 或 High 级别，注入和路径穿越类漏洞占 66.7%。我们进一步识别出反复出现的问题，包括输入验证不足、访问控制不充分和协议层安全缺口。通过六个代表性案例研究，我们展示了常见的利用模式并将其映射到实际防御措施。我们发布了数据集、可复现工具和可持续维护流程，作为未来 MCP 安全度量、基准测试和防御研究的基础。
translation.brief: 从 CVE 披露中筛选并构建经人工验证的 MCP 漏洞数据集，系统分析漏洞类型与利用模式并映射到防御措施。

papers.title: Beyond Hard Labels: LLM Probabilities Improve Human-Assisted Regression
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for text annotation, but their outputs are often reduced to a single categorical label before downstream analysis. This hardening step discards the model's relative support across categories, which may contain useful information when category boundaries are ambiguous. We study whether retaining the full probability vector improves downstream regression when LLM annotations are combined with a limited amount of human annotation. Using matched soft and hard representations from three LLMs across three social-science text datasets, we compare direct regression and human-assisted correction. Soft inputs are not uniformly better when used directly as outcomes, but after human correction, using the probability vector consistently improves regression efficiency across models and datasets. Analyses of repeated human judgments and controlled simulations further show that these gains arise when probability variation beyond the hard category carries useful information about the human-coded outcome. Our results identify output representation as an important design choice in LLM-assisted measurement and support preserving probability outputs for downstream statistical analysis. Code and reproducibility materials are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/soft-label-LLM-D201/

translation.title: 超越硬标签：LLM 概率改进人机协同回归
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于文本标注，但其输出在下游分析前常被压缩为单个类别标签。这种硬化步骤丢弃了模型在各类别间的相对支持度，而在类别边界模糊时这些信息可能很有用。我们研究在将 LLM 标注与少量人工标注结合时，保留完整概率向量能否改进下游回归。基于三个 LLM 在三个社会科学文本数据集上匹配的软、硬表示，我们比较了直接回归和人工辅助校正。软输入作为回归结果直接使用时并非一致更优，但经过人工校正后，使用概率向量在所有模型和数据集上一致地提升了回归效率。对重复人工判断的分析和受控模拟进一步表明，当超出硬类别的概率变化携带关于人工编码结果的有用信息时，这些增益才会出现。我们的结果将输出表示确立为 LLM 辅助测量中的一个重要设计选择，并支持在下游统计分析中保留概率输出。代码和可复现材料见 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/soft-label-LLM-D201/
translation.brief: 研究在 LLM 文本标注用于回归时保留完整概率向量（软标签）而非单一硬标签的价值，发现结合人工校正后软表示一致提升回归效率。

papers.title: Compositional Conformal Risk Control for Multi-Stage LLM Cascades
papers.abstract: Multi-stage large language model (LLM) cascades balance accuracy and inference cost, but reliable deployment also requires controlling error risk and identifying its sources across stages. We propose Compositional Conformal Risk Control (CompCRC), a risk-control framework for pre-specified multi-stage LLM cascades. We decompose the risk of accepting incorrect answers into additive stage-wise contributions over the full query population, linking local risk budgets to a system-level guarantee. CompCRC constructs and freezes candidate budget allocations and acceptance thresholds, selects one candidate on independent data, and certifies its stage-wise risk contributions on separate held-out data. Under conditional exchangeability, we establish a finite-sample guarantee: the marginal expected accepted-error risk of the complete deployment procedure does not exceed the global risk budget. At the reported comparison budget of $α=0.45$, all three stages of CompCRC pass their local checks on MMLU, GSM8K, and HellaSwag. Compared with Global-CRC, which passes system-level risk certification at the same budget, CompCRC reduces observed accepted-error risk by 1.33--2.00 percentage points, improves final accuracy by 0.67--2.00 percentage points, and reduces weighted inference cost by 30.37\% on HellaSwag. The selected cost-based budget allocation also improves accuracy per unit cost by 10.6\%--46.7\% over uniform allocation. Further experiments show that stage-wise statistics identify stages that fail local certification checks, providing diagnostic information alongside system-level risk control.

translation.title: 面向多阶段LLM级联的组合式保形风险控制
translation.abstract: 多阶段大语言模型（LLM）级联在精度与推理成本之间取得平衡，但可靠部署还需要控制错误风险并识别风险在各阶段的来源。我们提出组合式保形风险控制（CompCRC），一个面向预先指定的多阶段LLM级联的风险控制框架。我们将接受错误答案的风险分解为整个查询总体上各阶段的加性贡献，将局部风险预算与系统级保证联系起来。CompCRC构建并冻结候选的预算分配和接受阈值，在独立数据上选择一个候选方案，并在单独的留出数据上认证其各阶段风险贡献。在条件可交换性下，我们建立了有限样本保证：完整部署程序的边际期望接受错误风险不超过全局风险预算。在报告的比较预算α=0.45下，CompCRC的所有三个阶段均在MMLU、GSM8K和HellaSwag上通过局部检查。与在同一预算下通过系统级风险认证的Global-CRC相比，CompCRC将观测到的接受错误风险降低1.33--2.00个百分点，最终精度提高0.67--2.00个百分点，并在HellaSwag上降低加权推理成本30.37%。所选的基于成本的预算分配相比均匀分配也将单位成本精度提升10.6%--46.7%。进一步实验表明，阶段级统计量能识别未通过局部认证检查的阶段，在系统级风险控制之外提供了诊断信息。
translation.brief: 解决多阶段LLM级联中错误风险控制与风险来源定位问题，核心方法是将风险分解为各阶段加性贡献并通过保形风险控制认证阶段级预算分配与阈值。

papers.title: LongCap: Hour-Scale Timestamped Audio Captioning via Chunk-wise Processing
papers.abstract: Describing hours of audio requires accurate event timing and sustained descriptive detail throughout the recording. We present LongCap, a framework for timestamped audio captioning (TAC), with the human-annotated LongCapBench and three diarization-inspired metrics: Timeline Error Rate (TER), Granularity Error Rate (GER), and Caption Similarity (tcpCapSim). LongCap interleaves audio chunks with structured event captions, using relative timestamps and retained context to support length extrapolation within a 1M-token inference context window. Event-level reannotation restores caption detail, while systematic studies examine model scaling, dependency supervision, and self-distillation. LongCap-Diar achieves strong benchmark results and extrapolates to 16 hours of concatenated audio despite training on recordings no longer than 40 minutes. Our TAC models are competitive with Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus on short clips, outperform evaluated baselines in caption similarity and timeline accuracy in segment-level comparisons on LongCapBench-TAC-Long, and caption full recordings approaching two hours. On LongCapBench-TAC, 9B and 35B-A3B offer favorable size-performance tradeoffs, while 122B-A10B substantially improves event-dependency recovery. These findings support long-horizon general audio understanding and provide a foundation for always-on voice agents.

translation.title: LongCap：基于分块处理的小时级时间戳音频描述
translation.abstract: 描述数小时的音频需要在整个录音中准确的事件时间定位和持续的描述细节。我们提出LongCap，一个时间戳音频描述（TAC）框架，并构建人工标注的LongCapBench及三个受说话人分离启发的指标：时间线错误率（TER）、粒度错误率（GER）和描述相似度（tcpCapSim）。LongCap将音频块与结构化事件描述交错处理，利用相对时间戳和保留的上下文，在1M token推理上下文窗口内支持长度外推。事件级重标注恢复描述细节，系统研究考察了模型扩展、依赖监督和自蒸馏。LongCap-Diar在基准测试中取得优异成绩，尽管训练录音不超过40分钟，仍能外推到16小时的拼接音频。我们的TAC模型在短片段上与Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus具有竞争力，在LongCapBench-TAC-Long的片段级比较中在描述相似度和时间线准确性上超越所有受评估的基线，并可对接近两小时的完整录音进行描述。在LongCapBench-TAC上，9B和35B-A3B提供了良好的规模-性能权衡，而122B-A10B显著改善了事件依赖恢复。这些发现支持长时程通用音频理解，并为常驻语音智能体奠定基础。
translation.brief: 解决小时级录音的准确事件定位与细节描述问题，核心方法是分块处理音频并结合相对时间戳、上下文保留与事件级重标注实现时间戳音频描述。

papers.title: From Game Generation to Game Playing: Fully Automated Ability Training for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Training vision-language-action (VLA) models to follow gameplay instructions across diverse games is limited by the cost of collecting demonstrations. We introduce a framework that automatically generates game environments and expert demonstrations. An LLM-powered agent uses game-building tools to construct executable environments and tasks targeting specified skills. Programmatic experts then use privileged simulator state to generate aligned instructions, rendered observations, and keyboard and mouse actions. We train our game policy, Script2Play, by post-training a 4B vision-language model with behavior cloning on 150.3 hours of synthetic Minecraft and Roblox gameplay, without human gameplay demonstrations or reinforcement learning. Evaluation on multiple public game benchmarks demonstrates that Script2Play follows gameplay instructions effectively and generalizes across game engines, highlighting the effectiveness of targeted synthetic supervision.

translation.title: 从游戏生成到游戏游玩：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的全自动能力训练
translation.abstract: 训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型以遵循跨多种游戏的游玩指令受到演示收集成本的限制。我们引入一个自动生成游戏环境和专家演示的框架。LLM驱动的智能体使用游戏构建工具来构建针对指定技能的可执行环境和任务。程序化专家随后利用特权模拟器状态生成对齐的指令、渲染观察以及键盘和鼠标动作。我们通过在150.3小时的合成Minecraft和Roblox游戏数据上以行为克隆对4B视觉-语言模型进行后训练，得到我们的游戏策略Script2Play，无需人类游戏演示或强化学习。在多个公开游戏基准上的评估表明，Script2Play能有效遵循游戏指令并跨游戏引擎泛化，凸显了针对性合成监督的有效性。
translation.brief: 解决VLA模型训练演示数据收集成本高的问题，核心方法是用LLM智能体自动生成游戏环境并由程序化专家产生合成演示用于行为克隆训练。

papers.title: Do Benign-Trained Hidden-State Probes Detect Tool Errors Under Adversarial Conditions?
papers.abstract: Although hidden-state probes efficiently monitor model operation, it remains unclear whether probes trained on benign tool use remain useful for detecting incorrect actions under adversarial conditions. In this research, we assess this problem from the perspective of operational tool-action correct- ness. we use four AgentDojo suites, four conditions, and three models: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, and GLM- 4.6V-Flash (9B). We perform a five-fold, task-grouped out-of-fold (OOF) evaluation for each model. We train step-specific logistic- regression probes only on benign and non-defended trajectories and evaluate them on held-out trajectories for benign, prompt- injection, system-override, and tool-poisoning conditions. We compare our hidden-state probe to mean tool-call-token entropy, negative mean tool-call-token log-probability, and self-consistency uncertainty. The paired tests highlight six significant differences after Holm correction. All of the tests involve Qwen2.5-14B- Instruct under the system-override condition, with all three scalar uncertainty metrics obtaining higher area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and average precision (AP) than the hidden-state probe. These results suggest that benign-trained hidden-state probes should not be assumed to reliably detect operational tool-action errors under adversarial conditions.

translation.title: 良性数据训练的隐状态探针能否在对抗条件下检测工具错误？
translation.abstract: 尽管隐状态探针能高效监控模型运行，但在良性工具使用上训练的探针在对抗条件下能否继续用于检测错误操作仍不清楚。本研究从操作层面工具动作正确性的角度评估这一问题。我们使用四个AgentDojo套件、四种条件和三个模型：Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct和GLM-4.6V-Flash（9B）。我们对每个模型执行五折、按任务分组的折外（OOF）评估。我们仅在良性和无防御轨迹上训练针对步骤的逻辑回归探针，并在良性、提示注入、系统覆盖和工具投毒条件的留出轨迹上评估。我们将隐状态探针与平均工具调用token熵、负平均工具调用token对数概率和自洽性不确定性进行比较。配对检验经Holm校正后凸显出六处显著差异。所有检验均涉及系统覆盖条件下的Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct，且三个标量不确定性指标的AUROC和平均精度（AP）均高于隐状态探针。这些结果表明，不应假定良性训练的隐状态探针能在对抗条件下可靠地检测操作层面工具动作错误。
translation.brief: 解决良性数据训练的隐状态探针在对抗条件下检测工具错误能力存疑的问题，核心方法是在多种对抗条件下将探针与标量不确定性指标进行系统的折外对比评估。

papers.title: Beyond Code Translation: Agentic Android-to-HarmonyOS Migration
papers.abstract: Migrating Android applications to HarmonyOS is an important yet challenging software engineering task. Existing large language model (LLM)-based migration approaches primarily translate code at the method or file level, overlooking project-wide dependencies and workflow coordination. Moreover, ArkTS, the primary language for HarmonyOS, is relatively low-resource, and migrated applications often lack sufficient tests for reliable verification, making end-to-end migration error-prone. We present A2HTrans, an agentic framework for end-to-end Android-to-HarmonyOS application migration. Rather than performing isolated code translation, A2HTrans decomposes applications into functionality-aware migration tasks, prioritizes them through dependency analysis, and orchestrates translation, validation, and iterative repair within a unified execution workflow. To improve migration reliability, A2HTrans employs a tool-augmented verification strategy that combines compiler-based syntax checking with LLM-based semantic validation and automated repair. We evaluate A2HTrans on 14 Android applications spanning diverse sizes and domains using Claude-Sonnet-4.6 as the underlying migration model. Compared with Claude Code, A2HTrans preserves 8.3% more functional completeness, improves behavioral correctness by 8.0%, and reduces migration time by 28.8%. These results demonstrate that structured agentic execution substantially improves the reliability and efficiency of project-level cross-platform software migration.

translation.title: 超越代码翻译：智能体式Android到HarmonyOS迁移
translation.abstract: 将Android应用迁移到HarmonyOS是一项重要但具挑战性的软件工程任务。现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的迁移方法主要在方法或文件层面翻译代码，忽视了项目级依赖和工作流协调。此外，HarmonyOS的主要语言ArkTS资源相对匮乏，迁移后的应用往往缺乏足够的测试以进行可靠验证，使端到端迁移容易出错。我们提出A2HTrans，一个用于Android到HarmonyOS应用端到端迁移的智能体式框架。A2HTrans不执行孤立的代码翻译，而是将应用分解为功能感知的迁移任务，通过依赖分析确定优先级，并在统一执行工作流中编排翻译、验证和迭代修复。为提高迁移可靠性，A2HTrans采用工具增强的验证策略，将基于编译器的语法检查与基于LLM的语义验证和自动修复相结合。我们使用Claude-Sonnet-4.6作为底层迁移模型，在14个不同规模和领域的Android应用上评估A2HTrans。与Claude Code相比，A2HTrans多保留8.3%的功能完整性，行为正确性提高8.0%，迁移时间减少28.8%。这些结果表明，结构化的智能体执行能显著提升项目级跨平台软件迁移的可靠性和效率。
translation.brief: 解决LLM代码级翻译忽视项目级依赖且迁移验证不可靠的问题，核心方法是智能体式框架A2HTrans进行功能感知任务分解、依赖优先级排序并结合编译器与LLM的迭代验证修复。

papers.title: Deterministic Narrative Gravity: Bridging Theory of Mind and Historical Simulation through ABM-LLM Architectures
papers.abstract: Historical social simulation faces a fundamental reproducibility challenge: the stochastic nature of large language models (LLMs) introduces a digital butterfly effect that prevents exact replication across multi-turn runs. Furthermore, the inability to control low-level server parameters in commercial LLM hosting environments severely limits reproducibility. To overcome this opacity, we present a deterministic multi-agent framework coupling LLMs to an Agent-Based Modelling (ABM) pipeline grounded in Theory of Mind (ToM) and Cognitive Archaeology, and validate exact artifact identity within local, pinned execution environments using SHA-256 hashing. Run locally at temperature zero with clean per-call model reloads, the system injects differentiated cognitive states per turn through dissonance-driven behavioural modes and gated internal voices. Evaluating seven model configurations spanning 4B to 31B parameters against an ablated baseline reveals clear operational boundaries. Small models ($\leq$8B) suffer from context capacity overload, producing repetitive, specular dialogue loops. However, at $\geq$12B parameters, the ABM scaffolding breaks the monotonous response patterns seen in ablation. Crucially, these scaffolded models exhibit spontaneous diegetic expansion: they coherently expand scenario lore through tactically motivated, anachronism-free details rather than escalating into aggression. By resisting the structural pull toward premature scene closure, scaffolded sessions sustain an open terminal Narrative Vector ($V_N = \mathrm{Open}$ in 12/21 overall; 9/9 in official $\geq$12B configurations) whereas unscaffolded ablation never does (0/21). This framework provides a transparent, auditable benchmark architecture for virtual archaeology, with the full pipeline released as open-source software to enable independent replication.

translation.title: 确定性叙事引力：通过 ABM-LLM 架构桥接心智理论与历史模拟
translation.abstract: 历史社会模拟面临一个根本性的可复现性挑战：大语言模型（LLM）的随机性引入了数字蝴蝶效应，使得多轮运行无法精确复现。此外，商业 LLM 托管环境无法控制底层服务器参数，严重限制了可复现性。为克服这种不透明性，我们提出一个确定性多智能体框架，将 LLM 与基于心智理论（ToM）和认知考古学的基于智能体建模（ABM）流水线耦合，并使用 SHA-256 哈希在本地固定执行环境中验证产物身份的精确一致。系统在本地以零温度运行并每次调用时重新干净加载模型，通过失调驱动的行为模式和门控内部声音在每一轮注入差异化的认知状态。对从 4B 到 31B 参数的七种模型配置与消融基线的评估揭示了清晰的运行边界。小模型（≤8B）因上下文容量过载而产生重复的镜像式对话循环。然而，当参数达到 ≥12B 时，ABM 脚手架打破了消融中出现的单调响应模式。关键的是，这些带脚手架的模型表现出自发的叙事内扩展：它们通过策略性驱动的、无时代错置的细节连贯地扩展场景背景设定，而非升级为攻击性。通过抵抗过早场景收束的结构性引力，带脚手架的会话能够维持开放的终端叙事向量（V_N = Open 在总体 21 次中出现 12 次；在官方 ≥12B 配置中为 9/9），而无脚手架的消融从未出现（0/21）。该框架为虚拟考古学提供了透明、可审计的基准架构，完整流水线以开源软件发布以支持独立复现。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 历史模拟不可精确复现的问题，方法是将 LLM 与基于心智理论的 ABM 流水线耦合，在本地零温度固定环境中通过 SHA-256 验证实现确定性运行。

papers.title: Replay Fidelity in LLM Agent Evaluation: Randomness, Hidden State, and Test Oracles in AppWorld
papers.abstract: Reproducibility in large language model (LLM) agent evaluation depends on replay fidelity: which parts of an execution trace are reconstructed, controlled, and compared. This matters for agent debugging, failure analysis, and counterfactual evaluation of stateful tool use. We audit all 71 unsuccessful executions in a fixed historical AppWorld corpus using 284 isolated fixed-code replay attempts. Reconstructed declared settings admit 42 cases under printed-output, pre-oracle database-delta, and native-verdict/test-count checks; resetting the random-number generator before each interaction admits 68. The 26-case gap contracts to four under database/oracle checks, with one endpoint unknown. Mechanism studies identify four materialized-state discrepancies despite matching outputs and verdicts. In one admitted endpoint pair, an identical API call yields matching responses but different row effects; common future Python RNG removes that deterministic difference in two paired repetitions. A separate JWT credential-equality program and alignment controls expose authentication/write differences, with missing repetitions retained. For all 10 affected post-oracle export cases, native export from retained output trackers restores the reference comparison without changing original cached contents. A purposeful 12-case BFCL pilot shows no discrepancy under its tested public-state, return, and verdict checks. We preserve resource censoring and infrastructure deviations. The contribution is a bounded empirical characterization of replay eligibility, hidden state, and test-oracle integration, without estimating debugger accuracy, repair gains, or method-ranking distortion.

translation.title: LLM 智能体评估中的重放保真度：AppWorld 中的随机性、隐藏状态与测试预言
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体评估的可复现性取决于重放保真度：即执行轨迹的哪些部分被重构、控制和比较。这对智能体调试、失败分析以及有状态工具使用的反事实评估至关重要。我们使用 284 次隔离的固定代码重放尝试，审计了固定历史 AppWorld 语料库中全部 71 次失败执行。重构的声明设置在打印输出、预言前数据库差值和原生判定/测试计数检查下可容纳 42 个案例；在每次交互前重置随机数生成器则可容纳 68 个。在数据库/预言检查下，26 个案例的差距缩小到 4 个，其中 1 个终点未知。机制研究发现了 4 例输出和判定匹配但实体化状态不一致的情况。在一对被纳入的终点中，相同的 API 调用产生匹配的响应但不同的行级影响；在两次配对重复中使用共同的未来 Python RNG 消除了这一确定性差异。一个独立的 JWT 凭据相等程序和对齐控制暴露了认证/写入差异，并保留了缺失的重复。对于全部 10 个受影响的预言后导出案例，从保留的输出跟踪器进行原生导出可恢复参考比较而不改变原始缓存内容。一个有目的的 12 案例 BFCL 试点在其测试的公共状态、返回值和判定检查下未显示差异。我们保留了资源审查和基础设施偏差。本工作的贡献是对重放资格、隐藏状态和测试预言集成的有界经验刻画，而不估计调试器准确率、修复收益或方法排名失真。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 智能体评估中重放执行不忠实的问题，通过对 AppWorld 失败执行的大规模固定代码重放审计，系统刻画随机性、隐藏状态与测试预言对可复现性的影响。

papers.title: SGA-Sparse: Training Native SwiGLU Gates for Activation-Sparse and Low-Bit LLMs
papers.abstract: Activation sparsity can reduce FFN weight traffic during single-user LLM decoding, but active channels must be identified early enough to avoid fetching unused weights. In pretrained SwiGLU models, training-free routing with the native gate performs substantially worse than routing with the up activation at high sparsity. We show that this ordering reverses after sparsity-aware training. Based on this insight, we introduce SGA-Sparse, which converts pretrained SwiGLU LLMs into fixed-budget activation-sparse models by training the existing gate projection directly as a top-k router. SGA-Sparse updates all model parameters end-to-end while preserving the original SwiGLU activation and introducing no auxiliary router parameters. After approximately 30B training tokens, LLaMA models from 1B to 8B achieve uniform per-token 75-85% FFN channel sparsity while remaining within 0.2-2.7 pp of their original dense checkpoints in average zero-shot accuracy. Because post-training quantization degrades sparsity-trained checkpoints, we further study two complementary quantization-aware training (QAT) recipes: continued-QAT largely recovers performance at 4-bit weight quantization, while joint-QAT performs better for the more aggressive sub-4-bit target. To compare activation sparsity with dense low-bit quantization, we translate the sparsity-induced reduction in weight traffic into an equivalent bit-width. Under this unified weight-traffic metric, our 2.5- and 1.5-bit-equivalent models establish a new accuracy-traffic Pareto frontier: the 2.5-bit-equivalent models match dense 3-bit QAT accuracy, while the 1.5-bit-equivalent models approach dense 2-bit models and outperform dense ternary models by 1.3 pp on average. These results establish native-gate training as a practical approach for combining high FFN sparsity with low-bit weights.

translation.title: SGA-Sparse：为激活稀疏与低比特 LLM 训练原生 SwiGLU 门控
translation.abstract: 激活稀疏性可以在单用户 LLM 解码期间减少 FFN 权重流量，但必须尽早识别活跃通道以避免获取未使用的权重。在预训练的 SwiGLU 模型中，高稀疏度下使用原生门控的免训练路由性能显著差于使用 up 激活的路由。我们表明，在经过稀疏感知训练后，这一排序会反转。基于这一洞察，我们提出 SGA-Sparse，通过将现有的门控投影直接训练为 top-k 路由器，把预训练的 SwiGLU LLM 转换为固定预算的激活稀疏模型。SGA-Sparse 端到端更新所有模型参数，同时保留原始 SwiGLU 激活且不引入辅助路由器参数。经过约 30B 训练 token，1B 到 8B 的 LLaMA 模型实现每 token 均匀 75-85% 的 FFN 通道稀疏度，同时平均零样本准确率保持在原始稠密检查点 0.2-2.7 个百分点之内。由于训练后量化会降低稀疏训练检查点的性能，我们进一步研究两种互补的量化感知训练（QAT）方案：continued-QAT 在 4 比特权重量化下基本恢复性能，而 joint-QAT 在更激进的低于 4 比特目标上表现更好。为比较激活稀疏性与稠密低比特量化，我们将稀疏带来的权重流量减少转换为等效比特宽度。在这一统一的权重流量指标下，我们的 2.5 和 1.5 比特等效模型建立了新的准确率-流量 Pareto 前沿：2.5 比特等效模型匹配稠密 3 比特 QAT 的准确率，而 1.5 比特等效模型接近稠密 2 比特模型，并平均超出稠密三值模型 1.3 个百分点。这些结果确立了原生门控训练作为结合高 FFN 稀疏性与低比特权重的实用方法。
translation.brief: 解决如何让预训练 SwiGLU 模型实现高 FFN 激活稀疏度的问题，方法是将原生门控投影直接训练为 top-k 路由器，并结合量化感知训练与低比特权重结合。

papers.title: Welfare in Envy-free Contracts: When Agents Have Sparse Interests
papers.abstract: We study welfare maximization under envy-free contracts, where a principal assigns tasks and offers success-contingent payments to heterogeneous agents with hidden effort. For unit-demand agents, we establish a sharp complexity boundary: the problem is polynomial-time solvable when each agent is interested in at most two tasks, but NP-hard with at most three interests. Our algorithm analyzes tree-structured dependencies among forced assignments and reduces optimization to maximum-weight independent set in a perfect graph. When agents may receive multiple tasks, no polynomial-time constant-factor approximation exists unless $\mathrm{P}=\mathrm{NP}$. Finally, with homogeneous success probabilities and rewards, we establish a welfare- and revenue-preserving equivalence between unit-demand contract design and envy-free pricing. This yields polynomial-time welfare maximization without restricting interests, while revenue maximization remains NP-hard.

translation.title: 无嫉妒契约中的福利：当智能体的兴趣稀疏时
translation.abstract: 我们研究无嫉妒契约下的福利最大化问题，即委托人向具有隐藏努力、偏好各异的智能体分配任务并提供基于成功的支付。对于单位需求智能体，我们建立了清晰的复杂度边界：当每个智能体至多对两个任务感兴趣时，该问题可多项式时间求解；而至多三个兴趣时即为 NP-难。我们的算法分析强制分配之间的树状依赖结构，并将优化归约为完美图中的最大权重独立集问题。当智能体可承担多个任务时，除非 P=NP，否则不存在多项式时间常数因子近似。最后，在成功概率和奖励同质的情况下，我们建立了单位需求契约设计与无嫉妒定价之间保持福利和收益的等价性。这使得在不限制兴趣的情况下也能多项式时间实现福利最大化，而收益最大化仍为 NP-难。
translation.brief: 解决无嫉妒契约下福利最大化的计算复杂度问题，方法是通过分析任务依赖的树状结构将其归约为完美图上的最大权重独立集。

papers.title: TLRS-DPO: Token-Level Risk Scoring for Better Direct Preference Optimization
papers.abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is a simple and widely used alternative to RLHF for aligning large language models (LLMs), but its sequence-level objective cannot precisely locate or suppress the local patterns that make an otherwise acceptable response unsafe or undesirable. We propose TLRS-DPO (Token-Level Risk Scoring for Better Direct Preference Optimization), which augments DPO with fine-grained token-level control while remaining fully offline and reference-based. TLRS-DPO introduces a token-level robust compensation term that converts the policy-reference log-ratio on rejected responses into localized risk scores, a curriculum-style schedule that gradually increases the strength of this compensation during training, and a risk-adaptive screening mechanism that selectively penalizes only high-risk tokens instead of entire sequences. This design bridges sequence-level preference fitting and token-level behavior control, and can be implemented as a drop-in modification to standard DPO trainers. Empirically, TLRS-DPO improves alignment quality and safety-relevant behavior with minimal impact on helpfulness compared to strong DPO baselines.

translation.title: TLRS-DPO：面向更优直接偏好优化的词元级风险评分
translation.abstract: 直接偏好优化（DPO）是一种简单且被广泛使用的 RLHF 替代方法，用于对齐大语言模型（LLM），但其序列级目标无法精确定位或抑制使原本可接受的响应变得不安全或不受欢迎的局部模式。我们提出 TLRS-DPO（Token-Level Risk Scoring for Better Direct Preference Optimization），在保持完全离线和基于参考模型的前提下，为 DPO 引入细粒度的词元级控制。TLRS-DPO 引入一个词元级鲁棒补偿项，将被拒绝响应上的策略-参考对数比转换为局部化风险评分；一个课程式调度在训练中逐渐增强该补偿的强度；以及一个风险自适应筛选机制，只选择性地惩罚高风险词元而非整个序列。该设计衔接了序列级偏好拟合与词元级行为控制，并可作为标准 DPO 训练器的即插即用修改。实证表明，与强 DPO 基线相比，TLRS-DPO 在对 helpfulness 影响很小的情况下提升了对齐质量和安全相关行为。
translation.brief: 解决 DPO 序列级目标无法定位不安全局部模式的问题，方法是将被拒绝响应的词元级 log-ratio 转换为局部风险评分并只惩罚高风险词元。

papers.title: LoMASA: A Local Multi-Agent Sales Assistant with Confidence-Gated Delegation for B2B Quoting
papers.abstract: Frontline sales staff spend much of their day re-coordinating quotes after customers change quantities, ask for discounts or new payment terms, or costs move. We present LoMASA (Local Multi-Agent Sales Assistant), a training-free multi-agent system that runs entirely on one desktop computer. A 35B mixture-of-experts model (System-1) makes each decision in a single forward pass and reads its confidence from the probabilities of the answer options. A 27B dense model (System-2) writes customer replies and escalation briefs and is consulted when System-1 is unsure. Code computes every price, margin and option, and hard pricing rules cannot be overridden. On a test split of 500 simulated episodes with 1512 decisions built from public supply-chain data, the salesperson has to decide only 19.5% of decisions: 38.0% are settled automatically, with a median latency of 2.67 seconds, and 42.5% are escalated to a manager by the hard rules. On the automatically settled decisions LoMASA is as accurate as a rule baseline (0.894 vs.\ 0.894) and makes fewer commitments whose margin later falls below the floor (2.61% vs 4.53%); the price is additional escalations to the manager. Option probabilities are well calibrated without any training, unlike confidence stated in words by the same model. We also report where the design does not help: the 27B model rarely changes a decision.

translation.title: LoMASA：面向B2B报价的置信度门控委托本地多智能体销售助手
translation.abstract: 一线销售人员每天花费大量时间在客户更改数量、要求折扣或新付款条件、或成本变动后重新协调报价。我们提出LoMASA（本地多智能体销售助手），一个完全在一台桌面电脑上运行、无需训练的多智能体系统。一个35B混合专家模型（System-1）在单次前向传播中做出每个决策，并从答案选项的概率中读取置信度。一个27B稠密模型（System-2）撰写客户回复和上报简报，并在System-1不确定时被咨询。代码计算每个价格、利润率和选项，硬性定价规则不可被覆盖。在基于公开供应链数据构建的500个模拟场景、1512个决策的测试集上，销售人员只需决定19.5%的决策：38.0%自动解决，中位延迟2.67秒，42.5%由硬性规则上报给经理。在自动解决的决策上，LoMASA与规则基线同样准确（0.894 vs. 0.894），且做出的承诺中利润率随后低于底线的比例更少（2.61% vs 4.53%）；代价是向经理上报的次数增加。选项概率无需任何训练即校准良好，不同于同一模型用文字表述的置信度。我们还报告了设计不起作用的地方：27B模型很少改变决策。
translation.brief: 解决B2B报价变更需人工反复协调的问题，采用无需训练的System-1/System-2双模型置信度门控委托架构，由代码执行硬性定价规则并自动分流决策。

papers.title: FRESCO: A Novel Consistency Control for Asynchronous Pipeline Parallel Training
papers.abstract: Asynchronous pipeline parallelism can accelerate distributed model training, but suffers from instability caused by inconsistent gradient computations. We identify a fundamental source of this inconsistency: error signals are coupled to forward-time features, not just parameter states. This means that parameters may evolve as long as they preserve forward-equivalence. Leveraging this insight, we introduce FRESCO, which frames asynchronous updates as a constrained optimization problem: it finds the minimal update modification that acts trivially on the activation subspace. We demonstrate that FRESCO consistently outperforms representative asynchronous baselines in LLM pre-training, with the gains most pronounced under deep pipelines and high inconsistency levels: at pipeline depth 32, it reaches the same loss as the strongest baseline with 43% fewer iterations and 30% less wall-clock time, while requiring 8~921$\times$ less memory overhead. Moving beyond the current limitations, FRESCO establishes a new foundation for high-utilization pipeline parallel training, providing a scalable path for large-model development on diverse, resource-constrained systems.

translation.title: FRESCO：一种用于异步流水线并行训练的新型一致性控制方法
translation.abstract: 异步流水线并行可以加速分布式模型训练，但会受到梯度计算不一致引起的不稳定性的困扰。我们识别出这种不一致的一个根本来源：误差信号与前向时刻的特征耦合，而不仅仅是参数状态。这意味着只要参数保持前向等价，它们就可以演化。利用这一洞察，我们提出FRESCO，将异步更新构建为一个约束优化问题：找到对激活子空间作用可忽略的最小更新修改。我们证明FRESCO在LLM预训练中持续优于代表性异步基线，在深流水线和高不一致水平下收益最为显著：在流水线深度为32时，它以少43%的迭代次数和少30%的墙钟时间达到与最强基线相同的损失，同时内存开销减少8~921倍。超越当前局限，FRESCO为高利用率流水线并行训练奠定了新基础，为在多样化、资源受限的系统上开发大模型提供了可扩展的路径。
translation.brief: 解决异步流水线并行训练中因梯度不一致导致不稳定的问题，将异步更新建模为对激活子空间作用可忽略的最小修改的约束优化问题。

papers.title: A Layer-wise Study of How Style Rewriting Breaks the Calibration of Zero-Shot LLM Fake-News Detectors
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly asked to judge whether a news article is true, and their stated confidence is often taken at face value. We test what happens to that confidence when an article's writing style, but not its facts, is manipulated, as in recent \emph{style attacks} on fake-news detectors. Tracing how the prediction and its confidence form layer by layer inside the network, we study three model families (LLaMA-3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B) on three fake-news benchmarks, and find the same three patterns in every model--dataset pairing. First, on the original articles the models are competent and largely honest judges: they settle on an answer, briefly become overconfident, and then correct their confidence in the final layers. Second, style-rewritten articles break this self-correction: the models become far less accurate, under the strongest attack, worse than random guessing, yet remain just as confident, so they are \emph{confidently wrong} precisely when a warning is most needed. Third, nearly all of the damage comes from rewriting into sensational or emotionally charged styles, while sober, neutral rewrites leave the models' honesty largely intact. The practical implication is that an LLM's confidence about veracity cannot be trusted as a safety signal when an article's style may have been manipulated.

translation.title: 风格改写如何破坏零样本LLM假新闻检测器校准的逐层研究
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被要求判断新闻文章的真伪，其表述的置信度往往被照字面采信。我们测试当文章的写作风格而非事实被操纵时——正如近期针对假新闻检测器的风格攻击——其置信度会发生什么。通过追踪预测及其置信度在网络内部逐层形成的过程，我们在三个假新闻基准上研究三个模型家族（LLaMA-3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B），并在每个模型-数据集配对中发现相同的三种模式。首先，在原始文章上，模型是称职且大体诚实的判断者：它们确定答案，短暂变得过度自信，然后在最后几层修正其置信度。其次，风格改写的文章破坏了这种自我修正：模型的准确度大幅下降，在最强的攻击下甚至低于随机猜测，却仍保持同样自信，因此在最需要警告之时恰好自信地犯错。第三，几乎所有损害都来自改写成耸人听闻或情绪化的风格，而冷静、中性的改写基本不影响模型的诚实性。实践启示是：当文章风格可能被操纵时，LLM对真伪的置信度不能作为安全信号被信任。
translation.brief: 研究风格改写（而非事实篡改）对零样本LLM假新闻检测置信度校准的影响，通过网络逐层追踪预测与置信度的形成机制进行分析。

papers.title: Chatter Attack: Resource Consumption Attack for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: LLMs are powerful but incur substantial inference cost, which can be exploited by malicious users to induce overly long outputs, increasing latency and operational expense. Prior resource consumption attacks either coerce repetition or suppress the end-of-sequence token by lowering its logit value. However, with autoregressive, sampling-based generation, the search space grows exponentially with length and small deviations or unstable trajectories can derail optimization, limiting attack effectiveness and stability. To address this issue, we introduce Chatter Attack, a novel class of resource consumption attacks that optimize adversarial prompts to induce predefined short target phrases, thereby avoiding search-space explosion while still eliciting long responses. Specifically, Chatter Attack triggers self-doubt using short doubt-inducing phrases as the target, and sustains this state throughout generation via inference attention loss and global entropy loss. To extend to black-box settings, we further propose a novel Bayesian Prompt Optimization (BPO) method, which models the objective function globally by constructing a discrete token kernel, efficiently exploring the entire search space using prior information. Extensive experiments across multiple models and datasets show that our method outperforms baselines, with maximum response length increases to 31.5$\times$, and revealing practical resource-depletion risks for real-world LLM inference services.

translation.title: Chatter Attack：针对大语言模型的资源消耗攻击
translation.abstract: LLM强大但推理成本高昂，恶意用户可利用这一点诱导过长的输出，增加延迟和运营开支。已有的资源消耗攻击要么强制重复，要么通过降低序列结束token的logit值来抑制它。然而，在基于采样的自回归生成中，搜索空间随长度呈指数增长，微小的偏差或不稳定的轨迹会使优化脱轨，限制了攻击的有效性和稳定性。为解决这一问题，我们提出Chatter Attack，一类新型资源消耗攻击，通过优化对抗性提示来诱导预定义的短目标短语，从而避免搜索空间爆炸，同时仍引出长回复。具体而言，Chatter Attack以简短的引发怀疑的短语为目标触发自我怀疑，并通过推理注意力损失和全局熵损失在生成全程维持这种状态。为扩展到黑盒设置，我们进一步提出一种新颖的贝叶斯提示优化（BPO）方法，通过构建离散token核全局建模目标函数，利用先验信息高效探索整个搜索空间。在多个模型和数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法优于基线，最大响应长度增至31.5倍，揭示了真实世界LLM推理服务面临的实际资源耗尽风险。
translation.brief: 解决已有LLM资源消耗攻击因搜索空间爆炸而不稳定的问题，通过优化对抗提示诱导短怀疑短语触发自我怀疑并以注意力与熵损失维持，黑盒场景辅以贝叶斯提示优化。

papers.title: ErosionBench: Probing Alignment Decay in Enterprise Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: As enterprises delegate consequential work to multi-agent LLM systems, benign-looking requests can escalate into unsafe actions as they propagate across sessions through poisoned shared state, long-context documents, and trusted peer messages: no single message is malicious, yet the assembled tool action is. Prior benchmarks isolate a single agent under prompt injection or score multi-agent attacks by their final output, leaving cross-session erosion of shared state out of scope. We introduce ErosionBench, an environment-grounded benchmark that executes such attacks and verifies alignment decay at the process level, scoring the realized tool call against authorized intent and provenance with deterministic contracts, not output text. Each scenario is authored as a deterministic state graph before any prose is rendered, so every state change traces to a known cause. It spans four enterprise domains and four decay mechanisms across 1,728 scenarios with matched benign controls, labeled against the OWASP Top-10 for LLM Applications, plus 198 image-based attacks, each paired with a text equivalent, so a defense must survive the same attack in either channel. Perimeter defenses suppress attacks only by over-refusing 54-92% of legitimate work, so a low attack-success rate can conceal severe over-refusal. As a reference defense, we propose a calibrated Meta-Auditor pairing synchronous state checks with asynchronous trajectory monitoring; on a family-disjoint 906-scenario held-out split it reaches 98.5% recall at a 2.9% false-positive rate. Since it monitors trajectory, not surface content, its detection is channel-invariant: the strongest auditor flags image-delivered attacks about as reliably as their text equivalents (recall gap $\leq$2 points per model). Across GPT, Gemini, and Claude auditors, calibration keeps false positives low while recall tracks model capability, strongest for Claude.

translation.title: ErosionBench：探测企业级多智能体系统中的对齐衰减
translation.abstract: 随着企业将重要工作委托给多智能体LLM系统，看似无害的请求可能在跨会话传播中通过被投毒的共享状态、长上下文文档和可信对等消息升级为不安全行为：没有任何单一消息是恶意的，但组装出的工具操作却是。既有基准或在提示注入下隔离单个智能体，或按最终输出对多智能体攻击评分，将跨会话的共享状态侵蚀排除在外。我们提出ErosionBench，一个基于环境的基准，执行此类攻击并在过程层面验证对齐衰减，用确定性契约——而非输出文本——对照授权意图和来源对实际工具调用进行评分。每个场景在渲染任何文本之前都被编写为确定性状态图，因此每个状态变化都可追溯到已知原因。它涵盖四个企业领域和四种衰减机制，共1728个场景并配有匹配的良性对照，按LLM应用OWASP Top-10标注，另含198个基于图像的攻击，每个都与文本等价物配对，因此防御必须在两种渠道中抵御相同攻击。边界防御只有通过过度拒绝54-92%的合法工作才能抑制攻击，因此低攻击成功率可能掩盖严重的过度拒绝。作为参考防御，我们提出一个校准的Meta-Auditor，将同步状态检查与异步轨迹监控相结合；在与模型族不相交的906场景留出集上，它在2.9%的假阳性率下达到98.5%的召回率。由于它监控的是轨迹而非表面内容，其检测与渠道无关：最强的审计器标记图像传递的攻击与其文本等价物同样可靠（每个模型的召回率差距≤2个百分点）。在GPT、Gemini和Claude审计器中，校准使假阳性保持低位，召回率随模型能力提升，其中Claude最强。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体LLM系统中跨会话共享状态侵蚀导致对齐衰减且缺乏过程级评测的问题，构建基于确定性状态图的环境化基准ErosionBench并提出结合同步状态检查与异步轨迹监控的Meta-Auditor防御。

papers.title: How Efficient Is Your Agent? Online Predictive Bounds under Budget Constraints
papers.abstract: We evaluate AI agents in an online setting where tasks arrive sequentially and, before running each task, we construct an upper predictive bound on its \emph{time-to-success}---the number of interactions until the task is completed successfully. Under a limited budget, some runs are stopped early, so their time-to-success is unobserved (right-censored), and the correctness of the bound may be unknown. We introduce \emph{\textbf{PR}edictive Bounds for \textbf{O}nline \textbf{B}udget \textbf{E}fficiency} (\texttt{PROBE}), a method for constructing calibrated upper predictive bounds while adaptively allocating a limited budget across agent tasks to reduce the anticipated coverage deficit. Our method calibrates the bounds online using inverse-probability-weighted feedback together with a correction designed to minimize coverage deficit while remaining unbiased. We prove that \texttt{PROBE} provides a coverage guarantee for any finite time horizon while satisfying the budget constraint. Experiments on software engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and instruction following show that \texttt{PROBE} attains a coverage rate closer to the target level with tighter predictive bounds than a calibrated baseline.

translation.title: 你的 Agent 有多高效？预算约束下的在线预测上界
translation.abstract: 我们在任务按序到达的在线设置中评估 AI agents：在运行每个任务前，为其 time-to-success（即成功完成任务前的交互次数）构造一个预测上界。在预算有限的情况下，某些运行会被提前停止，其 time-to-success 不可观测（右删失），上界的正确性也可能未知。我们提出 PRedictive Bounds for Online Budget Efficiency（PROBE），一种在有限预算内自适应分配到各 agent 任务以减少预期覆盖亏空的方法，同时构造校准的预测上界。我们的方法使用逆概率加权反馈进行在线校准，并辅以一项旨在最小化覆盖亏空同时保持无偏的修正。我们证明 PROBE 在任意有限时间范围内都能提供覆盖保证，同时满足预算约束。在软件工程、检索增强生成和指令遵循任务上的实验表明，与校准基线相比，PROBE 能以更紧的预测上界获得更接近目标水平的覆盖率。
translation.brief: 针对预算受限在线评估中 time-to-success 右删失导致覆盖亏空的问题，提出 PROBE 方法，通过逆概率加权在线校准和自适应预算分配构造满足覆盖保证的预测上界。

papers.title: WarBias: A Bilingual LLM Benchmark of Stereotypes About Internally Displaced People and Veterans
papers.abstract: This paper contains examples of stereotypes about veterans and displaced people that may be offensive or distressing. Social bias benchmarks for language models commonly examine categories such as gender, race, and religion, often drawn from lists of legally protected characteristics. Veterans and internally displaced people (IDPs) fall outside these lists, and stereotypes about them, which can undermine access to employment, housing, and social participation, remain largely absent from language model evaluation. We introduce WarBias, a Ukrainian--English benchmark of stereotypes about these two groups. Built from a taxonomy of 120 stereotype claims grounded in research and monitoring reports, WarBias contains 1,007 stereotype--counter-stereotype--unrelated sentence triplets and 240 multiple-choice questions per language. A Ukrainian language model selected in a blinded human pilot generated the Ukrainian triplets. At least two independent annotators reviewed each triplet in the annotation cohort. The authors revised items in response to the reviews, and the final release was machine-translated into English. Each claim carries a human severity rating. In a baseline evaluation of six models, four prefer stereotypical Ukrainian sentences about at least one group, most strongly about IDPs, while English scores are mostly balanced. WarBias supports complementary evaluations of stereotypical preferences and context-sensitive judgments, and provides paired forget/retain material for unlearning-based bias mitigation. We document the benchmark's construction, intended uses, and limitations, and offer its construction method as a template for analogous benchmarks in other conflict-affected societies.

translation.title: WarBias：关于国内流离失所者和退伍军人刻板印象的双语 LLM 基准
translation.abstract: 本文包含关于退伍军人和流离失所者的刻板印象示例，可能具有冒犯性或令人不适。语言模型的社会偏见基准通常考察性别、种族和宗教等类别，这些类别往往来自法律保护特征清单。退伍军人和国内流离失所者（IDPs）不在这些清单之列，而关于他们的刻板印象——可能损害其就业、住房和社会参与机会——在语言模型评估中基本处于缺位状态。我们提出 WarBias，一个关于这两个群体的乌克兰语—英语基准。该基准基于研究和监测报告构建了 120 条刻板印象声明的分类体系，包含每个语言 1,007 组刻板印象—反刻板印象—无关句子三元组以及 240 道多选题。乌克兰语三元组由在盲测人工试点中选出的一款乌克兰语模型生成，注释队列中每个三元组由至少两名独立标注者审阅，作者根据审阅意见修订条目，最终发布版本经机器翻译为英语。每条声明均带有人工严重程度评级。在六个模型的基线评估中，四个模型偏好关于至少一个群体的刻板印象乌克兰语句子（对 IDPs 最明显），而英语得分大多均衡。WarBias 支持对刻板印象偏好和情境敏感判断的互补评估，并为基于 unlearning 的偏见缓解提供了成对的遗忘/保留材料。我们记录了该基准的构建、预期用途和局限性，并提供其构建方法作为其他受冲突影响社会中类似基准的模板。
translation.brief: 针对语言模型评估中缺失对退伍军人和国内流离失所者刻板印象考察的问题，基于 120 条声明分类体系构建了 WarBias 乌克兰语—英语双语基准并进行了基线评估。

papers.title: Least-Privilege Auditing of Agent Tool Calls with Intent Graphs and Reasoning-Guided Escalation
papers.abstract: LLM agents that call tools are exposed to indirect prompt injection: instructions hidden in tool outputs can steer an agent into calls the user never asked for. We present a runtime audit that derives an executable intent graph from the user's objective and the deployment's tool catalog with one LLM call per task, and checks every tool call against it with a deterministic loop that makes no LLM call (median 5.7 microseconds per call). Two further mechanisms recover utility. Lookups of the user's own state bypass the audit, because the harm of an attack lies in its write or outward step. The calls that remain flagged are escalated to a reasoning guardian, in the spirit of tool-integrated reasoning models such as START: a reasoning model that sees only the objective, the plan, the call history without tool outputs, and the flagged call, and can verify facts with a restricted Python-expression tool. A current agent showed no baseline attack success, so end-to-end validation remains open.

translation.title: 基于意图图与推理引导升级的 Agent 工具调用最小权限审计
translation.abstract: 调用工具的 LLM agents 会面临间接提示注入：隐藏在工具输出中的指令可以诱导 agent 执行用户从未要求的调用。我们提出一种运行时审计方法，从用户目标和部署的工具目录中派生可执行的意图图（每个任务一次 LLM 调用），并用一个不进行 LLM 调用的确定性循环（每次调用中位数 5.7 微秒）检查每个工具调用是否符合意图图。另有两个机制用于恢复效用：对用户自身状态的查询绕过审计，因为攻击的危害在于其写入或外发步骤；其余被标记的调用被升级至一个推理守护者，其精神类似 START 等工具集成推理模型——该推理模型仅看到目标、计划、不含工具输出的调用历史以及被标记的调用，并可通过受限的 Python 表达式工具验证事实。当前的 agent 未表现出基线攻击成功，因此端到端验证仍有待完成。
translation.brief: 针对间接提示注入诱导 agent 发起越权工具调用的问题，提出从用户目标派生可执行意图图并以确定性循环校验每次调用、辅以推理守护者升级的运行时审计方法。

papers.title: SkillCODER: Towards Auditing and Attribution of Copyright Infringement in LLM Agent Skills
papers.abstract: Agent skills package reusable workflows and task-specific procedures into deployable natural-language artifacts for LLM agents. Their scale and readability make them valuable but vulnerable to unauthorized redistribution and repackaging. Existing prompt copyright auditing methods struggle with long skills and introduce token-level perturbations that compromise readability. We propose SkillCODER for copyright auditing and buyer attribution in a black-box, content-only setting. During embedding, SkillCODER parses a skill into a section-aware intermediate representation, SkillIR, to identify structural anchors. It distributes conditional instructions across these anchors to form an Artifact-Gated Capsule, designed to activate under verification queries and remain dormant otherwise. Controlled-Vocabulary Error-Correcting Codes encode buyer-specific fingerprints through controlled lexical choices within the capsule. During verification, the defender issues paired positive and negative probes, extracts capsule evidence, and recovers ownership and buyer identity through error-correcting decoding. Across three domains, six models, and three agent frameworks, SkillCODER achieves 99.2% owner verification and 99.3% buyer Top-1 attribution accuracy while preserving task fidelity, substantially outperforming prompt-level baselines. Embedded signals remain robust under paraphrase, compression, clause deletion, and reorganization. Under five adaptive attacks, including a method-aware LLM sanitizer and multi-buyer collusion, ownership evidence remains reliably detectable while buyer attribution degrades gracefully.

translation.title: SkillCODER：面向 LLM Agent 技能版权侵权的审计与归因
translation.abstract: Agent skills 将可复用的工作流和任务特定流程打包为面向 LLM agents 的可部署自然语言制品。其规模和可读性使其有价值，但也易受未授权再分发和重新打包的侵害。现有的 prompt 版权审计方法难以处理长技能，且会引入损害可读性的 token 级扰动。我们提出 SkillCODER，在黑盒、仅内容设置下进行版权审计和买家归因。在嵌入阶段，SkillCODER 将技能解析为分节的中间表示 SkillIR 以识别结构锚点，并将条件指令分布到这些锚点上，形成 Artifact-Gated Capsule——设计为在验证查询下激活、其余情况下保持休眠。Controlled-Vocabulary Error-Correcting Codes 通过 capsule 内受控的词汇选择编码买家特定指纹。在验证阶段，防御者发出成对的阳性与阴性探针，提取 capsule 证据，并通过纠错解码恢复所有权和买家身份。在三个领域、六个模型和三个 agent 框架的实验中，SkillCODER 在保持任务保真度的同时实现 99.2% 的所有者验证和 99.3% 的买家 Top-1 归因准确率，大幅超越 prompt 级基线。嵌入信号在改写、压缩、子句删除和重组下保持鲁棒。在五种自适应攻击（包括方法感知的 LLM 清洗器和多买家合谋）下，所有权证据仍可可靠检测，而买家归因性能平滑退化。
translation.brief: 针对 agent skill 易被未授权再分发且现有 prompt 版权审计方法失效的问题，提出 SkillCODER，通过结构锚点嵌入门控 capsule 与纠错码指纹实现黑盒下的版权审计与买家归因。

papers.title: Verify Before You Fetch: Reliable KV Cache Compression for LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Long-context applications, long-lived agents, and multi-agent systems require large language models (LLMs) to process and retain extensive information. In these settings, the KV cache can exceed GPU high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity, necessitating offloading to host memory, where CPU-to-GPU transfers can dominate inference latency. While KV cache compression can reduce data movement, query-agnostic compression that guarantees accurate attention for arbitrary queries is extremely challenging, if not impossible. We introduce VerKV, a hybrid approach that provides $(ε, δ)$ guarantees for approximating attention on any given query. VerKV maintains a compact set of query-agnostic pivotal tokens on the GPU, together with a token-level sketch of the full KV cache, while retaining the complete cache in CPU memory. We introduce a novel stochastic sampling procedure, PoissonComp, to select the pivotal tokens. At inference time, our proposed KVFetch algorithm uses the pivotal tokens and the sketch to estimate the relative error of the resulting attention computation. If the estimate satisfies a user-specified $(ε, δ)$ tolerance, inference proceeds without accessing host memory. Otherwise, VerKV performs query-aware retrieval to fetch additional tokens from the CPU, refining the attention computation to meet the required tolerance. Thus, VerKV enables attention with bounded approximation error while minimizing CPU-to-GPU transfers. We show that PoissonComp outperforms state-of-the-art approaches to KV cache compression. Combined with KVFetch, it achieves near-dense performance (90-100% of dense quality at 32K context length, averaged over RULER and LOFT), using Qwen3-4B, Qwen3.5-9B and Ministral-3-8B, while reducing the GPU memory footprint by 8-32x and keeping CPU-to-GPU memory fetches within 2-23% of the cache per generated token, depending on the model.

translation.title: 先验证再取数：面向 LLM 推理的可靠 KV Cache 压缩
translation.abstract: 长上下文应用、长生命周期 agents 和多智能体系统要求大语言模型（LLMs）处理和保留大量信息。在这些场景中，KV cache 可能超过 GPU 高带宽内存（HBM）容量，从而需要卸载到主机内存，而 CPU 到 GPU 的传输会主导推理延迟。虽然 KV cache 压缩可以减少数据移动，但保证对任意查询准确注意力的查询无关压缩极其困难甚至不可能。我们提出 VerKV，一种为任意给定查询的注意力近似提供 (ε, δ) 保证的混合方法。VerKV 在 GPU 上维护一组紧凑的查询无关 pivotal tokens 以及完整 KV cache 的 token 级 sketch，同时在 CPU 内存中保留完整 cache。我们提出一种新颖的随机采样过程 PoissonComp 来选择 pivotal tokens。推理时，我们提出的 KVFetch 算法使用 pivotal tokens 和 sketch 估计注意力计算的相对误差。若估计值满足用户指定的 (ε, δ) 容忍度，推理无需访问主机内存即可继续；否则，VerKV 执行查询感知检索，从 CPU 取回额外 token，精化注意力计算以满足所需容忍度。因此，VerKV 在最小化 CPU 到 GPU 传输的同时，实现了具有有界近似误差的注意力。我们证明 PoissonComp 优于最先进的 KV cache 压缩方法。与 KVFetch 结合后，使用 Qwen3-4B、Qwen3.5-9B 和 Ministral-3-8B，在 32K 上下文长度下（RULER 与 LOFT 平均）达到近乎稠密的性能（稠密质量的 90-100%），同时将 GPU 内存占用减少 8-32 倍，并使每个生成 token 的 CPU 到 GPU 内存取数保持在 cache 的 2-23% 以内（依模型而异）。
